`components/ThemeToggle.tsx`:

```tsx
   1 | import { useEffect, useState } from "react";
   2 |
   3 | type ThemeMode = "light" | "dark" | "auto";
   4 |
   5 | function getInitialMode(): ThemeMode {
   6 | 	if (typeof window === "undefined") {
   7 | 		return "auto";
   8 | 	}
   9 |
  10 | 	const stored = window.localStorage.getItem("theme");
  11 | 	if (stored === "light" || stored === "dark" || stored === "auto") {
  12 | 		return stored;
  13 | 	}
  14 |
  15 | 	return "auto";
  16 | }
  17 |
  18 | function applyThemeMode(mode: ThemeMode) {
  19 | 	const prefersDark = window.matchMedia("(prefers-color-scheme: dark)").matches;
  20 | 	const resolved = mode === "auto" ? (prefersDark ? "dark" : "light") : mode;
  21 |
  22 | 	document.documentElement.classList.remove("light", "dark");
  23 | 	document.documentElement.classList.add(resolved);
  24 |
  25 | 	if (mode === "auto") {
  26 | 		document.documentElement.removeAttribute("data-theme");
  27 | 	} else {
  28 | 		document.documentElement.setAttribute("data-theme", mode);
  29 | 	}
  30 |
  31 | 	document.documentElement.style.colorScheme = resolved;
  32 | }
  33 |
  34 | export default function ThemeToggle() {
  35 | 	const [mode, setMode] = useState<ThemeMode>("auto");
  36 |
  37 | 	useEffect(() => {
  38 | 		const initialMode = getInitialMode();
  39 | 		setMode(initialMode);
  40 | 		applyThemeMode(initialMode);
  41 | 	}, []);
  42 |
  43 | 	useEffect(() => {
  44 | 		if (mode !== "auto") {
  45 | 			return;
  46 | 		}
  47 |
  48 | 		const media = window.matchMedia("(prefers-color-scheme: dark)");
  49 | 		const onChange = () => applyThemeMode("auto");
  50 |
  51 | 		media.addEventListener("change", onChange);
  52 | 		return () => {
  53 | 			media.removeEventListener("change", onChange);
  54 | 		};
  55 | 	}, [mode]);
  56 |
  57 | 	function toggleMode() {
  58 | 		const nextMode: ThemeMode = mode === "light" ? "dark" : mode === "dark" ? "auto" : "light";
  59 | 		setMode(nextMode);
  60 | 		applyThemeMode(nextMode);
  61 | 		window.localStorage.setItem("theme", nextMode);
  62 | 	}
  63 |
  64 | 	const label =
  65 | 		mode === "auto"
  66 | 			? "Theme mode: auto (system). Click to switch to light mode."
  67 | 			: `Theme mode: ${mode}. Click to switch mode.`;
  68 |
  69 | 	return (
  70 | 		<button
  71 | 			aria-label={label}
  72 | 			className='rounded-full border border-[var(--chip-line)] bg-[var(--chip-bg)] px-3 py-1.5 font-semibold text-[var(--sea-ink)] text-sm shadow-[0_8px_22px_rgba(30,90,72,0.08)] transition hover:-translate-y-0.5'
  73 | 			onClick={toggleMode}
  74 | 			title={label}
  75 | 			type='button'
  76 | 		>
  77 | 			{mode === "auto" ? "Auto" : mode === "dark" ? "Dark" : "Light"}
  78 | 		</button>
  79 | 	);
  80 | }
```

```tsx
 342 | 											{ value: "SMS", label: "SMS" },
 343 | 											{ value: "BOTH", label: "Both" }
 344 | 										]}
 345 | 									/>
 346 | 								</div>
 347 | 							)}
 348 | 						</div>
 349 |
 350 | 						{/* Medical Information */}
 351 | 						<div className='space-y-4'>
 352 | 							<h3 className='flex items-center gap-2 font-semibold text-lg'>
 353 | 								<Activity className='h-5 w-5' />
 354 | 								Medical Information

 357 | 							<FormTextareaField

 361 | 								rows={3}
 362 | 							/>
 363 | 						</div>

 438 | export function RescheduleAppointmentForm({ appointmentId, currentDate, onSuccess, onCancel }: RescheduleFormProps) {
 439 | 	const queryClient = useQueryClient();

 441 | 	// Use updateAppointmentStatus since there's no dedicated reschedule procedure
 442 | 	const { mutate: updateStatus, isPending } = useMutation(
 443 | 		orpc.appointments.update.mutationOptions({
```

```tsx
  44 | // WHO Z-Score interpretation labels
  45 | const getZScoreInterpretation = (zScore: number | undefined, type: "weight" | "height" | "bmi" | "hc"): string => {
  46 | 	if (zScore === undefined) return "Not available";
  47 |
  48 | 	if (type === "weight") {
  49 | 		if (zScore < -3) return "Severely Underweight";
  50 | 		if (zScore < -2) return "Underweight";
  51 | 		if (zScore <= 1) return "Normal";
  52 | 		if (zScore <= 2) return "Overweight";
  53 | 		return "Obese";
  54 | 	}
  55 |
  56 | 	if (type === "height") {
  57 | 		if (zScore < -3) return "Severely Stunted";
  58 | 		if (zScore < -2) return "Stunted";
  59 | 		if (zScore <= 1) return "Normal";
  60 | 		if (zScore <= 2) return "Tall";
  61 | 		return "Very Tall";
  62 | 	}
  63 |
  64 | 	if (type === "bmi") {
  65 | 		if (zScore < -3) return "Severely Thin";
  66 | 		if (zScore < -2) return "Thin";
  67 | 		if (zScore <= 1) return "Normal";
  68 | 		if (zScore <= 2) return "Overweight";
  69 | 		return "Obese";
  70 | 	}
  71 |
  72 | 	if (type === "hc") {
  73 | 		if (zScore < -3) return "Severely Microcephalic";
  74 | 		if (zScore < -2) return "Microcephalic";
  75 | 		if (zScore <= 2) return "Normal";
  76 | 		return "Macrocephalic";
  77 | 	}
  78 |
  79 | 	return "Unknown";
  80 | };
  81 |
  82 | const getZScoreColor = (zScore: number | undefined): string => {
  83 | 	if (zScore === undefined) return "bg-gray-100 text-gray-700";
  84 | 	if (zScore >= -2 && zScore <= 2) return "bg-green-100 text-green-700";
```

```tsx
 737 | 						<div className='flex justify-end gap-4'>
 738 | 							{onCancel && (
 739 | 								<Button
 740 | 									onClick={onCancel}
 741 | 									type='button'
 742 | 									variant='outline'
 743 | 								>
 744 | 									Cancel
 745 | 								</Button>
 746 | 							)}
 747 | 							<form.SubmitButton disabled={isPending}>
 748 | 								{isPending ? "Creating..." : "Create Patient"}
 749 | 							</form.SubmitButton>
 750 | 						</div>
 751 | 					</form.Form>
 752 | 				</form.AppForm>
 753 | 			</CardContent>
 754 | 		</Card>
 755 | 	);
 756 | }
 757 |
 758 | // Export types
 759 | export type { PatientFormValues };
```

```tsx
  56 | type VitalSignsFormValues = z.infer<typeof vitalSignsFormSchema>;
  57 |
  58 | // Helper function to calculate age from date of birth
  59 | function calculateAge(dateOfBirth: Date): { days: number; months: number } {
  60 | 	const today = new Date();
  61 | 	const diffTime = Math.abs(today.getTime() - dateOfBirth.getTime());
  62 | 	const diffDays = Math.ceil(diffTime / (1000 * 60 * 60 * 24));
  63 | 	const diffMonths =
  64 | 		(today.getFullYear() - dateOfBirth.getFullYear()) * 12 + (today.getMonth() - dateOfBirth.getMonth());
  65 |
  66 | 	return { days: diffDays, months: Math.max(0, diffMonths) };
  67 | }
  68 |
  69 | // Helper to calculate BMI
  70 | function calculateBMI(weight: number | undefined, height: number | undefined): number | undefined {
  71 | 	if (weight && height && height > 0) {
  72 | 		const heightInMeters = height / 100;
  73 | 		return Number((weight / (heightInMeters * heightInMeters)).toFixed(1));
  74 | 	}
  75 | 	return undefined;
  76 | }
  77 |
  78 | // Helper to interpret vital signs
  79 | function getVitalStatus(
  80 | 	value: number | undefined,
  81 | 	ranges: { min: number; max: number; criticalMin?: number; criticalMax?: number },
  82 | 	unit: string
  83 | ): { status: "normal" | "warning" | "critical"; display: string } {
  84 | 	if (value === undefined) return { status: "normal", display: "Not recorded" };
  85 |
  86 | 	if (ranges.criticalMin && value < ranges.criticalMin) {
  87 | 		return { status: "critical", display: `⚠️ Critical Low: ${value} ${unit}` };
  88 | 	}
  89 | 	if (ranges.criticalMax && value > ranges.criticalMax) {
  90 | 		return { status: "critical", display: `⚠️ Critical High: ${value} ${unit}` };
  91 | 	}
  92 | 	if (value < ranges.min) {
  93 | 		return { status: "warning", display: `Low: ${value} ${unit}` };
  94 | 	}
  95 | 	if (value > ranges.max) {
  96 | 		return { status: "warning", display: `High: ${value} ${unit}` };
  97 | 	}
  98 | 	return { status: "normal", display: `${value} ${unit}` };
  99 | }

 102 | const vitalRanges = {

 104 | 	systolic: { min: 90, max: 120, criticalMin: 70, criticalMax: 180, unit: "mmHg" },
 105 | 	diastolic: { min: 60, max: 80, criticalMin: 40, criticalMax: 120, unit: "mmHg" },
 106 | 	heartRate: { min: 60, max: 100, criticalMin: 40, criticalMax: 150, unit: "bpm" },
 107 | 	respiratoryRate: { min: 12, max: 20, criticalMin: 8, criticalMax: 30, unit: "breaths/min" },
 108 | 	oxygenSaturation: { min: 95, max: 100, criticalMin: 85, unit: "%" }

 114 | 	toddler: { heartRate: { min: 70, max: 120 }, respiratoryRate: { min: 18, max: 30 } },
 115 | 	child: { heartRate: { min: 60, max: 110 }, respiratoryRate: { min: 15, max: 25 } },
 116 | 	adolescent: { heartRate: { min: 55, max: 100 }, respiratoryRate: { min: 12, max: 20 } }

 119 | function getPediatricRange(ageMonths: number | undefined) {

 122 | 	if (ageMonths < 36) return pediatricRanges.toddler;
 123 | 	if (ageMonths < 144) return pediatricRanges.child;

 782 | // Vital signs history / view-only component
 783 | interface VitalSignsHistoryProps {
 784 | 	patientId: string;

 786 | }
 787 |
 788 | export function VitalSignsHistory({ patientId, onSelectRecord }: VitalSignsHistoryProps) {
 789 | 	const { data, isLoading } = useQuery(
 790 | 		orpc.vitalSigns.list.queryOptions({
 791 | 			input: { patientId, limit: 50 }
 792 | 		})
 793 | 	);
 794 |
 795 | 	if (isLoading) {

 797 | 	}
 798 |
 799 | 	if (!data?.vitalSigns?.length) {
 800 | 		return (

 802 | 		);
 803 | 	}
 804 |
 805 | 	return (
 806 | 		<div className='space-y-4'>

 815 | 						<CardContent className='p-4'>
 816 | 							<div className='flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-2'>

 821 | 									)}
 822 | 									{record.heartRate && <Badge variant='outline'>❤️ {record.heartRate} bpm</Badge>}

 830 | 								</div>
 831 | 							</div>
 832 | 						</CardContent>

 836 | 		</div>
```

`components/forms/fields/checkbox-field.tsx`:

```tsx
   1 | import { useStore } from "@tanstack/react-form";
   2 |
   3 | import { Checkbox } from "#/components/ui/checkbox";
   4 | import { FieldDescription, FieldLabel } from "#/components/ui/field";
   5 | import {
   6 | 	createFormField,
   7 | 	FormField,
   8 | 	FormFieldError,
   9 | 	FormFieldSet,
  10 | 	useFieldContext
  11 | } from "#/components/ui/form-context";
  12 |
  13 | interface CheckboxFieldProps {
  14 | 	label: string;
  15 | 	description?: string;
  16 | }
  17 |
  18 | export function CheckboxField({ label, description }: CheckboxFieldProps) {
  19 | 	const field = useFieldContext();
  20 | 	const isTouched = useStore(field.store, s => s.meta.isTouched);
  21 | 	const isValid = useStore(field.store, s => s.meta.isValid);
  22 | 	const value = useStore(field.store, s => s.value) as boolean;
  23 |
  24 | 	return (
  25 | 		<FormFieldSet>
  26 | 			<FormField orientation='horizontal'>
  27 | 				<Checkbox
  28 | 					aria-invalid={isTouched && !isValid}
  29 | 					checked={value}
  30 | 					onCheckedChange={checked => {
  31 | 						field.handleChange(checked as boolean);
  32 | 						field.handleBlur();
  33 | 					}}
  34 | 				/>
  35 | 				<div className='flex flex-1 flex-col gap-1.5 leading-snug'>
  36 | 					<FieldLabel className='leading-none'>{label}</FieldLabel>
  37 | 					{description && <FieldDescription>{description}</FieldDescription>}
  38 | 					<FormFieldError />
  39 | 				</div>
  40 | 			</FormField>
  41 | 		</FormFieldSet>
  42 | 	);
  43 | }
  44 |
  45 | export const FormCheckboxField = createFormField(CheckboxField);
```

`components/forms/fields/select-field.tsx`:

```tsx
   1 | import { useStore } from "@tanstack/react-form";
   2 |
   3 | import { FieldDescription, FieldLabel } from "#/components/ui/field";
   4 | import {
   5 | 	createFormField,
   6 | 	FormField,
   7 | 	FormFieldError,
   8 | 	FormFieldSet,
   9 | 	useFieldContext
  10 | } from "#/components/ui/form-context";
  11 | import { Select, SelectContent, SelectItem, SelectTrigger, SelectValue } from "#/components/ui/select";
  12 |
  13 | type Option = { value: string; label: string };
  14 |
  15 | interface SelectFieldProps {
  16 | 	label: string;
  17 | 	description?: string;
  18 | 	required?: boolean;
  19 | 	options: Option[];
  20 | 	placeholder?: string;
  21 | 	disabled?: boolean;
  22 | }
  23 |
  24 | export function SelectField({
  25 | 	label,
  26 | 	description,
  27 | 	required,
  28 | 	options,
  29 | 	placeholder = "Select an option",
  30 | 	disabled
  31 | }: SelectFieldProps) {
  32 | 	const field = useFieldContext();
  33 | 	const isTouched = useStore(field.store, s => s.meta.isTouched);
  34 | 	const isValid = useStore(field.store, s => s.meta.isValid);
  35 | 	const value = useStore(field.store, s => s.value) as string;
  36 |
  37 | 	return (
  38 | 		<FormFieldSet>
  39 | 			<FormField>
  40 | 				<FieldLabel htmlFor={field.name}>
  41 | 					{label}
  42 | 					{required && " *"}
  43 | 				</FieldLabel>
  44 | 				<Select
  45 | 					disabled={disabled}
  46 | 					onOpenChange={open => {
  47 | 						if (!open) field.handleBlur();
  48 | 					}}
  49 | 					onValueChange={field.handleChange}
  50 | 					value={value}
  51 | 				>
  52 | 					<SelectTrigger
  53 | 						aria-invalid={isTouched && !isValid}
  54 | 						disabled={disabled}
  55 | 						id={field.name}
  56 | 					>
  57 | 						<SelectValue placeholder={placeholder} />
  58 | 					</SelectTrigger>

  60 | 						{options.map(opt => (
  61 | 							<SelectItem
  62 | 								key={opt.value}
  63 | 								value={opt.value}
  64 | 							>
  65 | 								{opt.label}
  66 | 							</SelectItem>
  67 | 						))}
  68 | 					</SelectContent>
  69 | 				</Select>
  70 | 				{description && <FieldDescription>{description}</FieldDescription>}
  71 | 			</FormField>
```

`components/forms/fields/slider-field.tsx`:

```tsx
   1 | import { useStore } from "@tanstack/react-form";
   2 |
   3 | import { FieldDescription, FieldLabel } from "#/components/ui/field";
   4 | import { createFormField, FormField, FormFieldSet, useFieldContext } from "#/components/ui/form-context";
   5 | import { Slider } from "#/components/ui/slider";
   6 |
   7 | interface SliderFieldProps {
   8 | 	label: string;
   9 | 	description?: string;
  10 | 	min?: number;
  11 | 	max?: number;
  12 | 	step?: number;
  13 | }
  14 |
  15 | export function SliderField({ label, description, min = 0, max = 100, step = 1 }: SliderFieldProps) {
  16 | 	const field = useFieldContext();
  17 | 	const value = (useStore(field.store, s => s.value) as number) ?? min;
  18 |
  19 | 	return (
  20 | 		<FormFieldSet>
  21 | 			<FormField>
  22 | 				<FieldLabel>{label}</FieldLabel>
  23 | 				<div className='px-1'>
  24 | 					<Slider
  25 | 						max={max}
  26 | 						min={min}
  27 | 						onBlur={field.handleBlur}
  28 | 						onValueChange={v => field.handleChange(v[0])}
  29 | 						step={step}
  30 | 						value={[value]}
  31 | 					/>
  32 | 					<div className='mt-1 flex justify-between text-muted-foreground text-xs tabular-nums'>
  33 | 						<span>{min}</span>
  34 | 						<span className='font-medium'>
  35 | 							{value}/{max}
  36 | 						</span>
  37 | 						<span>{max}</span>
  38 | 					</div>
  39 | 				</div>
  40 | 				{description && <FieldDescription>{description}</FieldDescription>}
  41 | 			</FormField>
  42 | 		</FormFieldSet>
  43 | 	);
  44 | }
  45 |
  46 | export const FormSliderField = createFormField(SliderField);
```

`components/forms/fields/text-field.tsx`:

```tsx
   1 | import { useStore } from "@tanstack/react-form";
   2 |
   3 | import { FieldDescription, FieldLabel } from "#/components/ui/field";
   4 | import {
   5 | 	createFormField,
   6 | 	FormField,
   7 | 	FormFieldError,
   8 | 	FormFieldSet,
   9 | 	useFieldContext
  10 | } from "#/components/ui/form-context";
  11 | import { Input } from "#/components/ui/input";
  12 | import { Spinner } from "#/components/ui/spinner";
  13 |
  14 | interface TextFieldProps extends Omit<React.ComponentProps<"input">, "value" | "onChange" | "onBlur"> {
  15 | 	label: string;
  16 | 	description?: string;
  17 | 	required?: boolean;
  18 | 	type?: "text" | "email" | "password" | "tel" | "url" | "number" | "color";
  19 | }
  20 |
  21 | export function TextField({ label, description, required, type = "text", className, ...inputProps }: TextFieldProps) {
  22 | 	const field = useFieldContext();
  23 | 	const isTouched = useStore(field.store, s => s.meta.isTouched);
  24 | 	const isValid = useStore(field.store, s => s.meta.isValid);
  25 | 	const isValidating = useStore(field.store, s => s.meta.isValidating);
  26 | 	const value = useStore(field.store, s => s.value) as string | number;
  27 |
  28 | 	return (
  29 | 		<FormFieldSet>
  30 | 			<FormField>
  31 | 				<FieldLabel htmlFor={field.name}>
  32 | 					{label}
  33 | 					{required && " *"}
  34 | 				</FieldLabel>
  35 | 				<div className='relative'>
  36 | 					<Input
  37 | 						aria-invalid={isTouched && !isValid}
  38 | 						className={className}
  39 | 						id={field.name}
  40 | 						onBlur={field.handleBlur}
  41 | 						onChange={e => {
  42 | 							if (type === "number") {
  43 | 								const v = e.target.value;
  44 | 								field.handleChange(v === "" ? "" : Number.parseFloat(v));
  45 | 							} else {
  46 | 								field.handleChange(e.target.value);
  47 | 							}
  48 | 						}}
  49 | 						type={type}
  50 | 						value={value ?? ""}
  51 | 						{...inputProps}
  52 | 					/>
  53 | 					{isValidating && (
  54 | 						<div className='absolute top-1/2 right-3 -translate-y-1/2'>
  55 | 							<Spinner className='h-4 w-4' />
  56 | 						</div>
  57 | 					)}
  58 | 				</div>
  59 | 				{description && <FieldDescription>{description}</FieldDescription>}
  60 | 			</FormField>
  61 | 			<FormFieldError />
  62 | 		</FormFieldSet>
  63 | 	);
  64 | }
  65 |
  66 | export const FormTextField = createFormField(TextField);
```

`components/forms/fields/textarea-field.tsx`:

```tsx
   1 | import { useStore } from "@tanstack/react-form";
   2 |
   3 | import { FieldDescription, FieldLabel } from "#/components/ui/field";
   4 | import {
   5 | 	createFormField,
   6 | 	FormField,
   7 | 	FormFieldError,
   8 | 	FormFieldSet,
   9 | 	useFieldContext
  10 | } from "#/components/ui/form-context";
  11 | import { Textarea } from "#/components/ui/textarea";
  12 |
  13 | interface TextareaFieldProps extends Omit<React.ComponentProps<"textarea">, "value" | "onChange" | "onBlur"> {
  14 | 	label: string;
  15 | 	description?: string;
  16 | 	required?: boolean;
  17 | 	maxLength?: number;
  18 | 	showCount?: boolean;
  19 | }
  20 |
  21 | export function TextareaField({
  22 | 	label,
  23 | 	description,
  24 | 	required,
  25 | 	maxLength,
  26 | 	showCount = !!maxLength,
  27 | 	className,
  28 | 	...textareaProps
  29 | }: TextareaFieldProps) {
  30 | 	const field = useFieldContext();
  31 | 	const isTouched = useStore(field.store, s => s.meta.isTouched);
  32 | 	const isValid = useStore(field.store, s => s.meta.isValid);
  33 | 	const value = (useStore(field.store, s => s.value) as string) ?? "";
  34 |
  35 | 	return (
  36 | 		<FormFieldSet>
  37 | 			<FormField>
  38 | 				<FieldLabel htmlFor={field.name}>
  39 | 					{label}
  40 | 					{required && " *"}
  41 | 				</FieldLabel>
  42 | 				<Textarea
  43 | 					aria-invalid={isTouched && !isValid}
  44 | 					className={className}
  45 | 					id={field.name}
  46 | 					maxLength={maxLength}
  47 | 					onBlur={field.handleBlur}
  48 | 					onChange={e => field.handleChange(e.target.value)}
  49 | 					value={value}
  50 | 					{...textareaProps}
  51 | 				/>
  52 | 				{showCount && (
  53 | 					<div className='text-right text-muted-foreground text-xs tabular-nums'>
  54 | 						{value.length}
  55 | 						{maxLength ? ` / ${maxLength}` : ""}
  56 | 					</div>
  57 | 				)}
  58 | 				{description && <FieldDescription>{description}</FieldDescription>}

  60 | 			<FormFieldError />
```

```tsx
  64 | 			doctorId: initialData?.doctorId ?? null,

  77 | 		},

  79 | 			// Ensure doctorId is null if undefined

  81 | 				...value,

  83 | 			};

  85 | 		}
  86 | 	});

 100 | 						<div className='grid grid-cols-1 gap-4 md:grid-cols-2'>
 101 | 							{/* Patient Selection */}
 102 | 							<form.AppField name='patientId'>
 103 | 								{field => (
 104 | 									<div className='space-y-2'>

 107 | 										</Label>
 108 | 										<Select

 112 | 										>

 127 | 										{field.state.meta.errors.length > 0 && (
```

`components/table/data-table-column-filter.tsx`:

```tsx
   1 | import { CaretDownIcon } from "@phosphor-icons/react";
   2 | import type { Table } from "@tanstack/react-table";
   3 |
   4 | import { Button } from "#/components/ui/button";
   5 | import { Checkbox } from "#/components/ui/checkbox";
   6 | import { Dialog, DialogTrigger } from "#/components/ui/dialog";
   7 | import { GridList, GridListItem } from "#/components/ui/grid-list";
   8 | import { Popover } from "#/components/ui/popover";
   9 |
  10 | interface DataTableColumnFilterProps<TData> {
  11 | 	table: Table<TData>;
  12 | }
  13 |
  14 | export function DataTableColumnFilter<TData>({ table }: DataTableColumnFilterProps<TData>) {
  15 | 	const columns = table.getAllColumns().filter(column => column.getCanHide());
  16 |
  17 | 	return (
  18 | 		<DialogTrigger>
  19 | 			<Button variant='default'>
  20 | 				Columns <CaretDownIcon />
  21 | 			</Button>
  22 | 			<Popover>
  23 | 				<Dialog>
  24 | 					<GridList
  25 | 						aria-label='Toggle column visibility'
  26 | 						items={columns}
  27 | 						onSelectionChange={selectedIds => {
  28 | 							const visibilityState: Record<string, boolean> = {};
  29 |
  30 | 							for (const column of columns) {
  31 | 								if (selectedIds === "all") {
  32 | 									visibilityState[column.id] = true;
  33 | 								} else if (typeof selectedIds?.has === "function") {
  34 | 									visibilityState[column.id] = selectedIds.has(column.id);
  35 | 								}
  36 | 							}
  37 |
  38 | 							table.setColumnVisibility(visibilityState);
  39 | 						}}
  40 | 						selectedKeys={table.getVisibleLeafColumns().map(({ id }) => id)}
  41 | 						selectionMode='multiple'
  42 | 					>
  43 | 						{column => (
  44 | 							<GridListItem textValue={column.id}>
  45 | 								<Checkbox slot='selection'>{column.columnDef.header?.toString()}</Checkbox>
  46 | 							</GridListItem>
  47 | 						)}
  48 | 					</GridList>
  49 | 				</Dialog>
  50 | 			</Popover>
  51 | 		</DialogTrigger>
  52 | 	);
  53 | }

```

```tsx
   1 | import { EmptyIcon } from "@phosphor-icons/react";
   2 | import { type RankingInfo, rankItem } from "@tanstack/match-sorter-utils";
   3 | import {
   4 | 	type ColumnDef,
   5 | 	type FilterFn,
   6 | 	flexRender,
   7 | 	getCoreRowModel,
   8 | 	getFilteredRowModel,
   9 | 	getPaginationRowModel,

  12 | 	type SortingState,
  13 | 	useReactTable
  14 | } from "@tanstack/react-table";
  15 | import type React from "react";
  16 | import { useState } from "react";
  17 |
  18 | import { DataTableSearch } from "#/components/table/data-table-search";
  19 | import { Callout, CalloutIcon, CalloutText } from "#/components/ui/callout";
  20 | import { Table, TableBody, TableCell, TableHead, TableHeader, TableRow } from "#/components/ui/table";
  21 |
  22 | import { DataTableColumnFilter } from "./data-table-column-filter";
  23 | import { DataTablePagination } from "./data-table-pagination";
  24 | import { DataTableSortButton } from "./data-table-sort-button";
  25 |
  26 | declare module "@tanstack/react-table" {
  27 | 	interface FilterFns {
  28 | 		fuzzy: FilterFn<unknown>;
  29 | 	}
  30 | 	interface FilterMeta {
  31 | 		itemRank: RankingInfo;
  32 | 	}
  33 | }
  34 |
  35 | interface DataTableProps<TData, TValue> {
  36 | 	actions?: React.ReactNode;
  37 | 	columns: ColumnDef<TData, TValue>[];
  38 | 	data: TData[];
  39 | 	defaultColumnVisibility?: Record<string, boolean>;
  40 | 	label: string;
  41 | }
  42 |
  43 | const fuzzyFilter: FilterFn<unknown> = (row, columnId, value, addMeta) => {
  44 | 	const itemRank = rankItem(row.getValue(columnId), value);
  45 |
  46 | 	addMeta({
  47 | 		itemRank
  48 | 	});
  49 |
  50 | 	return itemRank.passed;
  51 | };
  52 |
  53 | export function DataTable<TData, TValue>({
  54 | 	actions,
  55 | 	columns,
  56 | 	data,
  57 | 	defaultColumnVisibility,
  58 | 	label
  59 | }: DataTableProps<TData, TValue>) {
  60 | 	const [columnVisibility, setColumnVisibility] = useState(defaultColumnVisibility ?? {});
  61 | 	const [globalFilter, setGlobalFilter] = useState<string>("");
  62 | 	const [sorting, setSorting] = useState<SortingState>([]);
  63 | 	const [pagination, setPagination] = useState<PaginationState>({
  64 | 		pageIndex: 0,
  65 | 		pageSize: 25
  66 | 	});
  67 |
  68 | 	const table = useReactTable({
  69 | 		data,
  70 | 		columns,
  71 | 		filterFns: {
  72 | 			fuzzy: fuzzyFilter
  73 | 		},
  74 | 		getCoreRowModel: getCoreRowModel(),
  75 | 		getFilteredRowModel: getFilteredRowModel(),
  76 | 		getPaginationRowModel: getPaginationRowModel(),
  77 | 		getSortedRowModel: getSortedRowModel(),
  78 | 		globalFilterFn: "fuzzy",
  79 | 		onColumnVisibilityChange: setColumnVisibility,
  80 | 		onGlobalFilterChange: setGlobalFilter,
  81 | 		onPaginationChange: setPagination,
  82 | 		onSortingChange: setSorting,
  83 | 		state: {
  84 | 			columnVisibility,
  85 | 			globalFilter,
  86 | 			pagination,
  87 | 			sorting
  88 | 		}
  89 | 	});
  90 |
  91 | 	return (
  92 | 		<div className='space-y-4'>
  93 | 			<div className='flex flex-wrap justify-between gap-4'>
  94 | 				<DataTableSearch
  95 | 					onChange={setGlobalFilter}
  96 | 					value={globalFilter}
  97 | 				/>
  98 | 				{defaultColumnVisibility ? <DataTableColumnFilter table={table} /> : null}
  99 | 				{actions}
 100 | 			</div>
 101 | 			{table.getRowModel().rows?.length ? (
 102 | 				<div className='space-y-4'>
 103 | 					<Table aria-label={label}>
 104 | 						<TableHeader>
 105 | 							{table.getHeaderGroups().map(headerGroup => (
 106 | 								<TableRow key={headerGroup.id}>
 107 | 									{headerGroup.headers.map(header => (
 108 | 										<TableHead
 109 | 											key={header.id}
 110 | 										>
 111 | 											<div className='flex items-center gap-4'>
 112 | 												{header.isPlaceholder
 113 | 													? null
 114 | 													: flexRender(header.column.columnDef.header, header.getContext())}
 115 | 												{header.column.getCanSort() ? (
 116 | 													<DataTableSortButton
 117 | 														isSorted={header.column.getIsSorted()}
 118 | 														onClick={header.column.getToggleSortingHandler()}
 119 | 													/>
 120 | 												) : null}
 121 | 											</div>
 122 | 										</TableHead>
 123 | 									))}
 124 | 								</TableRow>
 125 | 							))}
 126 | 						</TableHeader>
 127 | 						<TableBody>
 128 | 							{table.getRowModel().rows.map(row => (
 129 | 								<TableRow key={row.id}>
 130 | 									{row.getVisibleCells().map(cell => (
 131 | 										<TableCell key={cell.id}>
 132 | 											{flexRender(cell.column.columnDef.cell, cell.getContext())}
 133 | 										</TableCell>
 134 | 									))}
 135 | 								</TableRow>
 136 | 							))}
 137 | 						</TableBody>
 138 | 					</Table>
 139 | 					<DataTablePagination table={table} />
 140 | 				</div>
 141 | 			) : (
 142 | 				<Callout>
 143 | 					<CalloutIcon>
 144 | 						<EmptyIcon size={16} />
 145 | 					</CalloutIcon>
```

```tsx
  23 | import { getInitials } from "#/lib/utils";
  24 | import { orpc } from "#/orpc/client";
  25 |
  26 | interface Patient {
  27 | 	id: string;
  28 | 	firstName: string;
  29 | 	lastName: string;
  30 | 	email?: string | null;
  31 | 	phone?: string | null;
  32 | 	image?: string | null;
  33 | 	dateOfBirth: string | Date;
  34 | 	gender?: string | null;
  35 | 	status?: string | null;
  36 | }
  37 |
  38 | interface PatientsTableProps {
  39 | 	clinicId: string;
  40 | 	onEdit?: (patient: Patient) => void;
  41 | }
  42 |
  43 | export function PatientsTable({ clinicId, onEdit }: PatientsTableProps) {
  44 | 	const queryClient = useQueryClient();
  45 |
  46 | 	// Fetch patients using ORPC
  47 | 	const { data, isLoading } = useQuery({
  48 | 		queryKey: orpc.patients.list.key({ input: { page: 1, limit: 100 } }),
  49 | 		queryFn: () => orpc.patients.list.call({ page: 1, limit: 100 })
  50 | 	});
  51 |
  52 | 	const deletePatientMutation = useMutation({
  53 | 		mutationFn: (input: { id: string }) => orpc.patients.delete.call(input),
  54 | 		onSuccess: () => {
  55 | 			toast.success("Patient deleted successfully");
  56 | 			queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: orpc.patients.list.key({}) });
  57 | 		},
  58 | 		onError: error => {
  59 | 			console.error(error);
  60 | 			toast.error("Failed to delete patient");
  61 | 		}
  62 | 	});
  63 |
  64 | 	const getStatusBadge = (status: string) => {
  65 | 		const variants: Record<string, "default" | "secondary" | "destructive" | "outline"> = {
  66 | 			ACTIVE: "default",
  67 | 			INACTIVE: "secondary",
  68 | 			DORMANT: "outline"
  69 | 		};
  70 | 		return <Badge variant={variants[status] || "default"}>{status.toLowerCase()}</Badge>;
  71 | 	};
  72 |
  73 | 	// Helper to calculate age in years/months from date of birth
  74 | 	const getAgeString = (dateOfBirth: Date | string) => {
  75 | 		const today = new Date();
  76 | 		const birthDate = new Date(dateOfBirth);
  77 | 		let ageMonths = (today.getFullYear() - birthDate.getFullYear()) * 12;
  78 | 		ageMonths += today.getMonth() - birthDate.getMonth();
  79 | 		if (today.getDate() < birthDate.getDate()) ageMonths--;
  80 | 		if (ageMonths < 24) {
  81 | 			return `${ageMonths} months`;
  82 | 		}
  83 | 		const years = Math.floor(ageMonths / 12);
  84 | 		return `${years} years`;
  85 | 	};
  86 |
  87 | 	const columns: ColumnDef<Patient>[] = [
  88 | 		{
  89 | 			accessorKey: "name",
  90 | 			header: "Name",
  91 | 			cell: ({ row }) => {
  92 | 				const patient = row.original;
  93 | 				return (
  94 | 					<div className='flex items-center gap-3'>
  95 | 						<Avatar className='h-8 w-8'>
  96 | 							{patient.image ? (
  97 | 								<AvatarImage
  98 | 									alt={patient.firstName}
  99 | 									src={patient.image}
 100 | 								/>
 101 | 							) : null}
 102 | 							<AvatarFallback>{getInitials(`${patient.firstName} ${patient.lastName}`)}</AvatarFallback>
 103 | 						</Avatar>
 104 | 						<div>
 105 | 							<div className='font-medium'>
 106 | 								{patient.firstName} {patient.lastName}
 107 | 							</div>
 108 | 							<div className='text-muted-foreground text-sm'>{patient.email || patient.phone}</div>
 109 | 						</div>
 110 | 					</div>
 111 | 				);
 112 | 			},
 113 | 			sortingFn: (a, b) => {
 114 | 				const nameA = `${a.original.firstName} ${a.original.lastName}`;
 115 | 				const nameB = `${b.original.firstName} ${b.original.lastName}`;
 116 | 				return nameA.localeCompare(nameB);
 117 | 			}
 118 | 		},
 119 | 		{
 120 | 			accessorKey: "dateOfBirth",
 121 | 			header: "Date of Birth",
 122 | 			cell: ({ row }) => format(new Date(row.original.dateOfBirth), "PPP"),
 123 | 			sortingFn: "datetime"
 124 | 		},
 125 | 		{
 126 | 			accessorKey: "age",
 127 | 			header: "Age",
 128 | 			cell: ({ row }) => getAgeString(row.original.dateOfBirth)
 129 | 		},
 130 | 		{
 131 | 			accessorKey: "gender",
 132 | 			header: "Gender",
 133 | 			cell: ({ row }) => row.original.gender?.toLowerCase() || "not specified"
 134 | 		},
 135 | 		{
 136 | 			accessorKey: "status",
 137 | 			header: "Status",
 138 | 			cell: ({ row }) => getStatusBadge(row.original.status || "ACTIVE")
 139 | 		},
 140 | 		{
 141 | 			id: "actions",
 142 | 			header: "Actions",
 143 | 			cell: ({ row }) => {
 144 | 				const patient = row.original;
 145 | 				return (
 146 | 					<div className='flex items-center gap-2'>
 147 | 						<Button
 148 | 							aria-label='View patient'
 149 | 							as={Link}
 150 | 							href={`/dashboard/patients/${patient.id}`}
 151 | 							size='sm'
 152 | 							variant='ghost'
 153 | 						>
 154 | 							<EyeIcon className='h-4 w-4' />

 156 | 						<Button

 159 | 							size='sm'
```

```tsx
  15 | 					"bg-destructive text-white shadow-xs hover:bg-destructive/90 focus-visible:ring-destructive/20 dark:bg-destructive/60 dark:focus-visible:ring-destructive/40",
  16 | 				outline:
  17 | 					"border bg-background shadow-xs hover:bg-accent hover:text-accent-foreground dark:border-input dark:bg-input/30 dark:hover:bg-input/50",
  18 | 				secondary: "bg-secondary text-secondary-foreground shadow-xs hover:bg-secondary/80",
  19 | 				ghost: "hover:bg-accent hover:text-accent-foreground dark:hover:bg-accent/50",
  20 | 				link: "text-primary underline-offset-4 hover:underline"
  21 | 			},
  22 | 			size: {
  23 | 				default: "h-9 px-4 py-2 has-[>svg]:px-3",
  24 | 				sm: "h-8 gap-1.5 rounded-md px-3 has-[>svg]:px-2.5",
  25 | 				lg: "h-10 rounded-md px-6 has-[>svg]:px-4",
  26 | 				icon: "size-9"
  27 | 			}
  28 | 		},
  29 | 		defaultVariants: {
  30 | 			variant: "default",
  31 | 			size: "default"
  32 | 		}
  33 | 	}
  34 | );
  35 |
  36 | function Button({
  37 | 	className,
  38 | 	variant,
  39 | 	size,
  40 | 	asChild = false,
  41 | 	isLoading,
  42 | 	children,
  43 | 	disabled,
  44 | 	...props
  45 | }: React.ComponentProps<"button"> &
  46 | 	VariantProps<typeof buttonVariants> & {
  47 | 		asChild?: boolean;
  48 | 		isLoading?: boolean;
  49 | 	}) {
  50 | 	if (asChild) {
  51 | 		return (
  52 | 			<Slot
  53 | 				className={cn(buttonVariants({ variant, size, className }))}
  54 | 				data-slot='button'
  55 | 				{...props}
  56 | 			>
  57 | 				{children}
  58 | 			</Slot>
  59 | 		);
  60 | 	}
  61 |
  62 | 	// Normal button — no loading support, default shadcn behavior
  63 | 	if (isLoading === undefined) {
  64 | 		return (
  65 | 			<button
  66 | 				className={cn(buttonVariants({ variant, size, className }))}
  67 | 				data-slot='button'
  68 | 				disabled={disabled}
  69 | 				{...props}
  70 | 			>
  71 | 				{children}
  72 | 			</button>
  73 | 		);
  74 | 	}
  75 |
  76 | 	// Loading-aware button — grid overlap for zero layout shift.
  77 | 	// Children are always wrapped in a span so has-[>svg] padding
  78 | 	// stays consistent between loading and non-loading states.
  79 | 	return (
  80 | 		<button
  81 | 			aria-busy={isLoading || undefined}
  82 | 			className={cn(
  83 | 				buttonVariants({ variant, size }),
  84 | 				"grid place-items-center [&>*]:col-start-1 [&>*]:row-start-1",
  85 | 				className
  86 | 			)}
  87 | 			data-slot='button'
  88 | 			disabled={disabled || isLoading}
  89 | 			{...props}
  90 | 		>
  91 | 			<span className={cn("inline-flex items-center gap-2", isLoading && "invisible")}>{children}</span>
  92 | 			<span className={cn("flex items-center justify-center", !isLoading && "invisible")}>
  93 | 				<Spinner />
  94 | 			</span>
  95 | 		</button>
  96 | 	);
  97 | }
  98 |
  99 | export { Button, buttonVariants };
```

`components/ui/carousel.tsx`:

```tsx
   1 | "use client";
   2 |
   3 | import useEmblaCarousel, { type UseEmblaCarouselType } from "embla-carousel-react";
   4 | import { ArrowLeft, ArrowRight } from "lucide-react";
   5 | import * as React from "react";
   6 |
   7 | import { Button } from "#/components/ui/button";
   8 | import { cn } from "#/lib/utils";
   9 |
  10 | type CarouselApi = UseEmblaCarouselType[1];
  11 | type UseCarouselParameters = Parameters<typeof useEmblaCarousel>;
  12 | type CarouselOptions = UseCarouselParameters[0];
  13 | type CarouselPlugin = UseCarouselParameters[1];
  14 |
  15 | type CarouselProps = {
  16 | 	opts?: CarouselOptions;
  17 | 	plugins?: CarouselPlugin;
  18 | 	orientation?: "horizontal" | "vertical";
  19 | 	setApi?: (api: CarouselApi) => void;
  20 | };
  21 |
  22 | type CarouselContextProps = {
  23 | 	carouselRef: ReturnType<typeof useEmblaCarousel>[0];
  24 | 	api: ReturnType<typeof useEmblaCarousel>[1];
  25 | 	scrollPrev: () => void;
  26 | 	scrollNext: () => void;
  27 | 	canScrollPrev: boolean;
  28 | 	canScrollNext: boolean;
  29 | } & CarouselProps;
  30 |
  31 | const CarouselContext = React.createContext<CarouselContextProps | null>(null);
  32 |
  33 | function useCarousel() {
  34 | 	const context = React.useContext(CarouselContext);
  35 |
  36 | 	if (!context) {
  37 | 		throw new Error("useCarousel must be used within a <Carousel />");
  38 | 	}
  39 |
  40 | 	return context;
  41 | }
  42 |
  43 | function Carousel({
  44 | 	orientation = "horizontal",
  45 | 	opts,
  46 | 	setApi,
  47 | 	plugins,
  48 | 	className,
  49 | 	children,
  50 | 	...props
  51 | }: React.ComponentProps<"div"> & CarouselProps) {
  52 | 	const [carouselRef, api] = useEmblaCarousel(
  53 | 		{
  54 | 			...opts,
  55 | 			axis: orientation === "horizontal" ? "x" : "y"
  56 | 		},
  57 | 		plugins
  58 | 	);
  59 | 	const [canScrollPrev, setCanScrollPrev] = React.useState(false);
  60 | 	const [canScrollNext, setCanScrollNext] = React.useState(false);
  61 |
  62 | 	const onSelect = React.useCallback((api: CarouselApi) => {
  63 | 		if (!api) return;
  64 | 		setCanScrollPrev(api.canScrollPrev());
  65 | 		setCanScrollNext(api.canScrollNext());
  66 | 	}, []);
  67 |
  68 | 	const scrollPrev = React.useCallback(() => {
  69 | 		api?.scrollPrev();
  70 | 	}, [api]);
  71 |
  72 | 	const scrollNext = React.useCallback(() => {
  73 | 		api?.scrollNext();
  74 | 	}, [api]);
  75 |
  76 | 	const handleKeyDown = React.useCallback(
  77 | 		(event: React.KeyboardEvent<HTMLDivElement>) => {
  78 | 			if (event.key === "ArrowLeft") {
  79 | 				event.preventDefault();
  80 | 				scrollPrev();
  81 | 			} else if (event.key === "ArrowRight") {
  82 | 				event.preventDefault();
  83 | 				scrollNext();
  84 | 			}
  85 | 		},
  86 | 		[scrollPrev, scrollNext]
  87 | 	);
  88 |
  89 | 	React.useEffect(() => {
  90 | 		if (!api || !setApi) return;
  91 | 		setApi(api);
  92 | 	}, [api, setApi]);
  93 |
  94 | 	React.useEffect(() => {
  95 | 		if (!api) return;
  96 | 		onSelect(api);
  97 | 		api.on("reInit", onSelect);
  98 | 		api.on("select", onSelect);
  99 |
 100 | 		return () => {
 101 | 			api?.off("select", onSelect);
 102 | 		};
 103 | 	}, [api, onSelect]);
 104 |
 105 | 	return (
 106 | 		<CarouselContext.Provider
 107 | 			value={{
 108 | 				carouselRef,
 109 | 				api: api,
 110 | 				opts,
 111 | 				orientation: orientation || (opts?.axis === "y" ? "vertical" : "horizontal"),
 112 | 				scrollPrev,
 113 | 				scrollNext,
 114 | 				canScrollPrev,
 115 | 				canScrollNext
 116 | 			}}
 117 | 		>
 118 | 			<div
 119 | 				aria-roledescription='carousel'
 120 | 				className={cn("relative", className)}
 121 | 				data-slot='carousel'
 122 | 				onKeyDownCapture={handleKeyDown}
 123 | 				role='region'
 124 | 				{...props}
 125 | 			>
 126 | 				{children}
 127 | 			</div>
 128 | 		</CarouselContext.Provider>
 129 | 	);
 130 | }
 131 |
 132 | function CarouselContent({ className, ...props }: React.ComponentProps<"div">) {
 133 | 	const { carouselRef, orientation } = useCarousel();
 134 |
 135 | 	return (
 136 | 		<div
 137 | 			className='overflow-hidden'
 138 | 			data-slot='carousel-content'
 139 | 			ref={carouselRef}
 140 | 		>
 141 | 			<div
 142 | 				className={cn("flex", orientation === "horizontal" ? "-ml-4" : "-mt-4 flex-col", className)}
 143 | 				{...props}
 144 | 			/>
 145 | 		</div>
 146 | 	);
 147 | }
 148 |
 149 | function CarouselItem({ className, ...props }: React.ComponentProps<"div">) {
 150 | 	const { orientation } = useCarousel();
 151 |
 152 | 	return (
 153 | 		<div
 154 | 			aria-roledescription='slide'
 155 | 			className={cn(
 156 | 				"min-w-0 shrink-0 grow-0 basis-full",
 157 | 				orientation === "horizontal" ? "pl-4" : "pt-4",
 158 | 				className
 159 | 			)}
 160 | 			data-slot='carousel-item'
 161 | 			role='group'
 162 | 			{...props}
 163 | 		/>
 164 | 	);
 165 | }
 166 |
 167 | function CarouselPrevious({
 168 | 	className,
 169 | 	variant = "outline",
```

```tsx
 107 | function ChartTooltipContent({
 108 | 	active,
 109 | 	payload,

 126 | 		nameKey?: string;

 242 | function ChartLegendContent({
 243 | 	className,
 244 | 	hideIcon = false,
 245 | 	payload,
 246 | 	verticalAlign = "bottom",
 247 | 	nameKey
 248 | }: React.ComponentProps<"div"> & {
 249 | 	hideIcon?: boolean;
 250 | 	nameKey?: string;
 251 | } & RechartsPrimitive.DefaultLegendContentProps) {
 252 | 	const { config } = useChart();
 253 |
 254 | 	if (!payload?.length) {
 255 | 		return null;
 256 | 	}
 257 |
 258 | 	return (
 259 | 		<div
 260 | 			className={cn(
 261 | 				"flex items-center justify-center gap-4",
 262 | 				verticalAlign === "top" ? "pb-3" : "pt-3",
 263 | 				className
 264 | 			)}
 265 | 		>
 266 | 			{payload
 267 | 				.filter(item => item.type !== "none")
 268 | 				.map((item, index) => {
 269 | 					const key = `${nameKey ?? item.dataKey ?? "value"}`;
 270 | 					const itemConfig = getPayloadConfigFromPayload(config, item, key);
 271 |
 272 | 					return (
 273 | 						<div
 274 | 							className={cn(
 275 | 								"flex items-center gap-1.5 [&>svg]:h-3 [&>svg]:w-3 [&>svg]:text-muted-foreground"
 276 | 							)}
 277 | 							key={index}
 278 | 						>
 279 | 							{itemConfig?.icon && !hideIcon ? (
 280 | 								<itemConfig.icon />
 281 | 							) : (
 282 | 								<div
 283 | 									className='h-2 w-2 shrink-0 rounded-[2px]'
 284 | 									style={{
 285 | 										backgroundColor: item.color
 286 | 									}}
 287 | 								/>
 288 | 							)}
 289 | 							{itemConfig?.label}
 290 | 						</div>
 291 | 					);
 292 | 				})}
 293 | 		</div>
 294 | 	);
 295 | }
 296 |
 297 | // Helper to extract item config from a payload.
 298 | function getPayloadConfigFromPayload(config: ChartConfig, payload: unknown, key: string) {
 299 | 	if (typeof payload !== "object" || payload === null) {
 300 | 		return undefined;
 301 | 	}
 302 |
 303 | 	const payloadPayload =
 304 | 		"payload" in payload && typeof payload.payload === "object" && payload.payload !== null
 305 | 			? payload.payload
 306 | 			: undefined;
 307 |
 308 | 	let configLabelKey: string = key;
 309 |
 310 | 	if (key in payload && typeof payload[key as keyof typeof payload] === "string") {
 311 | 		configLabelKey = payload[key as keyof typeof payload] as string;
 312 | 	} else if (
 313 | 		payloadPayload &&
 314 | 		key in payloadPayload &&
 315 | 		typeof payloadPayload[key as keyof typeof payloadPayload] === "string"
 316 | 	) {
 317 | 		configLabelKey = payloadPayload[key as keyof typeof payloadPayload] as string;
 318 | 	}
 319 |
 320 | 	return configLabelKey in config ? config[configLabelKey] : config[key];
 321 | }
```

```tsx
 171 |
 172 | function FieldError({
 173 | 	className,
 174 | 	children,
 175 | 	errors,
 176 | 	...props
 177 | }: React.ComponentProps<"div"> & {
 178 | 	errors?: Array<string | { message?: string } | undefined>;
 179 | }) {
 180 | 	const content = useMemo(() => {
 181 | 		if (children) {
 182 | 			return children;
 183 | 		}
 184 |
 185 | 		if (!errors?.length) {
 186 | 			return null;
 187 | 		}
 188 |
 189 | 		// Normalize errors to strings, handling both string and {message} formats
 190 | 		const messages = errors
 191 | 			.map(error => {
 192 | 				if (typeof error === "string") return error;
 193 | 				return error?.message;
 194 | 			})
 195 | 			.filter(Boolean) as string[];
 196 |
 197 | 		const uniqueMessages = Array.from(new Set(messages));
 198 |
 199 | 		if (uniqueMessages.length === 1) {
 200 | 			return uniqueMessages[0];
 201 | 		}
 202 |
 203 | 		return (
 204 | 			<ul className='ml-4 flex list-disc flex-col gap-1'>
 205 | 				{uniqueMessages.map((msg, index) => (
 206 | 					<li key={index}>{msg}</li>
 207 | 				))}
 208 | 			</ul>
 209 | 		);
 210 | 	}, [children, errors]);
 211 |
 212 | 	if (!content) {
 213 | 		return null;
 214 | 	}
 215 |
 216 | 	return (
 217 | 		<div
 218 | 			className={cn("font-normal text-destructive text-sm", className)}
 219 | 			data-slot='field-error'
 220 | 			role='alert'
 221 | 			{...props}
 222 | 		>
 223 | 			{content}
 224 | 		</div>
 225 | 	);
 226 | }
 227 |
```

 118 | function Field({ children, ...props }: React.ComponentProps<"div"> & VariantProps<typeof fieldVariants>) {
 119 | 	const { errors, formItemId, formDescriptionId, formMessageId, store } = useFieldContext();
 120 | 	const form = useFormContext();
 121 | 	const isTouched = useStore(store, state => state.meta.isTouched);
 122 | 	// Show errors after user interaction OR after first submit attempt
 123 | 	const hasSubmitted = useStore(form.store, s => s.submissionAttempts > 0);
 124 | 	const hasVisibleErrors = !!errors.length && (isTouched || hasSubmitted);
 125 |
 126 | 	return (

 131 | 			id={formItemId}
 132 | 			{...props}
 133 | 		>

 195 | /**
 196 |  * Renders form-level validation errors (cross-field errors).
 197 |  * Place inside form.AppForm to show errors from form-level validators.
 198 |  *
 199 |  * @example
 200 |  * ```tsx
 201 |  * <form.AppForm>

 206 |  * </form.AppForm>
 207 |  * ```

 209 | function FormErrors({ className, ...props }: React.ComponentProps<"div">) {
 210 | 	const form = useFormContext();
 211 | 	return (
 212 | 		<form.Subscribe selector={state => state.errors}>
 213 | 			{errors => {
 214 | 				if (!errors.length) return null;
 215 | 				return (
 216 | 					<div
 217 | 						className={cn("rounded-md border bg-destructive/10 p-3 text-destructive text-sm", className)}
 218 | 						role='alert'
 219 | 						{...props}
 220 | 					>
 221 | 						<ul className='list-disc space-y-1 pl-4'>
 222 | 							{errors.map((error, i) => (
 223 | 								<li key={i}>{String(error)}</li>
 224 | 							))}
 225 | 						</ul>
 226 | 					</div>
 227 | 				);
 228 | 			}}
 229 | 		</form.Subscribe>
 230 | 	);

 233 | /**
 234 |  * Scrolls to the first field with a validation error.
 235 |  * Call after a failed form.handleSubmit() to guide the user to the problem.
 236 |  *
 237 |  * @example
 238 |  * ```tsx
 239 |  * onSubmit: ({ value }) => { ... },
 240 |  * onSubmitInvalid: () => scrollToFirstError(),
 241 |  * ```
 242 |  */
 243 | function scrollToFirstError() {
 244 | 	// Fields with errors have data-invalid="true" set by the FormField component
 245 | 	requestAnimationFrame(() => {
 246 | 		const firstError = document.querySelector('[data-invalid="true"]');
 247 | 		if (firstError) {
 248 | 			firstError.scrollIntoView({ behavior: "smooth", block: "center" });
 249 | 			// Focus the first focusable element within the error field
 250 | 			const focusable = firstError.querySelector<HTMLElement>("input, textarea, select, button, [tabindex]");
 251 | 			focusable?.focus({ preventScroll: true });
 252 | 		}
 253 | 	});
 254 | }
 255 |
 256 | // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
 257 | // 4. Field-level configuration types
 258 | //
 259 | //    These mirror TanStack Form's field options that get forwarded to
 260 | //    form.Field when using the flat FormXxxField pattern via createFormField.
 261 | //    Validator values accept Zod schemas (StandardSchemaV1) or plain functions.
 262 | // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
 263 |
 264 | /** Field-level validators forwarded to form.Field */
 265 | interface FieldValidatorConfig {
 266 | 	/** Sync validator — runs on every value change. Accepts a function or Zod schema. */
 267 | 	onChange?: unknown;
 268 | 	/** Async validator — runs on value change (debounced). */
 269 | 	onChangeAsync?: unknown;
 270 | 	/** Debounce (ms) for onChangeAsync. */
 271 | 	onChangeAsyncDebounceMs?: number;
 272 | 	/** Re-run onChange/onChangeAsync when these other fields change (linked validation). */
 273 | 	onChangeListenTo?: string[];
 274 | 	/** Sync validator — runs when the field loses focus. Accepts a function or Zod schema. */
 275 | 	onBlur?: unknown;
 276 | 	/** Async validator — runs on blur. */
 277 | 	onBlurAsync?: unknown;
 278 | 	/** Debounce (ms) for onBlurAsync. */
 279 | 	onBlurAsyncDebounceMs?: number;
 280 | 	/** Re-run onBlur/onBlurAsync when these other fields blur. */
 281 | 	onBlurListenTo?: string[];
 282 | 	/** Sync validator — runs on form submission. */
 283 | 	onSubmit?: unknown;
 284 | 	/** Async validator — runs on form submission. */
 285 | 	onSubmitAsync?: unknown;
 286 | 	/** Sync validator — runs on field mount. */
 287 | 	onMount?: unknown;
 288 | }
 289 |
 290 | /** Field-level side-effect listeners forwarded to form.Field */
 291 | interface FieldListenerConfig {
 292 | 	/** Fires after the field value changes. Use for side effects (e.g., resetting dependent fields). */
 293 | 	onChange?: (props: { value: unknown; fieldApi: AnyFieldApi }) => void;
 294 | 	/** Debounce (ms) for the onChange listener. */
 295 | 	onChangeDebounceMs?: number;
 296 | 	/** Fires when the field loses focus. */
 297 | 	onBlur?: (props: { value: unknown; fieldApi: AnyFieldApi }) => void;
 298 | 	/** Debounce (ms) for the onBlur listener. */
 299 | 	onBlurDebounceMs?: number;
 300 | 	/** Fires when the field mounts. */
 301 | 	onMount?: (props: { value: unknown; fieldApi: AnyFieldApi }) => void;
 302 | 	/** Fires on form submission. */
 303 | 	onSubmit?: (props: { value: unknown; fieldApi: AnyFieldApi }) => void;
 304 | }
 305 |
 306 | /**
 307 |  * Configuration forwarded to TanStack Form's form.Field component.
 308 |  * Use with createFormField composed components (FormTextField, etc.)
 309 |  * to enable field-level validation, async validation, and side-effect listeners.
 310 |  *
 311 |  * For type-safe field names, use form.AppField render-prop pattern instead.
 312 |  */
 313 | interface FieldConfig {
 314 | 	/** Field-level validators (onBlur, onChange, onSubmit + async variants). */
 315 | 	validators?: FieldValidatorConfig;
 316 | 	/** Default debounce (ms) for all async validators on this field. */
 317 | 	asyncDebounceMs?: number;
 318 | 	/** Side-effect listeners (onChange, onBlur, onMount, onSubmit). */
 319 | 	listeners?: FieldListenerConfig;
 320 | 	/** Set to 'array' for array fields (enables pushValue, removeValue, etc.). */
 321 | 	mode?: "value" | "array";
 322 | 	/** Default value for this field (useful for dynamically added fields). */
 323 | 	defaultValue?: unknown;
 324 | }
 325 |
 326 | // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
 327 | // 5. createFormField — lifts a field component into a flat form-level component
 328 | //
 329 | //    Forwards TanStack Form's field-level config (validators, listeners)
 330 | //    to form.Field while keeping the ergonomic flat API.
 331 | //
 332 | //    For type-safe field names, use form.AppField render-prop pattern.
 333 | //    The flat FormXxxField pattern trades name type-safety for ergonomics.
 334 | // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
 335 |
 336 | type FormFieldSlot = React.ComponentType<{
 337 | 	name: string;
 338 | 	validators?: FieldValidatorConfig;
 339 | 	asyncDebounceMs?: number;
 340 | 	listeners?: FieldListenerConfig;
 341 | 	mode?: "value" | "array";
 342 | 	defaultValue?: unknown;
 343 | 	children: (fieldApi: AnyFieldApi) => React.ReactNode;
 344 | }>;
 345 |
 346 | function createFormField<P extends object>(FieldComponent: React.ComponentType<P>) {
 347 | 	function ComposedFormField({
 348 | 		name,
 349 | 		validators,
 350 | 		asyncDebounceMs,
 351 | 		listeners,
 352 | 		mode,
 353 | 		defaultValue,
 354 | 		...props
 355 | 	}: { name: string } & FieldConfig &
 356 | 		Omit<P, "name" | "validators" | "asyncDebounceMs" | "listeners" | "mode" | "defaultValue">) {
 357 | 		const form = useFormContext();
 358 | 		const FieldSlot = form.Field as unknown as FormFieldSlot;
 359 | 		return (
 360 | 			<FieldSlot
 361 | 				asyncDebounceMs={asyncDebounceMs}
 362 | 				defaultValue={defaultValue}
 363 | 				listeners={listeners}
 364 | 				mode={mode}
 365 | 				name={name}
 366 | 				validators={validators}
 367 | 			>
 368 | 				{fieldApi => (
 369 | 					<fieldContext.Provider value={fieldApi}>
 370 | 						<FieldComponent {...(props as unknown as P)} />
 371 | 					</fieldContext.Provider>
 372 | 				)}
 373 | 			</FieldSlot>
 374 | 		);
 375 | 	}
 376 | 	ComposedFormField.displayName = `FormField(${FieldComponent.displayName || FieldComponent.name})`;
 377 | 	return ComposedFormField;
 378 | }

 447 | // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
 448 | // 6. Type-safe field name utilities
 449 | //
 450 | //    Standalone FormXxxField components have `name: string` by default because
 451 | //    they don't know which form they'll be used in at definition time.
 452 | //
 453 | //    These utilities narrow `name` to the form's actual field paths using
 454 | //    TanStack Form's DeepKeys<TValues>, giving full autocomplete + type errors.
 455 | // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
 456 |
 457 | /**
 458 |  * Narrows a composed field component's `name` prop to `DeepKeys<TValues>`.
 459 |  * Used internally by useFormFields and typedField.
 460 |  */
 461 | type WithTypedName<C, TValues> =
 462 | 	C extends React.ComponentType<infer P>
 463 | 		? P extends { name: string }
 464 | 			? React.ComponentType<Omit<P, "name"> & { name: DeepKeys<TValues> & string }>
 465 | 			: C
 466 | 		: C;
 467 |
 468 | /**
 469 |  * Narrows any single composed field component's `name` prop to type-safe field paths.
 470 |  * Use for custom fields not included in useFormFields.
 471 |  *
 472 |  * @example
 473 |  * ```tsx
 474 |  * const narrow = typedField<MyFormValues>();
 475 |  * const TypedDatePicker = narrow(FormDatePickerField);
 476 |  * <TypedDatePicker name="birthDate" />  // ✅ type-safe
 477 |  * ```
 478 |  */
 479 | function typedField<TValues extends Record<string, unknown>>() {
 480 | 	return function <C extends React.ComponentType<{ name: string }>>(Component: C): WithTypedName<C, TValues> {
 481 | 		return Component as WithTypedName<C, TValues>;
 482 | 	};
 483 | }
 484 |
 485 | // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
 486 | // 7. Exports
 487 | // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
 488 |
 489 | export type { FieldConfig, FieldListenerConfig, FieldValidatorConfig, WithTypedName };
 490 | export {
 491 | 	createFormField,
 492 | 	DateField,
 493 | 	Field as FormField,
 494 | 	FieldError as FormFieldError,
 495 | 	FieldSet as FormFieldSet,
 496 | 	FormErrors,
 497 | 	fieldContext,
 498 | 	formContext,

 502 | 	scrollToFirstError,
 503 | 	TextArea,
 504 | 	TimeField,
 505 | 	typedField,
 506 | 	useFieldContext,
 507 | 	useFormContext
 508 | };

`components/ui/info-button.tsx`:

```tsx
   1 | import * as React from "react";
   2 |
   3 | import { Icons } from "#/components/icons";
   4 | import { Button } from "#/components/ui/button";
   5 | import { type InfobarContent, useInfobar } from "#/components/ui/infobar";
   6 | import { cn } from "#/lib/utils";
   7 |
   8 | interface InfoButtonProps extends Omit<React.ComponentProps<typeof Button>, "content"> {
   9 | 	content: InfobarContent;
  10 | 	variant?: "default" | "ghost" | "outline" | "secondary" | "destructive" | "link";
  11 | 	size?: "default" | "sm" | "lg" | "icon";
  12 | }
  13 |
  14 | export function InfoButton({ content, className, variant = "ghost", size = "icon", ...props }: InfoButtonProps) {
  15 | 	const { setContent, setOpen } = useInfobar();
  16 |
  17 | 	// Set content on mount so the infobar has it ready, but don't force it open
  18 | 	const contentRef = React.useRef(content);
  19 | 	contentRef.current = content;
  20 |
  21 | 	React.useEffect(() => {
  22 | 		setContent(contentRef.current);
  23 | 	}, [setContent]); // eslint-disable-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
  24 |
  25 | 	const handleClick = (e: React.MouseEvent<HTMLButtonElement>) => {
  26 | 		setContent(content);
  27 | 		setOpen(true);
  28 | 		props.onClick?.(e);
  29 | 	};
  30 |
  31 | 	return (
  32 | 		<Button
  33 | 			aria-label='Show information'
  34 | 			className={cn("shrink-0", className)}
  35 | 			onClick={handleClick}
  36 | 			size={size}
  37 | 			variant={variant}
  38 | 			{...props}
  39 | 		>
  40 | 			<Icons.info className='h-4 w-4' />
  41 | 			<span className='sr-only'>Show information</span>
  42 | 		</Button>
  43 | 	);
  44 | }
```

```tsx
  15 |
  16 | const INFOBAR_WIDTH = "22rem";
  17 | const INFOBAR_WIDTH_MOBILE = "22rem";
  18 | const INFOBAR_WIDTH_ICON = "3rem";
  19 | const INFOBAR_KEYBOARD_SHORTCUT = "i";
  20 |
  21 | export type HelpfulLink = {
  22 | 	title: string;
  23 | 	url: string;
  24 | };
  25 |
  26 | export type DescriptiveSection = {
  27 | 	title: string;
  28 | 	description: string;
  29 | 	links?: HelpfulLink[];
  30 | };

  33 | 	title: string;
  34 | 	sections: DescriptiveSection[];
  35 | };
  36 |
  37 | type InfobarContextProps = {
  38 | 	state: "expanded" | "collapsed";
  39 | 	open: boolean;
  40 | 	setOpen: (open: boolean) => void;
  41 | 	openMobile: boolean;
  42 | 	setOpenMobile: (open: boolean) => void;
  43 | 	isMobile: boolean;
  44 | 	toggleInfobar: () => void;
  45 | 	content: InfobarContent | null;
  46 | 	setContent: (content: InfobarContent | null) => void;
  47 | 	isPathnameChanging: boolean;
  48 | };
  49 |
  50 | const InfobarContext = React.createContext<InfobarContextProps | null>(null);
  51 |
  52 | function useInfobar() {
  53 | 	const context = React.useContext(InfobarContext);
  54 | 	if (!context) {
  55 | 		throw new Error("useInfobar must be used within a InfobarProvider.");
  56 | 	}
  57 |
  58 | 	return context;
  59 | }
  60 |
  61 | function InfobarProvider({
  62 | 	defaultOpen = true,
  63 | 	open: openProp,
  64 | 	onOpenChange: setOpenProp,
  65 | 	className,
  66 | 	style,
  67 | 	children,
  68 | 	...props
  69 | }: React.ComponentProps<"div"> & {
  70 | 	defaultOpen?: boolean;
  71 | 	open?: boolean;
  72 | 	onOpenChange?: (open: boolean) => void;
  73 | }) {
  74 | 	const isMobile = useIsMobile();
  75 | 	const [openMobile, setOpenMobile] = React.useState(false);
  76 | 	const [content, setContent] = React.useState<InfobarContent | null>(null);
  77 | 	const [contentPathname, setContentPathname] = React.useState<string | null>(null);
  78 | 	const [isPathnameChanging, setIsPathnameChanging] = React.useState(false);
  79 | 	const { pathname } = useLocation();
  80 |
  81 | 	// This is the internal state of the infobar.
  82 | 	// We use openProp and setOpenProp for control from outside the component.
  83 | 	const [_open, _setOpen] = React.useState(defaultOpen);
  84 | 	const open = openProp ?? _open;
  85 | 	const setOpen = React.useCallback(
  86 | 		(value: boolean | ((value: boolean) => boolean)) => {
  87 | 			const openState = typeof value === "function" ? value(open) : value;
  88 |
  89 | 			// On mobile, also update the mobile state for the Sheet component
  90 | 			if (isMobile) {
  91 | 				setOpenMobile(openState);
  92 | 			}
  93 |
  94 | 			// Handle desktop state
  95 | 			if (setOpenProp) {
  96 | 				setOpenProp(openState);
  97 | 			} else {
  98 | 				_setOpen(openState);
  99 | 			}
 100 | 		},
 101 | 		[setOpenProp, open, isMobile]
 102 | 	);
 103 |
 104 | 	// Helper to toggle the infobar.
 105 | 	const toggleInfobar = React.useCallback(() => {
 106 | 		return isMobile ? setOpenMobile(open => !open) : setOpen(open => !open);
 107 | 	}, [isMobile, setOpen]);
 108 |
 109 | 	// Close infobar when switching between mobile and desktop to prevent state desync
 110 | 	React.useEffect(() => {
 111 | 		setOpenMobile(false);
 112 | 		_setOpen(false);
 113 | 	}, []);
 114 |
 115 | 	// Adds a keyboard shortcut to toggle the infobar.
 116 | 	React.useEffect(() => {
 117 | 		const handleKeyDown = (event: KeyboardEvent) => {
 118 | 			if (event.key === INFOBAR_KEYBOARD_SHORTCUT && (event.metaKey || event.ctrlKey)) {
 119 | 				event.preventDefault();
 120 | 				toggleInfobar();
 121 | 			}
 122 | 		};
 123 |
 124 | 		window.addEventListener("keydown", handleKeyDown);
 125 | 		return () => window.removeEventListener("keydown", handleKeyDown);
 126 | 	}, [toggleInfobar]);
 127 |
 128 | 	// Clear content and close infobar when pathname changes
 129 | 	React.useEffect(() => {
 130 | 		if (contentPathname !== null && contentPathname !== pathname) {
 131 | 			setIsPathnameChanging(true);
 132 | 			setContent(null);
 133 | 			setContentPathname(null);
 134 | 			setOpen(false);
 135 |
 136 | 			const timer = setTimeout(() => {
 137 | 				setIsPathnameChanging(false);
 138 | 			}, 200);
 139 |
 140 | 			return () => clearTimeout(timer);
 141 | 		}
 142 | 		// eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps -- setOpen is a stable React state setter
 143 | 	}, [pathname, contentPathname, setOpen]);
 144 |
 145 | 	// Update setContent to also track pathname
 146 | 	const handleSetContent = React.useCallback(
 147 | 		(newContent: InfobarContent | null) => {
 148 | 			setContent(newContent);
 149 | 			setContentPathname(newContent ? pathname : null);
 150 | 		},
 151 | 		[pathname]
 152 | 	);
 153 |
 154 | 	// We add a state so that we can do data-state="expanded" or "collapsed".
 155 | 	// This makes it easier to style the infobar with Tailwind classes.
 156 | 	const state = open ? "expanded" : "collapsed";
 157 |
 158 | 	// Update context to use handleSetContent instead of setContent
 159 | 	const contextValue = React.useMemo<InfobarContextProps>(
 160 | 		() => ({
 161 | 			state,
 162 | 			open,
 163 | 			setOpen,
 164 | 			isMobile,
 165 | 			openMobile,
 166 | 			setOpenMobile,
 167 | 			toggleInfobar,
 168 | 			content,
 169 | 			setContent: handleSetContent,
 170 | 			isPathnameChanging
 171 | 		}),
 172 | 		[state, open, setOpen, isMobile, openMobile, toggleInfobar, content, handleSetContent, isPathnameChanging]
 173 | 	);
 174 |
 175 | 	return (
 176 | 		<InfobarContext.Provider value={contextValue}>
 177 | 			<TooltipProvider delayDuration={0}>
 178 | 				<div
 179 | 					className={cn("group/infobar-wrapper flex w-full flex-1", className)}
 180 | 					data-slot='infobar-wrapper'
 181 | 					style={
 182 | 						{
 183 | 							"--infobar-width": INFOBAR_WIDTH,
 184 | 							"--infobar-width-icon": INFOBAR_WIDTH_ICON,
 185 | 							...style
 186 | 						} as React.CSSProperties
 187 | 					}
 188 | 					{...props}
 189 | 				>
 190 | 					{children}
 191 | 				</div>
 192 | 			</TooltipProvider>
 193 | 		</InfobarContext.Provider>
 194 | 	);
 195 | }
```

```tsx
  48 |
  49 | const directions: string[] = [KeyboardCode.Down, KeyboardCode.Right, KeyboardCode.Up, KeyboardCode.Left];
  50 |
  51 | const coordinateGetter: KeyboardCoordinateGetter = (event, { context }) => {
  52 | 	const { active, droppableRects, droppableContainers, collisionRect } = context;
  53 |
  54 | 	if (directions.includes(event.code)) {
  55 | 		event.preventDefault();
  56 |
  57 | 		if (!active || !collisionRect) return;
  58 |
  59 | 		const filteredContainers: DroppableContainer[] = [];
  60 |
  61 | 		for (const entry of droppableContainers.getEnabled()) {
  62 | 			if (!entry || entry?.disabled) return;
  63 |
  64 | 			const rect = droppableRects.get(entry.id);
  65 |
  66 | 			if (!rect) return;
  67 |
  68 | 			const data = entry.data.current;
  69 |
  70 | 			if (data) {
  71 | 				const { type, children } = data;
  72 |
  73 | 				if (type === "container" && children?.length > 0) {
  74 | 					if (active.data.current?.type !== "container") {
  75 | 						return;
  76 | 					}
  77 | 				}
  78 | 			}
  79 |
  80 | 			switch (event.code) {
  81 | 				case KeyboardCode.Down:
  82 | 					if (collisionRect.top < rect.top) {
  83 | 						filteredContainers.push(entry);
  84 | 					}
  85 | 					break;
  86 | 				case KeyboardCode.Up:
  87 | 					if (collisionRect.top > rect.top) {
  88 | 						filteredContainers.push(entry);
  89 | 					}
  90 | 					break;
  91 | 				case KeyboardCode.Left:
  92 | 					if (collisionRect.left >= rect.left + rect.width) {
  93 | 						filteredContainers.push(entry);
  94 | 					}
  95 | 					break;
  96 | 				case KeyboardCode.Right:
  97 | 					if (collisionRect.left + collisionRect.width <= rect.left) {
  98 | 						filteredContainers.push(entry);
  99 | 					}
 100 | 					break;
 101 | 			}
 102 | 		}
 103 |
 104 | 		const collisions = closestCorners({
 105 | 			active,
 106 | 			collisionRect: collisionRect,
 107 | 			droppableRects,
 108 | 			droppableContainers: filteredContainers,
 109 | 			pointerCoordinates: null
 110 | 		});
 111 | 		const closestId = getFirstCollision(collisions, "id");
 112 |
 113 | 		if (closestId != null) {
 114 | 			const newDroppable = droppableContainers.get(closestId);
 115 | 			const newNode = newDroppable?.node.current;
 116 | 			const newRect = newDroppable?.rect.current;
 117 |
 118 | 			if (newNode && newRect) {
 119 | 				if (newDroppable.id === "placeholder") {
 120 | 					return {
 121 | 						x: newRect.left + (newRect.width - collisionRect.width) / 2,
 122 | 						y: newRect.top + (newRect.height - collisionRect.height) / 2
 123 | 					};
 124 | 				}
 125 |
 126 | 				if (newDroppable.data.current?.type === "container") {
 127 | 					return {
 128 | 						x: newRect.left + 20,
 129 | 						y: newRect.top + 74
 130 | 					};
 131 | 				}
 132 |
 133 | 				return {
 134 | 					x: newRect.left,
 135 | 					y: newRect.top
 136 | 				};
 137 | 			}
 138 | 		}
 139 | 	}
 140 |
 141 | 	return undefined;
 142 | };
```
