```tsx
 144 | const ROOT_NAME = "Kanban";
 145 | const BOARD_NAME = "KanbanBoard";
 146 | const COLUMN_NAME = "KanbanColumn";
 147 | const COLUMN_HANDLE_NAME = "KanbanColumnHandle";
 148 | const ITEM_NAME = "KanbanItem";
 149 | const ITEM_HANDLE_NAME = "KanbanItemHandle";
 150 | const OVERLAY_NAME = "KanbanOverlay";
 151 |
 152 | interface KanbanContextValue<T> {
 153 | 	id: string;
 154 | 	items: Record<UniqueIdentifier, T[]>;
 155 | 	modifiers: DndContextProps["modifiers"];
 156 | 	strategy: SortableContextProps["strategy"];
 157 | 	orientation: "horizontal" | "vertical";
 158 | 	activeId: UniqueIdentifier | null;
 159 | 	setActiveId: (id: UniqueIdentifier | null) => void;
 160 | 	getItemValue: (item: T) => UniqueIdentifier;
 161 | 	flatCursor: boolean;
 162 | }
 163 |
 164 | const KanbanContext = React.createContext<KanbanContextValue<unknown> | null>(null);
 165 |
 166 | function useKanbanContext(consumerName: string) {
 167 | 	const context = React.useContext(KanbanContext);
 168 | 	if (!context) {
 169 | 		throw new Error(`\`${consumerName}\` must be used within \`${ROOT_NAME}\``);
 170 | 	}
 171 | 	return context;
 172 | }
 173 |
 174 | interface GetItemValue<T> {
 175 | 	/**
 176 | 	 * Callback that returns a unique identifier for each kanban item. Required for array of objects.
 177 | 	 * @example getItemValue={(item) => item.id}
 178 | 	 */
 179 | 	getItemValue: (item: T) => UniqueIdentifier;
 180 | }
 181 |
 182 | type KanbanProps<T> = Omit<DndContextProps, "collisionDetection"> &
 183 | 	(T extends object ? GetItemValue<T> : Partial<GetItemValue<T>>) & {
 184 | 		value: Record<UniqueIdentifier, T[]>;
 185 | 		onValueChange?: (columns: Record<UniqueIdentifier, T[]>) => void;
 186 | 		onMove?: (event: DragEndEvent & { activeIndex: number; overIndex: number }) => void;
 187 | 		strategy?: SortableContextProps["strategy"];
 188 | 		orientation?: "horizontal" | "vertical";
 189 | 		flatCursor?: boolean;
 190 | 	};
 191 |
 192 | function Kanban<T>(props: KanbanProps<T>) {
 193 | 	const {
 194 | 		value,
 195 | 		onValueChange,
 196 | 		modifiers,
 197 | 		strategy = verticalListSortingStrategy,
 198 | 		orientation = "horizontal",
 199 | 		onMove,
 200 | 		getItemValue: getItemValueProp,
 201 | 		accessibility,
 202 | 		flatCursor = false,
 203 | 		...kanbanProps
 204 | 	} = props;
 205 |
 206 | 	const id = React.useId();
 207 | 	const [activeId, setActiveId] = React.useState<UniqueIdentifier | null>(null);
 208 | 	const lastOverIdRef = React.useRef<UniqueIdentifier | null>(null);
 209 | 	const hasMovedRef = React.useRef(false);
 210 | 	const sensors = useSensors(
 211 | 		useSensor(MouseSensor),
 212 | 		useSensor(TouchSensor),
 213 | 		useSensor(KeyboardSensor, {
 214 | 			coordinateGetter
 215 | 		})
 216 | 	);
 217 |
 218 | 	const getItemValue = React.useCallback(
 219 | 		(item: T): UniqueIdentifier => {
 220 | 			if (typeof item === "object" && !getItemValueProp) {
 221 | 				throw new Error("`getItemValue` is required when using array of objects");
 222 | 			}
 223 | 			return getItemValueProp ? getItemValueProp(item) : (item as UniqueIdentifier);
 224 | 		},
 225 | 		[getItemValueProp]
 226 | 	);
 227 |
 228 | 	const getColumn = React.useCallback(
 229 | 		(id: UniqueIdentifier) => {
 230 | 			if (id in value) return id;
 231 |
 232 | 			for (const [columnId, items] of Object.entries(value)) {
 233 | 				if (items.some(item => getItemValue(item) === id)) {
 234 | 					return columnId;
 235 | 				}
 236 | 			}
 237 |
 238 | 			return null;
 239 | 		},
 240 | 		[value, getItemValue]
 241 | 	);
 242 |
 243 | 	const collisionDetection: CollisionDetection = React.useCallback(
 244 | 		args => {
 245 | 			if (activeId && activeId in value) {
 246 | 				return closestCenter({
 247 | 					...args,
 248 | 					droppableContainers: args.droppableContainers.filter(container => container.id in value)
 249 | 				});
 250 | 			}
 251 |
 252 | 			const pointerIntersections = pointerWithin(args);
 253 | 			const intersections = pointerIntersections.length > 0 ? pointerIntersections : rectIntersection(args);
 254 | 			let overId = getFirstCollision(intersections, "id");
 255 |
 256 | 			if (!overId) {
 257 | 				if (hasMovedRef.current) {
 258 | 					lastOverIdRef.current = activeId;
 259 | 				}
 260 | 				return lastOverIdRef.current ? [{ id: lastOverIdRef.current }] : [];
 261 | 			}
 262 |
 263 | 			if (overId in value) {
 264 | 				const containerItems = value[overId];
 265 | 				if (containerItems && containerItems.length > 0) {
 266 | 					const closestItem = closestCenter({
 267 | 						...args,
 268 | 						droppableContainers: args.droppableContainers.filter(
 269 | 							container =>
 270 | 								container.id !== overId &&
 271 | 								containerItems.some(item => getItemValue(item) === container.id)
 272 | 						)
 273 | 					});
 274 |
 275 | 					if (closestItem.length > 0) {
 276 | 						overId = closestItem[0]?.id ?? overId;
 277 | 					}
 278 | 				}
 279 | 			}
 280 |
 281 | 			lastOverIdRef.current = overId;
 282 | 			return [{ id: overId }];
 283 | 		},
 284 | 		[activeId, value, getItemValue]
 285 | 	);
 286 |
 287 | 	const onDragStart = React.useCallback(
 288 | 		(event: DragStartEvent) => {
 289 | 			kanbanProps.onDragStart?.(event);
 290 |
 291 | 			if (event.activatorEvent.defaultPrevented) return;
 292 | 			setActiveId(event.active.id);
 293 | 		},
 294 | 		// eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps -- kanbanProps is unstable object ref, using specific prop
 295 | 		[kanbanProps.onDragStart]
 296 | 	);
 297 |
 298 | 	const onDragOver = React.useCallback(
 299 | 		(event: DragOverEvent) => {
 300 | 			kanbanProps.onDragOver?.(event);
 301 |
 302 | 			if (event.activatorEvent.defaultPrevented) return;
 303 |
 304 | 			const { active, over } = event;
 305 | 			if (!over) return;
 306 |
 307 | 			const activeColumn = getColumn(active.id);
 308 | 			const overColumn = getColumn(over.id);
 309 |
 310 | 			if (!activeColumn || !overColumn) return;
 311 |
 312 | 			if (activeColumn === overColumn) {
 313 | 				const items = value[activeColumn];
 314 | 				if (!items) return;
 315 |
 316 | 				const activeIndex = items.findIndex(item => getItemValue(item) === active.id);
 317 | 				const overIndex = items.findIndex(item => getItemValue(item) === over.id);
 318 |
 319 | 				if (activeIndex !== overIndex) {
 320 | 					const newColumns = { ...value };
 321 | 					newColumns[activeColumn] = arrayMove(items, activeIndex, overIndex);
 322 | 					onValueChange?.(newColumns);
 323 | 				}
 324 | 			} else {
 325 | 				const activeItems = value[activeColumn];
 326 | 				const overItems = value[overColumn];
 327 |
 328 | 				if (!activeItems || !overItems) return;
 329 |
 330 | 				const activeIndex = activeItems.findIndex(item => getItemValue(item) === active.id);
 331 |
 332 | 				if (activeIndex === -1) return;
 333 |
 334 | 				const activeItem = activeItems[activeIndex];
 335 | 				if (!activeItem) return;
 336 |
 337 | 				const updatedItems = {
 338 | 					...value,
 339 | 					[activeColumn]: activeItems.filter(item => getItemValue(item) !== active.id),
 340 | 					[overColumn]: [...overItems, activeItem]
 341 | 				};
 342 |
 343 | 				onValueChange?.(updatedItems);
 344 | 				hasMovedRef.current = true;
 345 | 			}
 346 | 		},
 347 | 		// eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps -- kanbanProps is unstable object ref, using specific prop
 348 | 		[value, getColumn, getItemValue, onValueChange, kanbanProps.onDragOver]
 349 | 	);
 350 |
 351 | 	const onDragEnd = React.useCallback(
 352 | 		(event: DragEndEvent) => {
 353 | 			kanbanProps.onDragEnd?.(event);
 354 |
 355 | 			if (event.activatorEvent.defaultPrevented) return;
 356 |
 357 | 			const { active, over } = event;
 358 |
 359 | 			if (!over) {
 360 | 				setActiveId(null);
 361 | 				return;
 362 | 			}
 363 |
 364 | 			if (active.id in value && over.id in value) {
 365 | 				const activeIndex = Object.keys(value).indexOf(active.id as string);
 366 | 				const overIndex = Object.keys(value).indexOf(over.id as string);
 367 |
 368 | 				if (activeIndex !== overIndex) {
 369 | 					const orderedColumns = Object.keys(value);
 370 | 					const newOrder = arrayMove(orderedColumns, activeIndex, overIndex);
 371 |
 372 | 					const newColumns: Record<UniqueIdentifier, T[]> = {};
 373 | 					for (const key of newOrder) {
 374 | 						const items = value[key];
 375 | 						if (items) {
 376 | 							newColumns[key] = items;
 377 | 						}
 378 | 					}
 379 |
 380 | 					if (onMove) {
 381 | 						onMove({ ...event, activeIndex, overIndex });
 382 | 					} else {
 383 | 						onValueChange?.(newColumns);
 384 | 					}
 385 | 				}
 386 | 			} else {
 387 | 				const activeColumn = getColumn(active.id);
 388 | 				const overColumn = getColumn(over.id);
 389 |
 390 | 				if (!activeColumn || !overColumn) {
 391 | 					setActiveId(null);
 392 | 					return;
 393 | 				}
 394 |
 395 | 				if (activeColumn === overColumn) {
 396 | 					const items = value[activeColumn];
 397 | 					if (!items) {
 398 | 						setActiveId(null);
 399 | 						return;
 400 | 					}
 401 |
 402 | 					const activeIndex = items.findIndex(item => getItemValue(item) === active.id);
 403 | 					const overIndex = items.findIndex(item => getItemValue(item) === over.id);
 404 |
 405 | 					if (activeIndex !== overIndex) {
 406 | 						const newColumns = { ...value };
 407 | 						newColumns[activeColumn] = arrayMove(items, activeIndex, overIndex);
 408 | 						if (onMove) {
 409 | 							onMove({
 410 | 								...event,
 411 | 								activeIndex,
 412 | 								overIndex
 413 | 							});
 414 | 						} else {
 415 | 							onValueChange?.(newColumns);
 416 | 						}
 417 | 					}
 418 | 				}
 419 | 			}
 420 |
 421 | 			setActiveId(null);
 422 | 			hasMovedRef.current = false;
 423 | 		},
 424 | 		// eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps -- kanbanProps is unstable object ref, using specific prop
 425 | 		[value, getColumn, getItemValue, onValueChange, onMove, kanbanProps.onDragEnd]
 426 | 	);
 427 |
 428 | 	const onDragCancel = React.useCallback(
 429 | 		(event: DragCancelEvent) => {
 430 | 			kanbanProps.onDragCancel?.(event);
 431 |
 432 | 			if (event.activatorEvent.defaultPrevented) return;
 433 |
 434 | 			setActiveId(null);
 435 | 			hasMovedRef.current = false;
 436 | 		},
 437 | 		// eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps -- kanbanProps is unstable object ref, using specific prop
 438 | 		[kanbanProps.onDragCancel]
 439 | 	);
 440 |
 441 | 	const announcements: Announcements = React.useMemo(
 442 | 		() => ({
 443 | 			onDragStart({ active }) {
 444 | 				const isColumn = active.id in value;
 445 | 				const itemType = isColumn ? "column" : "item";
 446 | 				const position = isColumn
 447 | 					? Object.keys(value).indexOf(active.id as string) + 1
 448 | 					: (() => {
 449 | 							const column = getColumn(active.id);
 450 | 							if (!column || !value[column]) return 1;
 451 | 							return value[column].findIndex(item => getItemValue(item) === active.id) + 1;
 452 | 						})();
 453 | 				const total = isColumn
 454 | 					? Object.keys(value).length
 455 | 					: (() => {
 456 | 							const column = getColumn(active.id);
 457 | 							return column ? (value[column]?.length ?? 0) : 0;
 458 | 						})();
 459 |
 460 | 				return `Picked up ${itemType} at position ${position} of ${total}`;
 461 | 			},
 462 | 			onDragOver({ active, over }) {
 463 | 				if (!over) return;
 464 |
 465 | 				const isColumn = active.id in value;
 466 | 				const itemType = isColumn ? "column" : "item";
 467 | 				const position = isColumn
 468 | 					? Object.keys(value).indexOf(over.id as string) + 1
 469 | 					: (() => {
 470 | 							const column = getColumn(over.id);
 471 | 							if (!column || !value[column]) return 1;
 472 | 							return value[column].findIndex(item => getItemValue(item) === over.id) + 1;
 473 | 						})();
 474 | 				const total = isColumn
 475 | 					? Object.keys(value).length
 476 | 					: (() => {
 477 | 							const column = getColumn(over.id);
 478 | 							return column ? (value[column]?.length ?? 0) : 0;
 479 | 						})();
 480 |
 481 | 				const overColumn = getColumn(over.id);
 482 | 				const activeColumn = getColumn(active.id);
 483 |
 484 | 				if (isColumn) {
 485 | 					return `${itemType} is now at position ${position} of ${total}`;
 486 | 				}
 487 |
 488 | 				if (activeColumn !== overColumn) {
 489 | 					return `${itemType} is now at position ${position} of ${total} in ${overColumn}`;
 490 | 				}
 491 |
 492 | 				return `${itemType} is now at position ${position} of ${total}`;
 493 | 			},
 494 | 			onDragEnd({ active, over }) {
 495 | 				if (!over) return;
 496 |
 497 | 				const isColumn = active.id in value;
 498 | 				const itemType = isColumn ? "column" : "item";
 499 | 				const position = isColumn
 500 | 					? Object.keys(value).indexOf(over.id as string) + 1
 501 | 					: (() => {
 502 | 							const column = getColumn(over.id);
 503 | 							if (!column || !value[column]) return 1;
 504 | 							return value[column].findIndex(item => getItemValue(item) === over.id) + 1;
 505 | 						})();
 506 | 				const total = isColumn
 507 | 					? Object.keys(value).length
 508 | 					: (() => {
 509 | 							const column = getColumn(over.id);
 510 | 							return column ? (value[column]?.length ?? 0) : 0;
 511 | 						})();
 512 |
 513 | 				const overColumn = getColumn(over.id);
 514 | 				const activeColumn = getColumn(active.id);
 515 |
 516 | 				if (isColumn) {
 517 | 					return `${itemType} was dropped at position ${position} of ${total}`;
 518 | 				}
 519 |
 520 | 				if (activeColumn !== overColumn) {
 521 | 					return `${itemType} was dropped at position ${position} of ${total} in ${overColumn}`;
 522 | 				}
 523 |
 524 | 				return `${itemType} was dropped at position ${position} of ${total}`;
 525 | 			},
 526 | 			onDragCancel({ active }) {
 527 | 				const isColumn = active.id in value;
 528 | 				const itemType = isColumn ? "column" : "item";
 529 | 				return `Dragging was cancelled. ${itemType} was dropped.`;
 530 | 			}
 531 | 		}),
 532 | 		[value, getColumn, getItemValue]
 533 | 	);
 534 |
 535 | 	const contextValue = React.useMemo<KanbanContextValue<T>>(
 536 | 		() => ({
 537 | 			id,
 538 | 			items: value,
 539 | 			modifiers,
 540 | 			strategy,
 541 | 			orientation,
 542 | 			activeId,
 543 | 			setActiveId,
 544 | 			getItemValue,
 545 | 			flatCursor
 546 | 		}),
 547 | 		[id, value, activeId, modifiers, strategy, orientation, getItemValue, flatCursor]
 548 | 	);
 549 |
 550 | 	return (
 551 | 		<KanbanContext.Provider value={contextValue as KanbanContextValue<unknown>}>
 552 | 			<DndContext
 553 | 				collisionDetection={collisionDetection}
 554 | 				modifiers={modifiers}
 555 | 				sensors={sensors}
 556 | 				{...kanbanProps}
 557 | 				accessibility={{
 558 | 					announcements,
 559 | 					screenReaderInstructions: {
 560 | 						draggable: `
 561 |             To pick up a kanban item or column, press space or enter.
 562 |             While dragging, use the arrow keys to move the item.
 563 |             Press space or enter again to drop the item in its new position, or press escape to cancel.
 564 |           `
 565 | 					},
 566 | 					...accessibility
 567 | 				}}
 568 | 				id={id}
 569 | 				measuring={{
 570 | 					droppable: {
 571 | 						strategy: MeasuringStrategy.Always
 572 | 					}
 573 | 				}}
 574 | 				onDragCancel={onDragCancel}
 575 | 				onDragEnd={onDragEnd}
 576 | 				onDragOver={onDragOver}
 577 | 				onDragStart={onDragStart}
 578 | 			/>
 579 | 		</KanbanContext.Provider>
 580 | 	);
 581 | }

 946 | function KanbanOverlay(props: KanbanOverlayProps) {
 947 | 	const { container: containerProp, children, ...overlayProps } = props;
 948 |
 949 | 	const context = useKanbanContext(OVERLAY_NAME);
 950 |

 962 | 		<DragOverlay
 963 | 			className={cn(!context.flatCursor && "cursor-grabbing")}
 964 | 			dropAnimation={dropAnimation}
 965 | 			modifiers={context.modifiers}
 966 | 			{...overlayProps}
 967 | 		>
 968 | 			<KanbanOverlayContext.Provider value={true}>
 969 | 				{context.activeId && children
 970 | 					? typeof children === "function"
 971 | 						? children({
 972 | 								value: context.activeId,
 973 | 								variant
 974 | 							})
 975 | 						: children
 976 | 					: null}
 977 | 			</KanbanOverlayContext.Provider>
 978 | 		</DragOverlay>,
 979 | 		container
 980 | 	);
 981 | }
```

`components/ui/link.tsx`:

```tsx
   1 | import { createLink, type LinkComponent } from "@tanstack/react-router";
   2 | import { forwardRef } from "react";
   3 | import { type AriaLinkOptions, mergeProps, useFocusRing, useHover, useLink, useObjectRef } from "react-aria";
   4 | import { tv } from "tailwind-variants";
   5 |
   6 | import { ring } from "../../lib/utils";
   7 |
   8 | export interface AriaLinkProps extends Omit<AriaLinkOptions, "href"> {
   9 | 	className?: string;
  10 | 	children?: React.ReactNode;
  11 | }
  12 |
  13 | const linkStyles = tv({
  14 | 	extend: ring,
  15 | 	base: ["flex items-center gap-2 text-primary text-sm", "hover:underline"]
  16 | });
  17 |
  18 | const AriaLinkComponent = forwardRef<HTMLAnchorElement, AriaLinkProps>(({ className, ...props }, forwardedRef) => {
  19 | 	const ref = useObjectRef(forwardedRef);
  20 |
  21 | 	const { isPressed, linkProps } = useLink(props, ref);
  22 | 	const { isHovered, hoverProps } = useHover(props);
  23 | 	const { isFocusVisible, isFocused, focusProps } = useFocusRing(props);
  24 |
  25 | 	return (
  26 | 		<a
  27 | 			{...mergeProps(linkProps, hoverProps, focusProps, props)}
  28 | 			className={linkStyles({ className })}
  29 | 			data-focus-visible={isFocusVisible || undefined}
  30 | 			data-focused={isFocused || undefined}
  31 | 			data-hovered={isHovered || undefined}
  32 | 			data-pressed={isPressed || undefined}
  33 | 			ref={ref}
  34 | 		/>
  35 | 	);
  36 | });
  37 |
  38 | AriaLinkComponent.displayName = "AriaLinkComponent";
  39 |
  40 | const CreatedLinkComponent = createLink(AriaLinkComponent);
  41 |
  42 | export const Link: LinkComponent<typeof AriaLinkComponent> = props => {
  43 | 	return (
  44 | 		<CreatedLinkComponent
  45 | 			preload='intent'
  46 | 			{...props}
  47 | 		/>
  48 | 	);
  49 | };
```

`components/ui/notification-card.tsx`:

```tsx
   1 | import type { FC } from "react";
   2 |
   3 | import { Icons } from "#/components/icons";
   4 | import { cn } from "#/lib/utils";
   5 |
   6 | export type NotificationStatus = "unread" | "read" | "archived";
   7 | export type ActionType = "redirect" | "api_call" | "workflow" | "modal";
   8 | export type ActionStyle = "primary" | "danger" | "default";
   9 |
  10 | export interface NotificationAction {
  11 | 	id: string;
  12 | 	label: string;
  13 | 	type: ActionType;
  14 | 	style?: ActionStyle;
  15 | 	executed?: boolean;
  16 | }
  17 |
  18 | export interface NotificationCardProps {
  19 | 	id: string;
  20 | 	title: string;
  21 | 	body: string;
  22 | 	status?: NotificationStatus;
  23 | 	createdAt?: string | Date;
  24 | 	actions?: NotificationAction[];
  25 | 	onMarkAsRead?: (id: string) => void;
  26 | 	onAction?: (notificationId: string, actionId: string, actionType: ActionType) => void;
  27 | 	loadingActionId?: string;
  28 | 	className?: string;
  29 | }
  30 |
  31 | const formatDate = (date: string | Date): string => {
  32 | 	const d = new Date(date);
  33 | 	const now = new Date();
  34 | 	const diffMs = now.getTime() - d.getTime();
  35 | 	const diffMins = Math.floor(diffMs / (1000 * 60));
  36 | 	const diffHours = Math.floor(diffMs / (1000 * 60 * 60));
  37 | 	const diffDays = Math.floor(diffMs / (1000 * 60 * 60 * 24));
  38 |
  39 | 	if (diffMins < 1) return "Just now";
  40 | 	if (diffMins < 60) return `${diffMins}m ago`;
  41 | 	if (diffHours < 24) return `${diffHours}h ago`;
  42 | 	if (diffDays < 7) return `${diffDays}d ago`;
  43 |
  44 | 	return d.toLocaleDateString("en-US", {
  45 | 		month: "short",
  46 | 		day: "numeric"
  47 | 	});
  48 | };
  49 |
  50 | const getActionIcon = (actionType: ActionType) => {
  51 | 	const iconProps = { size: 12, strokeWidth: 2.5 };
  52 | 	switch (actionType) {
  53 | 		case "redirect":
  54 | 			return <Icons.externalLink {...iconProps} />;
  55 | 		case "api_call":
  56 | 			return <Icons.check {...iconProps} />;
  57 | 		case "workflow":
  58 | 			return <Icons.clock {...iconProps} />;
  59 | 		case "modal":
  60 | 			return <Icons.alertCircle {...iconProps} />;
  61 | 		default:
  62 | 			return null;
  63 | 	}
  64 | };
  65 |
  66 | export const NotificationCard: FC<NotificationCardProps> = ({
  67 | 	id,
  68 | 	title,
  69 | 	body,
  70 | 	status = "unread",
  71 | 	createdAt,
  72 | 	actions = [],
  73 | 	onMarkAsRead,
  74 | 	onAction,
  75 | 	loadingActionId,
  76 | 	className
  77 | }) => {
  78 | 	const isUnread = status === "unread";
  79 |
  80 | 	return (
  81 | 		<div
  82 | 			className={cn(
  83 | 				"group relative w-full rounded-2xl transition-all",
  84 | 				isUnread ? "bg-muted" : "bg-muted/40",
  85 | 				className
  86 | 			)}
  87 | 		>
  88 | 			<div className='px-4 py-3.5'>
  89 | 				<div className='flex items-start justify-between gap-3'>
  90 | 					{/* Main content */}
  91 | 					<div className='min-w-0 flex-1 space-y-1'>
  92 | 						{/* Title with unread indicator */}
  93 | 						<div className='flex items-center gap-2'>
  94 | 							<h3
  95 | 								className={cn(
  96 | 									"font-semibold text-[15px] leading-tight",
  97 | 									isUnread ? "text-foreground" : "text-muted-foreground"
  98 | 								)}
  99 | 							>
 100 | 								{title}
 101 | 							</h3>
 102 | 							{isUnread && <div className='h-1.5 w-1.5 flex-shrink-0 rounded-full bg-sky-500' />}
 103 | 						</div>
 104 |
 105 | 						{/* Description */}
 106 | 						<p
 107 | 							className={cn(
 108 | 								"mb-0 text-[13px]",
 109 | 								isUnread ? "text-muted-foreground" : "text-muted-foreground/60"
 110 | 							)}
 111 | 						>
 112 | 							{body}
 113 | 						</p>
 114 | 					</div>
 115 |
 116 | 					{/* Mark as read button */}
 117 | 					{isUnread && onMarkAsRead && (
 118 | 						<button
 119 | 							aria-label='Mark as read'
 120 | 							className={cn(
 121 | 								"rounded-lg p-1.5 transition-colors",
 122 | 								"text-muted-foreground hover:bg-accent hover:text-foreground"
 123 | 							)}
 124 | 							onClick={() => onMarkAsRead(id)}
 125 | 							type='button'
 126 | 						>
 127 | 							<Icons.check size={16} />
 128 | 						</button>
 129 | 					)}
 130 | 				</div>
 131 |
 132 | 				<div className='mt-3 flex items-end justify-between'>
 133 | 					{/* Actions */}
 134 | 					{actions.length > 0 && (
 135 | 						<div className={cn("flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2", !isUnread && "opacity-60")}>
 136 | 							{actions.map(action => {
 137 | 								const isLoading = loadingActionId === action.id;
 138 | 								const isExecuted = action.executed || false;
 139 | 								const showLoading = isLoading && action.type !== "modal";
 140 |
 141 | 								return (
 142 | 									<button
 143 | 										className={cn(
 144 | 											"flex items-center gap-1.5 rounded-lg px-4 py-1.5 font-normal text-xs transition",
 145 | 											action.style === "primary"
 146 | 												? "bg-primary/10 text-primary hover:bg-primary/20"
 147 | 												: action.style === "danger"
 148 | 													? "bg-destructive/10 text-destructive hover:bg-destructive/20"
 149 | 													: "bg-accent text-muted-foreground hover:bg-accent hover:text-foreground",
 150 | 											showLoading && "opacity-50",
 151 | 											isExecuted && "cursor-not-allowed opacity-60"
 152 | 										)}
 153 | 										disabled={isLoading || isExecuted}
 154 | 										key={action.id}
 155 | 										onClick={() => onAction?.(id, action.id, action.type)}
 156 | 										type='button'
 157 | 									>
 158 | 										{showLoading ? (
 159 | 											<Icons.spinner
 160 | 												className='animate-spin'
 161 | 												size={12}
 162 | 											/>
 163 | 										) : (
 164 | 											<>
 165 | 												<span>{action.label}</span>
 166 | 												{isExecuted ? (
 167 | 													<Icons.check
 168 | 														size={12}
 169 | 														strokeWidth={2.5}
 170 | 													/>
 171 | 												) : (
 172 | 													getActionIcon(action.type)
 173 | 												)}
 174 | 											</>
 175 | 										)}
 176 | 									</button>
 177 | 								);
 178 | 							})}
 179 | 						</div>
 180 | 					)}
 181 |
 182 | 					{/* Timestamp */}
 183 | 					{createdAt && (
 184 | 						<span className='inline-block text-[11px] text-muted-foreground/60'>
 185 | 							{formatDate(createdAt)}
 186 | 						</span>
 187 | 					)}
 188 | 				</div>
 189 | 			</div>
 190 | 		</div>
 191 | 	);
 192 | };
```

```tsx
  43 | function SidebarProvider({
  44 | 	defaultOpen = true,
  45 | 	open: openProp,
  46 | 	onOpenChange: setOpenProp,
  47 | 	className,
  48 | 	style,
  49 | 	children,
  50 | 	...props
  51 | }: React.ComponentProps<"div"> & {
  52 | 	defaultOpen?: boolean;
  53 | 	open?: boolean;
  54 | 	onOpenChange?: (open: boolean) => void;
  55 | }) {
  56 | 	const isMobile = useIsMobile();
  57 | 	const [openMobile, setOpenMobile] = React.useState(false);
  58 |
  59 | 	// This is the internal state of the sidebar.
  60 | 	// We use openProp and setOpenProp for control from outside the component.
  61 | 	const [_open, _setOpen] = React.useState(defaultOpen);
  62 | 	const open = openProp ?? _open;
  63 | 	const setOpen = React.useCallback(
  64 | 		(value: boolean | ((value: boolean) => boolean)) => {
  65 | 			const openState = typeof value === "function" ? value(open) : value;
  66 | 			if (setOpenProp) {
  67 | 				setOpenProp(openState);
  68 | 			} else {
  69 | 				_setOpen(openState);
  70 | 			}
  71 |
  72 | 			// This sets the cookie to keep the sidebar state.
  73 | 			document.cookie = `${SIDEBAR_COOKIE_NAME}=${openState}; path=/; max-age=${SIDEBAR_COOKIE_MAX_AGE}`;
  74 | 		},
  75 | 		[setOpenProp, open]
  76 | 	);
  77 |
  78 | 	// Helper to toggle the sidebar.
  79 | 	const toggleSidebar = React.useCallback(() => {
  80 | 		return isMobile ? setOpenMobile(open => !open) : setOpen(open => !open);
  81 | 	}, [isMobile, setOpen]);
  82 |
  83 | 	// Adds a keyboard shortcut to toggle the sidebar.
  84 | 	React.useEffect(() => {
  85 | 		const handleKeyDown = (event: KeyboardEvent) => {
  86 | 			if (event.key === SIDEBAR_KEYBOARD_SHORTCUT && (event.metaKey || event.ctrlKey)) {
  87 | 				event.preventDefault();
  88 | 				toggleSidebar();
  89 | 			}
  90 | 		};
  91 |
  92 | 		window.addEventListener("keydown", handleKeyDown);
  93 | 		return () => window.removeEventListener("keydown", handleKeyDown);
  94 | 	}, [toggleSidebar]);
  95 |
  96 | 	// We add a state so that we can do data-state="expanded" or "collapsed".
  97 | 	// This makes it easier to style the sidebar with Tailwind classes.
  98 | 	const state = open ? "expanded" : "collapsed";

 100 | 	const contextValue = React.useMemo<SidebarContextProps>(
 101 | 		() => ({
 102 | 			state,
 103 | 			open,
 104 | 			setOpen,
 105 | 			isMobile,
 106 | 			openMobile,
 107 | 			setOpenMobile,
 108 | 			toggleSidebar
 109 | 		}),
 110 | 		[state, open, setOpen, isMobile, openMobile, toggleSidebar]
 111 | 	);
 112 |
 113 | 	return (
 114 | 		<SidebarContext.Provider value={contextValue}>
 115 | 			<TooltipProvider delayDuration={0}>
 116 | 				<div
 117 | 					className={cn(
 118 | 						"group/sidebar-wrapper flex min-h-svh w-full has-data-[variant=inset]:bg-sidebar",
 119 | 						className
 120 | 					)}

 128 | 					}
 129 | 					{...props}
 130 | 				>
 131 | 					{children}
```

`components/ui/table/data-table-date-filter.tsx`:

```tsx
   1 | import type { Column } from "@tanstack/react-table";
   2 | import * as React from "react";
   3 | import type { DateRange } from "react-day-picker";
   4 |
   5 | import { Icons } from "#/components/icons";
   6 | import { Button } from "#/components/ui/button";
   7 | import { Calendar } from "#/components/ui/calendar";
   8 | import { Popover, PopoverContent, PopoverTrigger } from "#/components/ui/popover";
   9 | import { Separator } from "#/components/ui/separator";
  10 | import { formatDate } from "#/lib/format";
  11 |
  12 | type DateSelection = Date[] | DateRange;
  13 |
  14 | function getIsDateRange(value: DateSelection): value is DateRange {
  15 | 	return value && typeof value === "object" && !Array.isArray(value);
  16 | }
  17 |
  18 | function parseAsDate(timestamp: number | string | undefined): Date | undefined {
  19 | 	if (!timestamp) return undefined;
  20 | 	const numericTimestamp = typeof timestamp === "string" ? Number(timestamp) : timestamp;
  21 | 	const date = new Date(numericTimestamp);
  22 | 	return !Number.isNaN(date.getTime()) ? date : undefined;
  23 | }
  24 |
  25 | function parseColumnFilterValue(value: unknown) {
  26 | 	if (value === null || value === undefined) {
  27 | 		return [];
  28 | 	}
  29 |
  30 | 	if (Array.isArray(value)) {
  31 | 		return value.map(item => {
  32 | 			if (typeof item === "number" || typeof item === "string") {
  33 | 				return item;
  34 | 			}
  35 | 			return undefined;
  36 | 		});
  37 | 	}
  38 |
  39 | 	if (typeof value === "string" || typeof value === "number") {
  40 | 		return [value];
  41 | 	}
  42 |
  43 | 	return [];
  44 | }
  45 |
  46 | interface DataTableDateFilterProps<TData> {
  47 | 	column: Column<TData, unknown>;
  48 | 	title?: string;
  49 | 	multiple?: boolean;
  50 | }
  51 |
  52 | export function DataTableDateFilter<TData>({ column, title, multiple }: DataTableDateFilterProps<TData>) {
  53 | 	const columnFilterValue = column.getFilterValue();
  54 |
  55 | 	const selectedDates = React.useMemo<DateSelection>(() => {
  56 | 		if (!columnFilterValue) {
  57 | 			return multiple ? { from: undefined, to: undefined } : [];
  58 | 		}
  59 |
  60 | 		if (multiple) {
  61 | 			const timestamps = parseColumnFilterValue(columnFilterValue);
  62 | 			return {
  63 | 				from: parseAsDate(timestamps[0]),
  64 | 				to: parseAsDate(timestamps[1])
  65 | 			};
  66 | 		}
  67 |
  68 | 		const timestamps = parseColumnFilterValue(columnFilterValue);
  69 | 		const date = parseAsDate(timestamps[0]);
  70 | 		return date ? [date] : [];
  71 | 	}, [columnFilterValue, multiple]);
  72 |
  73 | 	const onSelect = React.useCallback(
  74 | 		(date: Date | DateRange | undefined) => {
  75 | 			if (!date) {
  76 | 				column.setFilterValue(undefined);
  77 | 				return;
  78 | 			}
  79 |
  80 | 			if (multiple && !("getTime" in date)) {
  81 | 				const from = date.from?.getTime();
  82 | 				const to = date.to?.getTime();
  83 | 				column.setFilterValue(from || to ? [from, to] : undefined);
  84 | 			} else if (!multiple && "getTime" in date) {
  85 | 				column.setFilterValue(date.getTime());
  86 | 			}
  87 | 		},
  88 | 		[column, multiple]
  89 | 	);
  90 |
  91 | 	const onReset = React.useCallback(
  92 | 		(event: React.MouseEvent) => {
  93 | 			event.stopPropagation();
  94 | 			column.setFilterValue(undefined);
  95 | 		},
  96 | 		[column]
  97 | 	);
  98 |
  99 | 	const hasValue = React.useMemo(() => {
 100 | 		if (multiple) {
 101 | 			if (!getIsDateRange(selectedDates)) return false;
 102 | 			return selectedDates.from || selectedDates.to;
 103 | 		}
 104 | 		if (!Array.isArray(selectedDates)) return false;
 105 | 		return selectedDates.length > 0;
 106 | 	}, [multiple, selectedDates]);
 107 |
 108 | 	const formatDateRange = React.useCallback((range: DateRange) => {
 109 | 		if (!range.from && !range.to) return "";
 110 | 		if (range.from && range.to) {
 111 | 			return `${formatDate(range.from)} - ${formatDate(range.to)}`;
 112 | 		}
 113 | 		return formatDate(range.from ?? range.to);
 114 | 	}, []);
 115 |
 116 | 	const label = React.useMemo(() => {
 117 | 		if (multiple) {
 118 | 			if (!getIsDateRange(selectedDates)) return null;
 119 |
 120 | 			const hasSelectedDates = selectedDates.from || selectedDates.to;
 121 | 			const dateText = hasSelectedDates ? formatDateRange(selectedDates) : "Select date range";
 122 |
 123 | 			return (
 124 | 				<span className='flex items-center gap-2'>
 125 | 					<span>{title}</span>
 126 | 					{hasSelectedDates && (
 127 | 						<>
 128 | 							<Separator
 129 | 								className='mx-0.5 data-[orientation=vertical]:h-4'
 130 | 								orientation='vertical'
 131 | 							/>
 132 | 							<span>{dateText}</span>
 133 | 						</>
 134 | 					)}
 135 | 				</span>
 136 | 			);
 137 | 		}
 138 |
 139 | 		if (getIsDateRange(selectedDates)) return null;
 140 |
 141 | 		const hasSelectedDate = selectedDates.length > 0;
 142 | 		const dateText = hasSelectedDate ? formatDate(selectedDates[0]) : "Select date";
 143 |
 144 | 		return (
 145 | 			<span className='flex items-center gap-2'>
 146 | 				<span>{title}</span>
 147 | 				{hasSelectedDate && (
 148 | 					<>
 149 | 						<Separator
 150 | 							className='mx-0.5 data-[orientation=vertical]:h-4'
 151 | 							orientation='vertical'
 152 | 						/>
 153 | 						<span>{dateText}</span>
 154 | 					</>
 155 | 				)}
 156 | 			</span>
 157 | 		);
 158 | 	}, [selectedDates, multiple, formatDateRange, title]);
 159 |
 160 | 	return (
 161 | 		<Popover>
 162 | 			<PopoverTrigger asChild>
 163 | 				<Button
 164 | 					className='border-dashed'
 165 | 					size='sm'
 166 | 					variant='outline'
 167 | 				>
 168 | 					{hasValue ? (
 169 | 						<button
 170 | 							aria-label={`Clear ${title} filter`}
 171 | 							className='rounded-sm opacity-70 transition-opacity hover:opacity-100 focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-1 focus-visible:ring-ring'
 172 | 							onClick={onReset}
 173 | 							type='button'
 174 | 						>
 175 | 							<Icons.xCircle />
 176 | 						</button>
 177 | 					) : (
 178 | 						<Icons.calendar />
 179 | 					)}
 180 | 					{label}
 181 | 				</Button>
 182 | 			</PopoverTrigger>
 183 | 			<PopoverContent
 184 | 				align='start'
 185 | 				className='w-auto p-0'
 186 | 			>
 187 | 				{multiple ? (
 188 | 					<Calendar
 189 | 						initialFocus
 190 | 						mode='range'
 191 | 						onSelect={onSelect}
 192 | 						selected={getIsDateRange(selectedDates) ? selectedDates : { from: undefined, to: undefined }}
 193 | 					/>
 194 | 				) : (
 195 | 					<Calendar
 196 | 						initialFocus
 197 | 						mode='single'
 198 | 						onSelect={onSelect}
 199 | 						selected={!getIsDateRange(selectedDates) ? selectedDates[0] : undefined}
 200 | 					/>
 201 | 				)}
 202 | 			</PopoverContent>
 203 | 		</Popover>
 204 | 	);
 205 | }
```

```tsx
  28 |
  29 | export function DataTableFacetedFilter<TData, TValue>({
  30 | 	column,
  31 | 	title,
  32 | 	options,
  33 | 	multiple
  34 | }: DataTableFacetedFilterProps<TData, TValue>) {
  35 | 	const [open, setOpen] = React.useState(false);
  36 |
  37 | 	const columnFilterValue = column?.getFilterValue();
  38 | 	const selectedValues = React.useMemo(
  39 | 		() => new Set(Array.isArray(columnFilterValue) ? columnFilterValue : []),
  40 | 		[columnFilterValue]
  41 | 	);
  42 |
  43 | 	const onItemSelect = React.useCallback(
  44 | 		(option: Option, isSelected: boolean) => {
  45 | 			if (!column) return;
  46 |
  47 | 			if (multiple) {
  48 | 				const newSelectedValues = new Set(selectedValues);
  49 | 				if (isSelected) {
  50 | 					newSelectedValues.delete(option.value);
  51 | 				} else {
  52 | 					newSelectedValues.add(option.value);
  53 | 				}
  54 | 				const filterValues = Array.from(newSelectedValues);
  55 | 				column.setFilterValue(filterValues.length ? filterValues : undefined);
  56 | 			} else {
  57 | 				column.setFilterValue(isSelected ? undefined : [option.value]);
  58 | 				setOpen(false);
  59 | 			}
  60 | 		},
  61 | 		[column, multiple, selectedValues]
  62 | 	);
  63 |
  64 | 	const onReset = React.useCallback(
  65 | 		(event?: React.MouseEvent) => {
  66 | 			event?.stopPropagation();
  67 | 			column?.setFilterValue(undefined);
  68 | 		},
  69 | 		[column]
  70 | 	);
  71 |
  72 | 	return (
  73 | 		<Popover
  74 | 			onOpenChange={setOpen}
  75 | 			open={open}
  76 | 		>
  77 | 			<PopoverTrigger asChild>
  78 | 				<Button
  79 | 					className='border-dashed'
  80 | 					size='sm'
  81 | 					variant='outline'
  82 | 				>
  83 | 					{selectedValues?.size > 0 ? (

  85 | 							aria-label={`Clear ${title} filter`}
  86 | 							className='rounded-sm opacity-70 transition-opacity hover:opacity-100 focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-1 focus-visible:ring-ring'
  87 | 							onClick={onReset}
  88 | 							type='button'
  89 | 						>
  90 | 							<Icons.xCircle />
  91 | 						</button>
  92 | 					) : (
  93 | 						<Icons.plusCircle />
  94 | 					)}
  95 | 					{title}
  96 | 					{selectedValues?.size > 0 && (
  97 | 						<>
  98 | 							<Separator
  99 | 								className='mx-0.5 data-[orientation=vertical]:h-4'
 100 | 								orientation='vertical'
 101 | 							/>
 102 | 							<Badge
 103 | 								className='rounded-sm px-1 font-normal lg:hidden'
 104 | 								variant='secondary'
 105 | 							>
 106 | 								{selectedValues.size}
 107 | 							</Badge>
 108 | 							<div className='hidden items-center gap-1 lg:flex'>
 109 | 								{selectedValues.size > 2 ? (
 110 | 									<Badge
 111 | 										className='rounded-sm px-1 font-normal'
 112 | 										variant='secondary'
 113 | 									>
 114 | 										{selectedValues.size} selected
 115 | 									</Badge>
 116 | 								) : (
 117 | 									options

 131 | 					)}
 132 | 				</Button>
```

```tsx
   6 | import { Input } from "#/components/ui/input";
   7 | import { Label } from "#/components/ui/label";
   8 | import { Popover, PopoverContent, PopoverTrigger } from "#/components/ui/popover";
   9 | import { Separator } from "#/components/ui/separator";
  10 | import { Slider } from "#/components/ui/slider";
  11 | import { cn } from "#/lib/utils";
  12 |
  13 | interface Range {
  14 | 	min: number;
  15 | 	max: number;
  16 | }
  17 |
  18 | type RangeValue = [number, number];
  19 |
  20 | function getIsValidRange(value: unknown): value is RangeValue {
  21 | 	return Array.isArray(value) && value.length === 2 && typeof value[0] === "number" && typeof value[1] === "number";
  22 | }
  23 |
  24 | interface DataTableSliderFilterProps<TData> {
  25 | 	column: Column<TData, unknown>;
  26 | 	title?: string;
  27 | }
  28 |
  29 | export function DataTableSliderFilter<TData>({ column, title }: DataTableSliderFilterProps<TData>) {
  30 | 	const id = React.useId();
  31 |
  32 | 	const columnFilterValue = getIsValidRange(column.getFilterValue())
  33 | 		? (column.getFilterValue() as RangeValue)
  34 | 		: undefined;
  35 |
  36 | 	const defaultRange = column.columnDef.meta?.range;
  37 | 	const unit = column.columnDef.meta?.unit;
  38 |
  39 | 	const { min, max, step } = React.useMemo<Range & { step: number }>(() => {
  40 | 		let minValue = 0;
  41 | 		let maxValue = 100;
  42 |
  43 | 		if (defaultRange && getIsValidRange(defaultRange)) {
  44 | 			[minValue, maxValue] = defaultRange;
  45 | 		} else {
  46 | 			const values = column.getFacetedMinMaxValues();
  47 | 			if (values && Array.isArray(values) && values.length === 2) {
  48 | 				const [facetMinValue, facetMaxValue] = values;
  49 | 				if (typeof facetMinValue === "number" && typeof facetMaxValue === "number") {
  50 | 					minValue = facetMinValue;
  51 | 					maxValue = facetMaxValue;
  52 | 				}
  53 | 			}
  54 | 		}
  55 |
  56 | 		const rangeSize = maxValue - minValue;
  57 | 		const step = rangeSize <= 20 ? 1 : rangeSize <= 100 ? Math.ceil(rangeSize / 20) : Math.ceil(rangeSize / 50);
  58 |
  59 | 		return { min: minValue, max: maxValue, step };
  60 | 	}, [column, defaultRange]);
  61 |
  62 | 	const range = React.useMemo((): RangeValue => {
  63 | 		return columnFilterValue ?? [min, max];
  64 | 	}, [columnFilterValue, min, max]);
  65 |
  66 | 	const formatValue = React.useCallback((value: number) => {
  67 | 		return value.toLocaleString(undefined, { maximumFractionDigits: 0 });
  68 | 	}, []);
  69 |
  70 | 	const onFromInputChange = React.useCallback(
  71 | 		(event: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => {
  72 | 			const numValue = Number(event.target.value);
  73 | 			if (!Number.isNaN(numValue) && numValue >= min && numValue <= range[1]) {
  74 | 				column.setFilterValue([numValue, range[1]]);
  75 | 			}
  76 | 		},
  77 | 		[column, min, range]
  78 | 	);
  79 |
  80 | 	const onToInputChange = React.useCallback(
  81 | 		(event: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => {
  82 | 			const numValue = Number(event.target.value);
  83 | 			if (!Number.isNaN(numValue) && numValue <= max && numValue >= range[0]) {
  84 | 				column.setFilterValue([range[0], numValue]);
  85 | 			}
  86 | 		},
  87 | 		[column, max, range]
  88 | 	);
  89 |
  90 | 	const onSliderValueChange = React.useCallback(
  91 | 		(value: RangeValue) => {
  92 | 			if (Array.isArray(value) && value.length === 2) {
  93 | 				column.setFilterValue(value);
  94 | 			}
  95 | 		},
  96 | 		[column]
  97 | 	);
  98 |
  99 | 	const onReset = React.useCallback(
 100 | 		(event: React.MouseEvent) => {
 101 | 			if (event.target instanceof HTMLDivElement) {
 102 | 				event.stopPropagation();
 103 | 			}
 104 | 			column.setFilterValue(undefined);
 105 | 		},
 106 | 		[column]
 107 | 	);
 108 |
 109 | 	return (
 110 | 		<Popover>
 111 | 			<PopoverTrigger asChild>
 112 | 				<Button
 113 | 					className='border-dashed'
 114 | 					size='sm'
 115 | 					variant='outline'
 116 | 				>
 117 | 					{columnFilterValue ? (
 118 | 						<button
 119 | 							aria-label={`Clear ${title} filter`}
 120 | 							className='rounded-sm opacity-70 transition-opacity hover:opacity-100 focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-1 focus-visible:ring-ring'
 121 | 							onClick={onReset}
 122 | 							type='button'
 123 | 						>
 124 | 							<Icons.xCircle />
 125 | 						</button>
 126 | 					) : (
 127 | 						<Icons.plusCircle />
 128 | 					)}
 129 | 					<span>{title}</span>
 130 | 					{columnFilterValue ? (
 131 | 						<>
 132 | 							<Separator
 133 | 								className='mx-0.5 data-[orientation=vertical]:h-4'
 134 | 								orientation='vertical'
 135 | 							/>
 136 | 							{formatValue(columnFilterValue[0])} - {formatValue(columnFilterValue[1])}
 137 | 							{unit ? ` ${unit}` : ""}
 138 | 						</>
 139 | 					) : null}
 140 | 				</Button>
 141 | 			</PopoverTrigger>
 142 | 			<PopoverContent
 143 | 				align='start'
 144 | 				className='flex w-auto flex-col gap-4'
 145 | 			>
 146 | 				<div className='flex flex-col gap-3'>
 147 | 					<p className='font-medium leading-none peer-disabled:cursor-not-allowed peer-disabled:opacity-70'>
 148 | 						{title}
 149 | 					</p>
 150 | 					<div className='flex items-center gap-4'>
 151 | 						<Label
 152 | 							className='sr-only'
 153 | 							htmlFor={`${id}-from`}
 154 | 						>
 155 | 							From
 156 | 						</Label>
 157 | 						<div className='relative'>
 158 | 							<Input
 159 | 								aria-valuemax={max}
 160 | 								aria-valuemin={min}
 161 | 								className={cn("h-8 w-24", unit && "pr-8")}
 162 | 								id={`${id}-from`}
 163 | 								inputMode='numeric'
 164 | 								max={max}
 165 | 								min={min}
 166 | 								onChange={onFromInputChange}
 167 | 								pattern='[0-9]*'
 168 | 								placeholder={min.toString()}
 169 | 								type='number'
 170 | 								value={range[0]?.toString()}
 171 | 							/>
 172 | 							{unit && (
 173 | 								<span className='absolute top-0 right-0 bottom-0 flex items-center rounded-r-md bg-accent px-2 text-muted-foreground text-sm'>
 174 | 									{unit}
 175 | 								</span>
 176 | 							)}
 177 | 						</div>
 178 | 						<Label
 179 | 							className='sr-only'
 180 | 							htmlFor={`${id}-to`}
 181 | 						>
 182 | 							to
 183 | 						</Label>
 184 | 						<div className='relative'>
 185 | 							<Input
 186 | 								aria-valuemax={max}
 187 | 								aria-valuemin={min}
 188 | 								className={cn("h-8 w-24", unit && "pr-8")}
 189 | 								id={`${id}-to`}
 190 | 								inputMode='numeric'
 191 | 								max={max}
 192 | 								min={min}
 193 | 								onChange={onToInputChange}
 194 | 								pattern='[0-9]*'
 195 | 								placeholder={max.toString()}
 196 | 								type='number'
 197 | 								value={range[1]?.toString()}
 198 | 							/>
 199 | 							{unit && (
 200 | 								<span className='absolute top-0 right-0 bottom-0 flex items-center rounded-r-md bg-accent px-2 text-muted-foreground text-sm'>
 201 | 									{unit}
 202 | 								</span>
 203 | 							)}
 204 | 						</div>
 205 | 					</div>
 206 | 					<Label
 207 | 						className='sr-only'
 208 | 						htmlFor={`${id}-slider`}
 209 | 					>
 210 | 						{title} slider
 211 | 					</Label>
 212 | 					<Slider
 213 | 						id={`${id}-slider`}
 214 | 						max={max}
 215 | 						min={min}
 216 | 						onValueChange={onSliderValueChange}
 217 | 						step={step}
 218 | 						value={range}
 219 | 					/>
 220 | 				</div>
 221 | 				<Button
 222 | 					aria-label={`Clear ${title} filter`}
 223 | 					onClick={onReset}
 224 | 					size='sm'
 225 | 					variant='outline'
 226 | 				>
 227 | 					Clear
 228 | 				</Button>
 229 | 			</PopoverContent>
 230 | 		</Popover>
 231 | 	);
 232 | }
```

```tsx
   1 | import { Cross2Icon } from "@radix-ui/react-icons";
   2 | import type { Column, Table } from "@tanstack/react-table";
   3 | import * as React from "react";
   4 |
   5 | import { Button } from "#/components/ui/button";
   6 | import { Input } from "#/components/ui/input";
   7 | import { DataTableDateFilter } from "#/components/ui/table/data-table-date-filter";

  15 | }
  16 |
  17 | export function DataTableToolbar<TData>({ table, children, className, ...props }: DataTableToolbarProps<TData>) {
  18 | 	const isFiltered = table.getState().columnFilters.length > 0;
  19 |
  20 | 	const columns = React.useMemo(() => table.getAllColumns().filter(column => column.getCanFilter()), [table]);
  21 |
  22 | 	const onReset = React.useCallback(() => {
  23 | 		table.resetColumnFilters();
  24 | 	}, [table]);
  25 |
  26 | 	return (
  27 | 		<div

  33 | 			<div className='flex flex-1 flex-wrap items-center gap-2'>
  34 | 				{columns.map(column => (
  35 | 					<DataTableToolbarFilter

  38 | 					/>
  39 | 				))}
  40 | 				{isFiltered && (
  41 | 					<Button
  42 | 						aria-label='Reset filters'
  43 | 						className='border-dashed'
  44 | 						onClick={onReset}
  45 | 						size='sm'
  46 | 						variant='outline'
  47 | 					>
  48 | 						<Cross2Icon />
  49 | 						Reset
  50 | 					</Button>
  51 | 				)}
  52 | 			</div>
  53 | 			<div className='flex items-center gap-2'>
  54 | 				{children}
  55 | 				<DataTableViewOptions table={table} />
  56 | 			</div>
  57 | 		</div>
  58 | 	);
  59 | }
  60 | interface DataTableToolbarFilterProps<TData> {
  61 | 	column: Column<TData>;
  62 | }
  63 |
  64 | function DataTableToolbarFilter<TData>({ column }: DataTableToolbarFilterProps<TData>) {
  65 | 	{
  66 | 		const columnMeta = column.columnDef.meta;
  67 |
  68 | 		const onFilterRender = React.useCallback(() => {
  69 | 			if (!columnMeta?.variant) return null;
  70 |
  71 | 			switch (columnMeta.variant) {
  72 | 				case "text":
  73 | 					return (
  74 | 						<Input
  75 | 							className='h-8 w-40 lg:w-56'
  76 | 							onChange={event => column.setFilterValue(event.target.value)}
  77 | 							placeholder={columnMeta.placeholder ?? columnMeta.label}
  78 | 							value={(column.getFilterValue() as string) ?? ""}
  79 | 						/>
  80 | 					);
  81 |
  82 | 				case "number":
  83 | 					return (
  84 | 						<div className='relative'>
  85 | 							<Input
  86 | 								className={cn("h-8 w-[120px]", columnMeta.unit && "pr-8")}
  87 | 								inputMode='numeric'
  88 | 								onChange={event => column.setFilterValue(event.target.value)}
  89 | 								placeholder={columnMeta.placeholder ?? columnMeta.label}
  90 | 								type='number'
  91 | 								value={(column.getFilterValue() as string) ?? ""}
  92 | 							/>
  93 | 							{columnMeta.unit && (
  94 | 								<span className='absolute top-0 right-0 bottom-0 flex items-center rounded-r-md bg-accent px-2 text-muted-foreground text-sm'>
  95 | 									{columnMeta.unit}
  96 | 								</span>
  97 | 							)}
  98 | 						</div>
  99 | 					);
 100 |
 101 | 				case "range":
 102 | 					return (
 103 | 						<DataTableSliderFilter
 104 | 							column={column}
 105 | 							title={columnMeta.label ?? column.id}
 106 | 						/>
 107 | 					);
 108 |
 109 | 				case "date":
 110 | 				case "dateRange":
 111 | 					return (
 112 | 						<DataTableDateFilter
 113 | 							column={column}
 114 | 							multiple={columnMeta.variant === "dateRange"}
 115 | 							title={columnMeta.label ?? column.id}
 116 | 						/>
 117 | 					);
 118 |
 119 | 				case "select":
 120 | 				case "multiSelect":
 121 | 					return (
 122 | 						<DataTableFacetedFilter
 123 | 							column={column}
 124 | 							multiple={columnMeta.variant === "multiSelect"}
 125 | 							options={columnMeta.options ?? []}
 126 | 							title={columnMeta.label ?? column.id}
 127 | 						/>
 128 | 					);
 129 |
 130 | 				default:
 131 | 					return null;
 132 | 			}
 133 | 		}, [column, columnMeta]);
 134 |
 135 | 		return onFilterRender();
 136 | 	}
 137 | }
```

  58 | function Form({
  59 | 	children,
  60 | 	...props
  61 | }: Omit<React.ComponentPropsWithoutRef<"form">, "onSubmit" | "noValidate"> & {
  62 | 	children?: React.ReactNode;
  63 | }) {
  64 | 	const form = useFormContext();
  65 | 	const handleSubmit = React.useCallback(
  66 | 		(e: React.FormEvent<HTMLFormElement>) => {
  67 | 			e.preventDefault();

  76 | 			noValidate
  77 | 			onSubmit={handleSubmit}
  78 | 			{...props}
  79 | 		>
  80 | 			{children}
  81 | 		</form>
  82 | 	);
  83 | }
  84 |
  85 | function SubmitButton({
  86 | 	children,
  87 | 	className,
  88 | 	size,
  89 | 	...props
  90 | }: React.ComponentProps<"button"> & VariantProps<typeof buttonVariants>) {
  91 | 	const form = useFormContext();
  92 | 	return (
  93 | 		<form.Subscribe selector={state => [state.canSubmit, state.isSubmitting] as const}>
  94 | 			{([canSubmit, isSubmitting]) => (
  95 | 				<Button
  96 | 					className={className}
  97 | 					disabled={!canSubmit}
  98 | 					isLoading={isSubmitting}
  99 | 					size={size}
 100 | 					type='submit'
 101 | 					{...props}
 102 | 				>
 103 | 					{children}
 104 | 				</Button>
 105 | 			)}
 106 | 		</form.Subscribe>
 107 | 	);
 108 | }

 110 | function SubscribeButton({ label }: { label: string }) {

 190 | 		// These allow form.TextField, form.SelectField, etc.
 191 | 		// For type-safe field names, use form.AppField render-prop instead.
 192 | 		TextField: FormTextField,
 193 | 		TextareaField: FormTextareaField,
 194 | 		SelectField: FormSelectField,
 195 | 		CheckboxField: FormCheckboxField,
 196 | 		SwitchField: FormSwitchField,

 203 | // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
 204 | // Type-safe field names — useFormFields
 205 | // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
 206 |
 207 | /**
 208 |  * Returns all composed field components with type-safe `name` props.
 209 |  * Pass your form's value type (or `z.infer<typeof schema>`) to narrow names.
 210 |  *
 211 |  * @example
 212 |  * ```tsx
 213 |  * type FormValues = z.infer<typeof mySchema>;
 214 |  * const form = useAppForm({ defaultValues: {...} as FormValues, ... });
 215 |  * const { FormTextField, FormSelectField } = useFormFields<FormValues>();
 216 |  *
 217 |  * <FormTextField name="email" />  // ✅ autocomplete + type check
 218 |  * <FormTextField name="typo" />   // ❌ TypeScript error!
 219 |  * ```
 220 |  */
 221 | function useFormFields<TValues extends Record<string, unknown>>() {
 222 | 	type Typed<C> = WithTypedName<C, TValues>;
 223 | 	return {
 224 | 		FormTextField: FormTextField as unknown as Typed<typeof FormTextField>,
 225 | 		FormTextareaField: FormTextareaField as unknown as Typed<typeof FormTextareaField>,
 226 | 		FormSelectField: FormSelectField as unknown as Typed<typeof FormSelectField>,
 227 | 		FormCheckboxField: FormCheckboxField as unknown as Typed<typeof FormCheckboxField>,
 228 | 		FormSwitchField: FormSwitchField as unknown as Typed<typeof FormSwitchField>,
 229 | 		FormRadioGroupField: FormRadioGroupField as unknown as Typed<typeof FormRadioGroupField>,
 230 | 		FormSliderField: FormSliderField as unknown as Typed<typeof FormSliderField>,
 231 | 		FormFileUploadField: FormFileUploadField as unknown as Typed<typeof FormFileUploadField>
 232 | 	};
 233 | }

`context/theme.tsx`:

```tsx
   1 | import { ScriptOnce } from "@tanstack/react-router";
   2 | import { createContext, use, useCallback, useEffect, useMemo, useState } from "react";
   3 |
   4 | type Theme = "dark" | "light";
   5 |
   6 | type ThemeProviderProps = {
   7 | 	children: React.ReactNode;
   8 | 	defaultTheme?: Theme;
   9 | };
  10 |
  11 | type ThemeProviderState = {
  12 | 	setTheme: (theme: Theme) => void;
  13 | 	theme: Theme;
  14 | };
  15 |
  16 | const ThemeProviderContext = createContext<ThemeProviderState>({
  17 | 	setTheme: () => null,
  18 | 	theme: "light"
  19 | });
  20 |
  21 | export function ThemeProvider({ children, defaultTheme = "light", ...props }: ThemeProviderProps) {
  22 | 	const [theme, setTheme] = useState<Theme>(() => {
  23 | 		if (typeof window === "undefined") return defaultTheme;
  24 |
  25 | 		const stored = localStorage.getItem("theme") as Theme | null;
  26 |
  27 | 		if (stored) {
  28 | 			return stored;
  29 | 		}
  30 |
  31 | 		return defaultTheme;
  32 | 	});
  33 |
  34 | 	const applyTheme = useCallback((theme: Theme) => {
  35 | 		const root = window.document.documentElement;
  36 |
  37 | 		root.classList.remove("light", "dark");
  38 | 		root.classList.add(theme);
  39 | 	}, []);
  40 |
  41 | 	useEffect(() => {
  42 | 		applyTheme(theme);
  43 |
  44 | 		localStorage.setItem("theme", theme);
  45 | 	}, [theme, applyTheme]);
  46 |
  47 | 	useEffect(() => {
  48 | 		const media = window.matchMedia("(prefers-color-scheme: dark)");
  49 |
  50 | 		const handler = (event: MediaQueryListEvent) => {
  51 | 			if (!localStorage.getItem("theme")) {
  52 | 				setTheme(event.matches ? "dark" : "light");
  53 | 			}
  54 | 		};
  55 |
  56 | 		media.addEventListener("change", handler);
  57 |
  58 | 		return () => media.removeEventListener("change", handler);
  59 | 	}, []);
  60 |
  61 | 	const value = useMemo(
  62 | 		() => ({
  63 | 			theme,
  64 | 			setTheme
  65 | 		}),
  66 | 		[theme]
  67 | 	);
  68 |
  69 | 	return (
  70 | 		<ThemeProviderContext
  71 | 			{...props}
  72 | 			value={value}
  73 | 		>
  74 | 			<ScriptOnce>
  75 | 				{`
  76 |           (function() {
  77 |             var stored = localStorage.getItem('theme');
  78 |             var root = document.documentElement;
  79 |             var theme = stored || '${defaultTheme}';
  80 |             root.classList.remove('light', 'dark');
  81 |             root.classList.add(theme);
  82 |           })();
  83 |         `}
  84 | 			</ScriptOnce>
  85 | 			{children}
  86 | 		</ThemeProviderContext>
  87 | 	);
  88 | }
  89 |
  90 | export const useTheme = () => {
  91 | 	const context = use(ThemeProviderContext);
  92 |
  93 | 	if (context === undefined) {
  94 | 		throw new Error("useTheme must be used within a ThemeProvider");
  95 | 	}
  96 |
  97 | 	return context;
  98 | };

```

`data/demo-table-data.ts`:

```ts
   1 | import { faker } from "@faker-js/faker";
   2 |
   3 | export type Person = {
   4 | 	id: number;
   5 | 	firstName: string;
   6 | 	lastName: string;
   7 | 	age: number;
   8 | 	visits: number;
   9 | 	progress: number;
  10 | 	status: "relationship" | "complicated" | "single";
  11 | 	subRows?: Person[];
  12 | };
  13 |
  14 | const range = (len: number) => {
  15 | 	const arr: number[] = [];
  16 | 	for (let i = 0; i < len; i++) {
  17 | 		arr.push(i);
  18 | 	}
  19 | 	return arr;
  20 | };
  21 |
  22 | const newPerson = (num: number): Person => {
  23 | 	return {
  24 | 		id: num,
  25 | 		firstName: faker.person.firstName(),
  26 | 		lastName: faker.person.lastName(),
  27 | 		age: faker.number.int(40),
  28 | 		visits: faker.number.int(1000),
  29 | 		progress: faker.number.int(100),
  30 | 		status: faker.helpers.shuffle<Person["status"]>(["relationship", "complicated", "single"])[0]!
  31 | 	};
  32 | };
  33 |
  34 | export function makeData(...lens: number[]) {
  35 | 	const makeDataLevel = (depth = 0): Person[] => {
  36 | 		const len = lens[depth]!;
  37 | 		return range(len).map((index): Person => {
  38 | 			return {
  39 | 				...newPerson(index),
  40 | 				subRows: lens[depth + 1] ? makeDataLevel(depth + 1) : undefined
  41 | 			};
  42 | 		});
  43 | 	};
  44 |
  45 | 	return makeDataLevel();
  46 | }
```

`db/index.ts`:

```ts
   1 | import { Database } from "bun:sqlite";
   2 |
   3 | import type { BunSQLiteDatabase } from "drizzle-orm/bun-sqlite";
   4 | import { drizzle } from "drizzle-orm/bun-sqlite";
   5 |
   6 | import { env } from "../env";
   7 | import * as schema from "./schema";
   8 |
   9 | export function createDb(): BunSQLiteDatabase<typeof schema> {
  10 | 	const sqlite = new Database(env.DATABASE_URL?.replace(/^file:/, "") ?? "./data.db");
  11 |
  12 | 	// In bun:sqlite, use .exec() for pragmas
  13 | 	sqlite.exec("PRAGMA journal_mode = WAL;");
  14 | 	sqlite.exec("PRAGMA synchronous = NORMAL;");
  15 | 	sqlite.exec("PRAGMA cache_size = -64000;");
  16 | 	sqlite.exec("PRAGMA busy_timeout = 30000;");
  17 |
  18 | 	return drizzle(sqlite, { schema });
  19 | }
  20 | /**
  21 |  * Global singleton (dev + hot reload safe)
  22 |  */
  23 | declare global {
  24 | 	// eslint-disable-next-line no-var
  25 | 	var __db: BunSQLiteDatabase<typeof schema> | undefined;
  26 | }
  27 |
  28 | export const db =
  29 | 	globalThis.__db ??
  30 | 	(() => {
  31 | 		const instance = createDb();
  32 | 		if (process.env.NODE_ENV !== "production") {
  33 | 			globalThis.__db = instance;
  34 | 		}
  35 | 		return instance;
  36 | 	})();
  37 |
  38 | export type DbExecutor = BunSQLiteDatabase<typeof schema>;
  39 | export type AppDb = typeof db;
```

`db/queries.ts`:

```ts
   1 | import { and, eq } from "drizzle-orm";
   2 |
   3 | import { db } from ".";
   4 | import { clinicMembers, doctor, guardian, user } from "./schema";
   5 |
   6 | export async function checkVitalSignsAccess(userId: string, patientId: string): Promise<boolean> {
   7 | 	const userData = await db.query.user.findFirst({
   8 | 		where: eq(user.id, userId),
   9 | 		with: {
  10 | 			patients: true,
  11 | 			doctors: true
  12 | 		}
  13 | 	});
  14 |
  15 | 	if (!userData) return false;
  16 |
  17 | 	if (userData.role === "admin" || userData.role === "staff") return true;
  18 | 	if (userData.role === "doctor" && userData.doctors) return true;
  19 | 	if (userData.role === "patient" && Array.isArray(userData.patients)) {
  20 | 		return userData.patients.some(p => p.id === patientId);
  21 | 	}
  22 |
  23 | 	// Check if user is guardian
  24 | 	const guardianRecord = await db.query.guardian.findFirst({
  25 | 		where: and(eq(guardian.userId, userId), eq(guardian.patientId, patientId))
  26 | 	});
  27 |
  28 | 	return !!guardianRecord;
  29 | }
  30 |
  31 | // Helper function to check doctor access
  32 | export async function checkDoctorAccess(doctorId: string, userId: string, clinicId?: string) {
  33 | 	const userRecord = await db.query.user.findFirst({
  34 | 		where: eq(user.id, userId),
  35 | 		with: {
  36 | 			doctors: true,
  37 | 			clinics: true
  38 | 		}
  39 | 	});
  40 |
  41 | 	if (!userRecord) return false;
  42 |
  43 | 	// Admin has full access
  44 | 	if (userRecord.role === "admin" || userRecord.role === "superadmin") return true;
  45 |
  46 | 	// Staff has limited access
  47 | 	if (userRecord.role === "staff") return true;
  48 |
  49 | 	// Doctor access
  50 | 	if (userRecord.role === "doctor") {
  51 | 		const doctorRecord = await db.query.doctor.findFirst({
  52 | 			where: and(eq(doctor.userId, userId), eq(doctor.id, doctorId))
  53 | 		});
  54 | 		return !!doctorRecord;
  55 | 	}
  56 |
  57 | 	// Check clinic membership
  58 | 	if (clinicId) {
  59 | 		const clinicMember = await db.query.clinicMembers.findFirst({
  60 | 			where: and(eq(clinicMembers.userId, userId), eq(clinicMembers.clinicId, clinicId))
  61 | 		});
  62 | 		return !!clinicMember;
  63 | 	}
  64 |
  65 | 	return false;
  66 | }
```

```ts
1440 | // Note: Switched to sqliteView as schema implies SQLite. Materialized views are not supported in SQLite.
```

```ts
   1 | import { randomUUID } from "node:crypto";

  10 | /* =======================
  11 |    Types (unchanged)

  13 |
  14 | type DoseGuidelineData = {
  15 | 	ROUTE: string;

  22 | 	GESTATIONAL_AGE_WEEKS_MAX: number | string;
  23 | 	POST_NATAL_AGE_DAYS_MIN: number | string;
  24 | 	POST_NATAL_AGE_DAYS_MAX: number | string;
  25 | 	MAX_DOSE_PER_24H: number | string;

  31 |
  32 | type DrugDatabase = {
  33 | 	[drugName: string]: DoseGuidelineData[];
  34 | };
  35 |
  36 | /* =======================
  37 |    Helpers (unchanged)
  38 | ======================= */
  39 |
  40 | function parseNumericValue(value: string | number): number | null {
  41 | 	if (value === "N/A" || value === "" || value == null) return null;
  42 | 	if (typeof value === "number") return value;
  43 | 	const parsed = Number.parseFloat(value.trim());
  44 | 	return Number.isNaN(parsed) ? null : parsed;
  45 | }
  46 |
  47 | function parseIntegerValue(value: string | number): number | null {
  48 | 	if (value === "N/A" || value === "" || value == null) return null;
  49 | 	if (typeof value === "number") return Math.floor(value);
  50 | 	const parsed = Number.parseInt(value.trim(), 10);
  51 | 	return Number.isNaN(parsed) ? null : parsed;
  52 | }
  53 |
  54 | /* =======================
  55 |    Drizzle Seed
  56 | ======================= */
  57 |
  58 | export default async function drugSeed(db: AppDb) {
  59 | 	console.log("🌱 Starting NICU Drug Database seeding...");
  60 |
  61 | 	const filePath = path.resolve("src/db/data/nicu_data.json");
  62 | 	console.log(`📖 Reading data from: ${filePath}`);
  63 |
  64 | 	const drugData = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(filePath, "utf-8")) as DrugDatabase;
  65 |
  66 | 	const drugNames = Object.keys(drugData);
  67 | 	console.log(`📊 Found ${drugNames.length} drugs`);
  68 |
  69 | 	const guidelinesBuffer: (typeof doseGuideline.$inferInsert)[] = [];
  70 | 	let totalGuidelines = 0;
  71 |
  72 | 	for (const [drugName, guidelines] of Object.entries(drugData)) {
  73 | 		/* ---------- upsert drug ---------- */
  74 | 		let drug = await db.select().from(drugs).where(eq(drugs.name, drugName)).get();
  75 |
  76 | 		if (!drug) {
  77 | 			const id = randomUUID();
  78 | 			await db.insert(drugs).values({ id, name: drugName });
  79 | 			drug = {
  80 | 				id,
  81 | 				name: drugName,
  82 | 				genericName: null,
  83 | 				brandName: null,
  84 | 				description: null,
  85 | 				sideEffects: null,
  86 | 				interactions: null,
  87 | 				contraindications: null,
  88 | 				createdAt: new Date(),
  89 | 				updatedAt: new Date()
  90 | 			};
  91 | 		}
  92 |
  93 | 		/* ---------- collect guidelines ---------- */
  94 | 		for (const g of guidelines) {
  95 | 			guidelinesBuffer.push({
  96 | 				id: randomUUID(),
  97 | 				drugId: drug.id,
  98 | 				route: g.ROUTE,
  99 | 				clinicalIndication: g.CLINICAL_INDICATION,
 100 |
 101 | 				minDosePerKg: parseNumericValue(g.MIN_DOSE_PER_KG),
 102 | 				maxDosePerKg: parseNumericValue(g.MAX_DOSE_PER_KG),
 103 | 				doseUnit: g.DOSE_UNIT === "N/A" ? null : g.DOSE_UNIT,
 104 | 				frequencyDays: g.FREQUENCY_DAYS === "N/A" ? null : g.FREQUENCY_DAYS,
 105 |
 106 | 				gestationalAgeWeeksMin: parseNumericValue(g.GESTATIONAL_AGE_WEEKS_MIN),
 107 | 				gestationalAgeWeeksMax: parseNumericValue(g.GESTATIONAL_AGE_WEEKS_MAX),
 108 |
 109 | 				postNatalAgeDaysMin: parseIntegerValue(g.POST_NATAL_AGE_DAYS_MIN),
 110 | 				postNatalAgeDaysMax: parseIntegerValue(g.POST_NATAL_AGE_DAYS_MAX),
 111 |
 112 | 				maxDosePer24h: parseNumericValue(g.MAX_DOSE_PER_24H),
 113 | 				stockConcentrationMgMl: parseNumericValue(g.STOCK_CONCENTRATION_MG_ML),
 114 | 				finalConcentrationMgMl: parseNumericValue(g.FINAL_CONCENTRATION_MG_ML),
 115 | 				minInfusionTimeMin: parseIntegerValue(g.MIN_INFUSION_TIME_MIN),
 116 |
 117 | 				compatibilityDiluent: g.COMPATIBILITY_DILUENT === "N/A" ? null : g.COMPATIBILITY_DILUENT
 118 | 			});
 119 | 		}
 120 |
 121 | 		totalGuidelines += guidelines.length;
 122 | 		console.log(`✅ ${drugName}: ${guidelines.length} guidelines`);
 123 | 	}
 124 |
 125 | 	/* ---------- batch insert ---------- */
 126 | 	const BATCH_SIZE = 1000;
 127 | 	console.log(`⏳ Inserting ${guidelinesBuffer.length} guidelines...`);
 128 |
 129 | 	for (let i = 0; i < guidelinesBuffer.length; i += BATCH_SIZE) {
 130 | 		await db.insert(doseGuideline).values(guidelinesBuffer.slice(i, i + BATCH_SIZE));
 131 | 	}
 132 |
 133 | 	console.log("🎉 NICU Drug Database seeded successfully!");
 134 | 	console.log(`📈 Summary — Drugs: ${drugNames.length}, Guidelines: ${totalGuidelines}`);
 135 | }
```

`db/seed/seed-wfa.ts`:

```ts
   1 | import { randomUUID } from "node:crypto";
   2 | import * as path from "node:path";
   3 | import { fileURLToPath } from "node:url";
   4 |
   5 | import type { AppDb } from "..";
   6 | import { whoGrowthStandard } from "../schema";
   7 | import { Gender, MeasurementType } from "../seed/seed";
   8 |
   9 | const __filename = fileURLToPath(import.meta.url);
  10 | const __dirname = path.dirname(__filename);
  11 |
  12 | const ZSCORE_DATA_PATH = path.join(__dirname, "..", "data", "zscore-wfa.json");
  13 |
  14 | type ZScoreDataPoint = {
  15 | 	Day: string;
  16 | 	L: string;
  17 | 	M: string;
  18 | 	S: string;
  19 | 	SD4neg: string;
  20 | 	SD3neg: string;
  21 | 	SD2neg: string;
  22 | 	SD1neg: string;
  23 | 	SD0: string;
  24 | 	SD1: string;
  25 | 	SD2: string;
  26 | 	SD3: string;
  27 | 	SD4: string;
  28 | };
  29 |
  30 | type GenderData = {
  31 | 	boys: ZScoreDataPoint[];
  32 | 	girls: ZScoreDataPoint[];
  33 | };
  34 |
  35 | type ZScoreData = {
  36 | 	wfa: GenderData;
  37 | };
  38 |
  39 | type ValidatedGrowthRecord = {
  40 | 	id: string;
  41 | 	ageInMonths: number;
  42 | 	ageDays: number;
  43 | 	gender: string;
  44 | 	measurementType: string;
  45 | 	lValue: number;
  46 | 	mValue: number;
  47 | 	sValue: number;
  48 | 	sd0: number;
  49 | 	sd1neg: number;
  50 | 	sd1pos: number;
  51 | 	sd2neg: number;
  52 | 	sd2pos: number;
  53 | 	sd3neg: number;
  54 | 	sd3pos: number;
  55 | 	sd4neg: number | null;
  56 | 	sd4pos: number | null;
  57 | };
  58 |
  59 | function parseNumericValue(value: string | undefined): number | null {
  60 | 	if (value === undefined || value.trim() === "") {
  61 | 		return null;
  62 | 	}
  63 | 	const parsed = Number.parseFloat(value);
  64 | 	return Number.isNaN(parsed) ? null : parsed;
  65 | }
  66 |
  67 | function calculateAgeInMonths(ageDays: number): number {
  68 | 	// Calculate age in months with better precision
  69 | 	return Number((ageDays / 30.4375).toFixed(2)); // Keep 2 decimal places for accuracy
  70 | }
  71 |
  72 | function mapDataPoint(dataPoint: ZScoreDataPoint, measurementType: string, gender: string): ValidatedGrowthRecord {
  73 | 	const ageDaysRaw = parseNumericValue(dataPoint.Day);
  74 | 	if (ageDaysRaw === null) {
  75 | 		throw new Error(`Invalid 'Day' value: ${dataPoint.Day}`);
  76 | 	}
  77 | 	const ageDays = Math.round(ageDaysRaw);
  78 | 	const ageInMonths = calculateAgeInMonths(ageDays);
  79 |
  80 | 	const lValue = parseNumericValue(dataPoint.L);
  81 | 	const mValue = parseNumericValue(dataPoint.M);
  82 | 	const sValue = parseNumericValue(dataPoint.S);
  83 | 	const sd0 = parseNumericValue(dataPoint.SD0);
  84 | 	const sd1neg = parseNumericValue(dataPoint.SD1neg);
  85 | 	const sd1pos = parseNumericValue(dataPoint.SD1);
  86 | 	const sd2neg = parseNumericValue(dataPoint.SD2neg);
  87 | 	const sd2pos = parseNumericValue(dataPoint.SD2);
  88 | 	const sd3neg = parseNumericValue(dataPoint.SD3neg);
  89 | 	const sd3pos = parseNumericValue(dataPoint.SD3);
  90 | 	const sd4neg = parseNumericValue(dataPoint.SD4neg);
  91 | 	const sd4pos = parseNumericValue(dataPoint.SD4);
  92 |
  93 | 	const requiredFields = {
  94 | 		lValue,
  95 | 		mValue,
  96 | 		sValue,
  97 | 		sd0,
  98 | 		sd1neg,
  99 | 		sd1pos,
 100 | 		sd2neg,
 101 | 		sd2pos,
 102 | 		sd3neg,
 103 | 		sd3pos
 104 | 	};
 105 |
 106 | 	for (const [key, value] of Object.entries(requiredFields)) {
 107 | 		if (value === null) {
 108 | 			throw new Error(`Missing or invalid required numeric field: ${key}`);
 109 | 		}
 110 | 	}
 111 |
 112 | 	const validatedFields = requiredFields as Record<keyof typeof requiredFields, number>;
 113 |
 114 | 	return {
 115 | 		id: randomUUID(),
 116 | 		ageInMonths,
 117 | 		ageDays,
 118 | 		gender,
 119 | 		measurementType,
 120 | 		lValue: validatedFields.lValue,
 121 | 		mValue: validatedFields.mValue,
 122 | 		sValue: validatedFields.sValue,
 123 | 		sd0: validatedFields.sd0,
 124 | 		sd1neg: validatedFields.sd1neg,
 125 | 		sd1pos: validatedFields.sd1pos,
 126 | 		sd2neg: validatedFields.sd2neg,
 127 | 		sd2pos: validatedFields.sd2pos,
 128 | 		sd3neg: validatedFields.sd3neg,
 129 | 		sd3pos: validatedFields.sd3pos,
 130 | 		sd4neg,
 131 | 		sd4pos
 132 | 	};
 133 | }
 134 |
 135 | export default async function wfaSeed(db: AppDb) {
 136 | 	console.log("--- Starting WHO Growth Standards Seeding ---");
 137 |
 138 | 	let whoJson: ZScoreData;
 139 | 	try {
 140 | 		whoJson = (await import(ZSCORE_DATA_PATH)).default as ZScoreData;
 141 | 		if (!whoJson?.wfa) {
 142 | 			throw new Error("JSON file is missing required 'wfa' data.");
 143 | 		}
 144 | 	} catch (error) {
 145 | 		console.error(`❌ Error reading or parsing WHO data file at ${ZSCORE_DATA_PATH}.`);
 146 | 		console.error(error instanceof Error ? error.message : "Unknown error");
 147 | 		return;
 148 | 	}
 149 |
 150 | 	const allRecords: ValidatedGrowthRecord[] = [];
 151 | 	let recordsSkipped = 0;
 152 |
 153 | 	console.log("Processing wfa data...");
 154 |
 155 | 	// Process boys data
 156 | 	if (whoJson.wfa.boys && Array.isArray(whoJson.wfa.boys)) {
```

```ts
 179 | // Helper functions
 180 | const getRandomEnumValue = <T>(enumObj: Record<string, T>): T => {
 181 | 	const enumValues = Object.values(enumObj) as T[];
 182 | 	if (enumValues.length === 0) {
 183 | 		throw new Error("Enum object has no values");
 184 | 	}
 185 | 	const index = Math.floor(Math.random() * enumValues.length);
 186 | 	const value = enumValues[index];
 187 | 	if (value === undefined) {
 188 | 		throw new Error("Failed to pick a random enum value");
 189 | 	}
 190 | 	return value;
 191 | };
 192 |
 193 | const getRandomSubset = <T>(array: T[], count: number): T[] => {
 194 | 	const shuffled = [...array].sort(() => 0.5 - Math.random());
 195 | 	return shuffled.slice(0, Math.min(count, shuffled.length));
 196 | };
 197 |
 198 | const weightedRandom = <T>(items: Array<{ item: T; weight: number }>): T => {
 199 | 	const total = items.reduce((sum, { weight }) => sum + weight, 0);
 200 | 	let random = Math.random() * total;
 201 |
 202 | 	if (items.length === 0) {
 203 | 		throw new Error("weightedRandom called with empty items");
 204 | 	}
 205 |
 206 | 	for (const { item, weight } of items) {
 207 | 		if (random < weight) return item;
 208 | 		random -= weight;
 209 | 	}
 210 |
 211 | 	const fallbackItem = items[0];
 212 | 	if (fallbackItem === undefined) {
 213 | 		throw new Error("weightedRandom: items[0] is undefined");
 214 | 	}
 215 | 	return fallbackItem.item;
 216 | };

 838 | // Create appointments
 839 | async function createAppointments(db: AppDb, patients: DbPatient[], doctors: DbDoctor[], services: DbService[]) {
 840 | 	console.log("📅 Creating appointments...");
 841 | 	const appointments: DbAppointment[] = [];
 842 |
 843 | 	for (let i = 0; i < CONFIG.totalAppointments; i++) {
 844 | 		const patient = faker.helpers.arrayElement(patients);
 845 | 		const doctor = faker.helpers.arrayElement(doctors);
 846 | 		const service = faker.helpers.arrayElement(services);
 847 | 		const clinicId = doctor.clinicId
 848 | 			? doctor.clinicId
 849 | 			: (faker.helpers.arrayElement([...new Set(patients.map(p => p.clinicId))]) ?? "");
 850 |
 851 | 		const status = weightedRandom([
 852 | 			{ item: AppointmentStatus.SCHEDULED, weight: 0.4 },
 853 | 			{ item: AppointmentStatus.COMPLETED, weight: 0.4 },
 854 | 			{ item: AppointmentStatus.CANCELLED, weight: 0.15 },
 855 | 			{ item: AppointmentStatus.PENDING, weight: 0.05 }
 856 | 		]);
 857 |
 858 | 		let appointmentDate: Date;
 859 | 		if (status === AppointmentStatus.COMPLETED) {
 860 | 			appointmentDate = faker.date.past({ years: 1 });
 861 | 		} else if (status === AppointmentStatus.SCHEDULED) {
 862 | 			appointmentDate = faker.date.future({ years: 0.5 });
 863 | 		} else {
 864 | 			const fromDate = faker.date.past({ years: 1 });
 865 | 			const toDate = faker.date.future({ years: 0.5 });
 866 | 			appointmentDate = faker.date.between({ from: fromDate, to: toDate });
 867 | 		}
 868 |
 869 | 		const appointmentData = {
 870 | 			id: faker.string.uuid(),
 871 | 			patientId: patient.id,
 872 | 			doctorId: doctor.id,

 877 | 			clinicId,
 878 | 			durationMinutes: faker.number.int({ min: 30, max: 120 }),
 879 | 			time: randomTime(),
 880 | 			status: status as string,
 881 | 			type: weightedRandom([
 882 | 				{ item: "Checkup", weight: 0.5 },
 883 | 				{ item: "Follow-up", weight: 0.3 },
 884 | 				{ item: "Emergency", weight: 0.1 },
 885 | 				{ item: "Consultation", weight: 0.1 }
 886 | 			]),

 890 | 			deletedAt: null,
```

`db/seed/wfa.ts`:

```ts
   1 | // scripts/seed-who-growth-data.ts
   2 |
   3 | import { randomUUID } from "node:crypto";
   4 | import fs from "node:fs";
   5 | import path from "node:path";
   6 |
   7 | import { db } from "../";
   8 | import { whoGrowthStandard } from "../schema";
   9 | import { Gender, MeasurementType } from "../seed/seed";
  10 |
  11 | type WHODayData = {
  12 | 	Day: string;
  13 | 	L: string;
  14 | 	M: string;
  15 | 	S: string;
  16 | 	SD4neg: string;
  17 | 	SD3neg: string;
  18 | 	SD2neg: string;
  19 | 	SD1neg: string;
  20 | 	SD0: string;
  21 | 	SD1: string;
  22 | 	SD2: string;
  23 | 	SD3: string;
  24 | 	SD4: string;
  25 | };
  26 |
  27 | type WHOData = {
  28 | 	wfa: {
  29 | 		boys: WHODayData[];
  30 | 		girls: WHODayData[];
  31 | 	};
  32 | };
  33 |
  34 | export default async function seedWHOGrowthData() {
  35 | 	console.log("🌱 Seeding WHO growth data...");
  36 |
  37 | 	// 1️⃣ Read JSON
  38 | 	const dataPath = path.join(process.cwd(), "data", "wfa.json");
  39 | 	const rawData = fs.readFileSync(dataPath, "utf-8");
  40 | 	const whoData = JSON.parse(rawData) as WHOData;
  41 |
  42 | 	// 2️⃣ Clear existing data (fastest & safest)
  43 | 	console.log("🗑️ Clearing existing WHO growth data...");
  44 | 	await db.delete(whoGrowthStandard).execute();
  45 |
  46 | 	const records: (typeof whoGrowthStandard.$inferInsert)[] = [];
  47 |
  48 | 	// 3️⃣ Boys
  49 | 	for (const dayData of whoData.wfa.boys) {
  50 | 		const ageDays = Number.parseInt(dayData.Day, 10);
  51 |
  52 | 		records.push({
  53 | 			id: randomUUID(),
  54 | 			ageDays,
  55 | 			ageInMonths: Math.floor(ageDays / 30.4375),
  56 | 			gender: Gender.MALE,
  57 | 			measurementType: MeasurementType.WFA,
  58 | 			lValue: Number(dayData.L),
  59 | 			mValue: Number(dayData.M),
  60 | 			sValue: Number(dayData.S),
  61 | 			sd0: Number(dayData.SD0),
  62 | 			sd1neg: Number(dayData.SD1neg),
  63 | 			sd1pos: Number(dayData.SD1),
  64 | 			sd2neg: Number(dayData.SD2neg),
  65 | 			sd2pos: Number(dayData.SD2),
  66 | 			sd3neg: Number(dayData.SD3neg),
  67 | 			sd3pos: Number(dayData.SD3),
  68 | 			sd4neg: Number(dayData.SD4neg),
  69 | 			sd4pos: Number(dayData.SD4)
  70 | 		});
  71 | 	}
  72 |
  73 | 	// 4️⃣ Girls
  74 | 	for (const dayData of whoData.wfa.girls) {
  75 | 		const ageDays = Number.parseInt(dayData.Day, 10);
  76 |
  77 | 		records.push({
  78 | 			id: randomUUID(),
  79 | 			ageDays,
  80 | 			ageInMonths: Math.floor(ageDays / 30.4375),
  81 | 			gender: Gender.FEMALE,
  82 | 			measurementType: MeasurementType.WFA,
  83 | 			lValue: Number(dayData.L),
  84 | 			mValue: Number(dayData.M),
  85 | 			sValue: Number(dayData.S),
  86 | 			sd0: Number(dayData.SD0),
  87 | 			sd1neg: Number(dayData.SD1neg),
  88 | 			sd1pos: Number(dayData.SD1),
  89 | 			sd2neg: Number(dayData.SD2neg),
  90 | 			sd2pos: Number(dayData.SD2),
  91 | 			sd3neg: Number(dayData.SD3neg),
  92 | 			sd3pos: Number(dayData.SD3),
  93 | 			sd4neg: Number(dayData.SD4neg),
  94 | 			sd4pos: Number(dayData.SD4)
  95 | 		});
  96 | 	}
  97 |
  98 | 	// 5️⃣ Batched insert (SQLite-safe)
  99 | 	const BATCH_SIZE = 1000;
 100 | 	let inserted = 0;
 101 |
 102 | 	for (let i = 0; i < records.length; i += BATCH_SIZE) {
 103 | 		const batch = records.slice(i, i + BATCH_SIZE);
 104 |
 105 | 		await db.insert(whoGrowthStandard).values(batch).execute();
 106 |
 107 | 		inserted += batch.length;
 108 | 		console.log(`  ✅ Inserted ${batch.length} records`);
 109 | 	}
 110 |
 111 | 	console.log(`🎉 Seeded ${inserted} WHO WFA records`);
 112 | }
```
