`hooks/use-breadcrumbs.tsx`:

```tsx
   1 | import { useLocation } from "@tanstack/react-router";
   2 | import { useMemo } from "react";
   3 |
   4 | type BreadcrumbItem = {
   5 | 	title: string;
   6 | 	link: string;
   7 | };
   8 |
   9 | // This allows to add custom title as well
  10 | const routeMapping: Record<string, BreadcrumbItem[]> = {
  11 | 	"/dashboard": [{ title: "Dashboard", link: "/dashboard" }],
  12 | 	"/dashboard/employee": [
  13 | 		{ title: "Dashboard", link: "/dashboard" },
  14 | 		{ title: "Employee", link: "/dashboard/employee" }
  15 | 	],
  16 | 	"/dashboard/product": [
  17 | 		{ title: "Dashboard", link: "/dashboard" },
  18 | 		{ title: "Product", link: "/dashboard/product" }
  19 | 	]
  20 | 	// Add more custom mappings as needed
  21 | };
  22 |
  23 | export function useBreadcrumbs() {
  24 | 	const { pathname } = useLocation();
  25 |
  26 | 	const breadcrumbs = useMemo(() => {
  27 | 		// Check if we have a custom mapping for this exact path
  28 | 		if (routeMapping[pathname]) {
  29 | 			return routeMapping[pathname];
  30 | 		}
  31 |
  32 | 		// If no exact match, fall back to generating breadcrumbs from the path
  33 | 		const segments = pathname.split("/").filter(Boolean);
  34 | 		return segments.map((segment, index) => {
  35 | 			const path = `/${segments.slice(0, index + 1).join("/")}`;
  36 | 			return {
  37 | 				title: segment.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + segment.slice(1),
  38 | 				link: path
  39 | 			};
  40 | 		});
  41 | 	}, [pathname]);
  42 |
  43 | 	return breadcrumbs;
  44 | }

```

`hooks/use-callback-ref.tsx`:

```tsx
   1 | import * as React from "react";
   2 |
   3 | /**
   4 |  * @see https://github.com/radix-ui/primitives/blob/main/packages/react/use-callback-ref/src/useCallbackRef.tsx
   5 |  */
   6 |
   7 | /**
   8 |  * A custom hook that converts a callback to a ref to avoid triggering re-renders when passed as a
   9 |  * prop or avoid re-executing effects when passed as a dependency
  10 |  */
  11 | function useCallbackRef<T extends (...args: never[]) => unknown>(callback: T | undefined): T {
  12 | 	const callbackRef = React.useRef(callback);
  13 |
  14 | 	React.useEffect(() => {
  15 | 		callbackRef.current = callback;
  16 | 	});
  17 |
  18 | 	// https://github.com/facebook/react/issues/19240
  19 | 	return React.useMemo(() => ((...args) => callbackRef.current?.(...args)) as T, []);
  20 | }
```

`hooks/use-controllable-state.tsx`:

```tsx
   1 | import * as React from "react";
   2 |
   3 | import { useCallbackRef } from "@/hooks/use-callback-ref";
   4 |
   5 | /**
   6 |  * @see https://github.com/radix-ui/primitives/blob/main/packages/react/use-controllable-state/src/useControllableState.tsx
   7 |  */
   8 |
   9 | type UseControllableStateParams<T> = {
  10 | 	prop?: T | undefined;
  11 | 	defaultProp?: T | undefined;
  12 | 	onChange?: (state: T) => void;
  13 | };
  14 |
  15 | type SetStateFn<T> = (prevState?: T) => T;
  16 |
  17 | function useControllableState<T>({ prop, defaultProp, onChange = () => {} }: UseControllableStateParams<T>) {
  18 | 	const [uncontrolledProp, setUncontrolledProp] = useUncontrolledState({
  19 | 		defaultProp,
  20 | 		onChange
  21 | 	});
  22 | 	const isControlled = prop !== undefined;
  23 | 	const value = isControlled ? prop : uncontrolledProp;
  24 | 	const handleChange = useCallbackRef(onChange);
  25 |
  26 | 	const setValue: React.Dispatch<React.SetStateAction<T | undefined>> = React.useCallback(
  27 | 		nextValue => {
  28 | 			if (isControlled) {
  29 | 				const setter = nextValue as SetStateFn<T>;
  30 | 				const value = typeof nextValue === "function" ? setter(prop) : nextValue;
  31 | 				if (value !== prop) handleChange(value as T);
  32 | 			} else {
  33 | 				setUncontrolledProp(nextValue);
  34 | 			}
  35 | 		},
  36 | 		[isControlled, prop, setUncontrolledProp, handleChange]
  37 | 	);
  38 |
  39 | 	return [value, setValue] as const;
  40 | }
  41 |
  42 | function useUncontrolledState<T>({ defaultProp, onChange }: Omit<UseControllableStateParams<T>, "prop">) {
  43 | 	const uncontrolledState = React.useState<T | undefined>(defaultProp);
  44 | 	const [value] = uncontrolledState;
  45 | 	const prevValueRef = React.useRef(value);
  46 | 	const handleChange = useCallbackRef(onChange);
  47 |
  48 | 	React.useEffect(() => {
  49 | 		if (prevValueRef.current !== value) {
  50 | 			handleChange(value as T);
  51 | 			prevValueRef.current = value;
  52 | 		}
  53 | 	}, [value, handleChange]);
  54 |
  55 | 	return uncontrolledState;
  56 | }
  57 |
  58 | export { useControllableState };
```

`hooks/use-debounce.tsx`:

```tsx
   1 | import { useEffect, useState } from "react";
   2 |
   3 | export function useDebounce<T>(value: T, delay: number): T {
   4 | 	const [debouncedValue, setDebouncedValue] = useState<T>(value);
   5 |
   6 | 	useEffect(() => {
   7 | 		const handler = setTimeout(() => {
   8 | 			setDebouncedValue(value);
   9 | 		}, delay);
  10 |
  11 | 		return () => {
  12 | 			clearTimeout(handler);
  13 | 		};
  14 | 	}, [value, delay]);
  15 |
  16 | 	return debouncedValue;
  17 | }
```

`hooks/use-debounced-callback.ts`:

```ts
   1 | import * as React from "react";
   2 |
   3 | import { useCallbackRef } from "@/hooks/use-callback-ref";
   4 |
   5 | export function useDebouncedCallback<T extends (...args: never[]) => unknown>(callback: T, delay: number) {
   6 | 	const handleCallback = useCallbackRef(callback);
   7 | 	const debounceTimerRef = React.useRef(0);
   8 | 	React.useEffect(() => () => window.clearTimeout(debounceTimerRef.current), []);
   9 |
  10 | 	const setValue = React.useCallback(
  11 | 		(...args: Parameters<T>) => {
  12 | 			window.clearTimeout(debounceTimerRef.current);
  13 | 			debounceTimerRef.current = window.setTimeout(() => handleCallback(...args), delay);
  14 | 		},
  15 | 		[handleCallback, delay]
  16 | 	);
  17 |
  18 | 	return setValue;
  19 | }
```

```ts
   1 | import { useMemo } from "react";

   3 | import type { NavGroup, NavItem } from "@/types";

   5 | /**
   6 |  * Hook to filter navigation items
   7 |  * RBAC has been removed — returns all items as-is

   9 | export function useFilteredNavItems(items: NavItem[]) {
  10 | 	return useMemo(() => {
  11 | 		return items.map(item => {
  12 | 			if (item.items && item.items.length > 0) {
  13 | 				return { ...item, items: [...item.items] };

  32 | 				items: filteredItems.filter(item =>
  33 | 					group.items.some(gi => gi.title === item.title && filteredSet.has(gi.title))
```

`hooks/use-pagination.ts`:

```ts
   1 | type UsePaginationProps = {
   2 | 	currentPage: number;
   3 | 	totalPages: number;
   4 | 	paginationItemsToDisplay: number;
   5 | };
   6 |
   7 | type UsePaginationReturn = {
   8 | 	pages: number[];
   9 | 	showLeftEllipsis: boolean;
  10 | 	showRightEllipsis: boolean;
  11 | };
  12 |
  13 | export function usePagination({
  14 | 	currentPage,
  15 | 	totalPages,
  16 | 	paginationItemsToDisplay
  17 | }: UsePaginationProps): UsePaginationReturn {
  18 | 	function calculatePaginationRange(): number[] {
  19 | 		if (totalPages <= paginationItemsToDisplay) {
  20 | 			return Array.from({ length: totalPages }, (_, i) => i + 1);
  21 | 		}
  22 |
  23 | 		const halfDisplay = Math.floor(paginationItemsToDisplay / 2);
  24 |
  25 | 		const initialRange = {
  26 | 			start: currentPage - halfDisplay,
  27 | 			end: currentPage + halfDisplay
  28 | 		};
  29 |
  30 | 		const adjustedRange = {
  31 | 			start: Math.max(1, initialRange.start),
  32 | 			end: Math.min(totalPages, initialRange.end)
  33 | 		};
  34 |
  35 | 		if (adjustedRange.start === 1) {
  36 | 			adjustedRange.end = Math.min(paginationItemsToDisplay, totalPages);
  37 | 		}
  38 |
  39 | 		if (adjustedRange.end === totalPages) {
  40 | 			adjustedRange.start = Math.max(1, totalPages - paginationItemsToDisplay + 1);
  41 | 		}
  42 |
  43 | 		return Array.from({ length: adjustedRange.end - adjustedRange.start + 1 }, (_, i) => adjustedRange.start + i);
  44 | 	}
  45 |
  46 | 	const pages = calculatePaginationRange();
  47 |
  48 | 	// Determine ellipsis display based on the actual pages shown
  49 | 	const showLeftEllipsis = pages.length > 0 && pages[0] > 1 && pages[0] > 2;
  50 |
  51 | 	const showRightEllipsis =
  52 | 		pages.length > 0 && pages[pages.length - 1] < totalPages && pages[pages.length - 1] < totalPages - 1;
  53 |
  54 | 	return {
  55 | 		pages,
  56 | 		showLeftEllipsis,
  57 | 		showRightEllipsis
  58 | 	};
  59 | }
```

`hooks/use-stepper.tsx`:

```tsx
   1 | import type { AnyFormApi } from "@tanstack/react-form";
   2 | import { useCallback, useState } from "react";
   3 | import type { ZodTypeAny } from "zod";
   4 |
   5 | /**
   6 |  * Options for handling cancel/back actions
   7 |  */
   8 | type HandleCancelOrBackOpts = {
   9 | 	onBack?: VoidFunction;
  10 | 	onCancel?: VoidFunction;
  11 | };
  12 |
  13 | /**
  14 |  * State of the current step
  15 |  */
  16 | type StepState = {
  17 | 	value: number;
  18 | 	count: number;
  19 | 	goToNextStep: () => void;
  20 | 	goToPrevStep: () => void;
  21 | 	isCompleted: boolean;
  22 | };
  23 |
  24 | /**
  25 |  * Hook for managing multi-step form navigation and validation
  26 |  *
  27 |  * @param schemas - Array of Zod schemas for each step
  28 |  * @returns Object with stepper state and methods
  29 |  */
  30 | export function useFormStepper(schemas: ZodTypeAny[]) {
  31 | 	const stepCount = schemas.length;
  32 | 	const [currentStep, setCurrentStep] = useState(1); // Start from 1
  33 |
  34 | 	const goToNextStep = useCallback(() => {
  35 | 		setCurrentStep(prev => Math.min(prev + 1, stepCount));
  36 | 	}, [stepCount]);
  37 |
  38 | 	const goToPrevStep = useCallback(() => {
  39 | 		setCurrentStep(prev => Math.max(prev - 1, 1));
  40 | 	}, []);
  41 |
  42 | 	const step: StepState = {
  43 | 		value: currentStep,
  44 | 		count: stepCount,
  45 | 		goToNextStep,
  46 | 		goToPrevStep,
  47 | 		isCompleted: currentStep === stepCount
  48 | 	};
  49 |
  50 | 	const currentValidator = schemas[currentStep - 1]; // Convert to 0-based for array access
  51 | 	const isFirstStep = currentStep === 1;
  52 |
  53 | 	const triggerFormGroup = async (form: AnyFormApi) => {
  54 | 		const result = currentValidator.safeParse(form.state.values);
  55 | 		if (!result.success) {
  56 | 			await form.handleSubmit({ step: String(currentStep) });
  57 | 			return result;
  58 | 		}
  59 |
  60 | 		return result;
  61 | 	};
  62 |
  63 | 	const handleNextStepOrSubmit = async (form: AnyFormApi) => {
  64 | 		const result = await triggerFormGroup(form);
  65 | 		if (!result.success) {
  66 | 			return;
  67 | 		}
  68 |
  69 | 		if (currentStep < stepCount) {
  70 | 			goToNextStep();
  71 | 			return;
  72 | 		}
  73 |
  74 | 		if (currentStep === stepCount) {
  75 | 			form.handleSubmit();
  76 | 		}
  77 | 	};
  78 |
  79 | 	const handleCancelOrBack = (opts?: HandleCancelOrBackOpts) => {
  80 | 		if (isFirstStep || step.isCompleted) {
  81 | 			opts?.onCancel?.();
  82 | 			return;
  83 | 		}
  84 |
  85 | 		if (currentStep > 1) {
  86 | 			opts?.onBack?.();
  87 | 			goToPrevStep();
  88 | 		}
  89 | 	};
  90 |
  91 | 	return {
  92 | 		step, // Current step state
  93 | 		currentStep, // Current step number (1-based)
  94 | 		isFirstStep, // Whether current step is the first step
  95 | 		currentValidator, // Zod schema for current step
  96 | 		triggerFormGroup, // Validate current step fields
  97 | 		handleNextStepOrSubmit, // Handle next/submit action
  98 | 		handleCancelOrBack // Handle back/cancel action
  99 | 	};
 100 | }
```

```ts
  11 | /**
  12 |  * Shared logic for session retrieval.
  13 |  * Kept as a standard function to avoid TanStack Start compiler collisions.
  14 |  */
  15 | async function fetchSessionInternal(query?: GetUserServerQuery) {
  16 | 	const request = getRequest();
  17 |
  18 | 	const session = await auth.api.getSession({
  19 | 		headers: request.headers,
  20 | 		query,

  28 | 	}
  29 |
  30 | 	return session;
  31 | }
```

`lib/compose-refs.ts`:

```ts
   1 | import * as React from "react";
   2 |
   3 | type PossibleRef<T> = React.Ref<T> | undefined;
   4 |
   5 | /**
   6 |  * Set a given ref to a given value
   7 |  * This utility takes care of different types of refs: callback refs and RefObject(s)
   8 |  */
   9 | function setRef<T>(ref: PossibleRef<T>, value: T) {
  10 | 	if (typeof ref === "function") {
  11 | 		return ref(value);
  12 | 	}
  13 |
  14 | 	if (ref !== null && ref !== undefined) {
  15 | 		ref.current = value;
  16 | 	}
  17 | }
  18 |
  19 | /**
  20 |  * A utility to compose multiple refs together
  21 |  * Accepts callback refs and RefObject(s)
  22 |  */
  23 | function composeRefs<T>(...refs: PossibleRef<T>[]): React.RefCallback<T> {
  24 | 	return node => {
  25 | 		let hasCleanup = false;
  26 | 		const cleanups = refs.map(ref => {
  27 | 			const cleanup = setRef(ref, node);
  28 | 			if (!hasCleanup && typeof cleanup === "function") {
  29 | 				hasCleanup = true;
  30 | 			}
  31 | 			return cleanup;
  32 | 		});
  33 |
  34 | 		// React <19 will log an error to the console if a callback ref returns a
  35 | 		// value. We don't use ref cleanups internally so this will only happen if a
  36 | 		// user's ref callback returns a value, which we only expect if they are
  37 | 		// using the cleanup functionality added in React 19.
  38 | 		if (hasCleanup) {
  39 | 			return () => {
  40 | 				for (let i = 0; i < cleanups.length; i++) {
  41 | 					const cleanup = cleanups[i];
  42 | 					if (typeof cleanup === "function") {
  43 | 						cleanup();
  44 | 					} else {
  45 | 						setRef(refs[i], null);
  46 | 					}
  47 | 				}
  48 | 			};
  49 | 		}
  50 | 	};
  51 | }
  52 |
  53 | /**
  54 |  * A custom hook that composes multiple refs
  55 |  * Accepts callback refs and RefObject(s)
  56 |  */
  57 | function useComposedRefs<T>(...refs: PossibleRef<T>[]): React.RefCallback<T> {
  58 | 	// biome-ignore lint/correctness/useExhaustiveDependencies: we want to memoize by all values
  59 | 	// eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps -- intentional: memoize by all ref values
  60 | 	return React.useCallback(composeRefs(...refs), refs);
  61 | }
  62 |
  63 | export { composeRefs, useComposedRefs };

```

```ts
   8 | 	const isLastLeftPinnedColumn = isPinned === "left" && column.getIsLastColumn("left");

  21 | 		width: column.getSize(),
  22 | 		zIndex: isPinned ? 1 : 0

  26 | export function getFilterOperators(filterVariant: FilterVariant) {

  28 | 		text: dataTableConfig.textOperators,
  29 | 		number: dataTableConfig.numericOperators,

  36 | 	};
  37 |
  38 | 	return operatorMap[filterVariant] ?? dataTableConfig.textOperators;

  42 | 	const operators = getFilterOperators(filterVariant);
  43 |
  44 | 	return operators[0]?.value ?? (filterVariant === "text" ? "iLike" : "eq");
  45 | }

  52 | 			(Array.isArray(filter.value)
```

```ts
  33 | 	for (const [key, schema] of Object.entries(CONFIG_DEF)) {
  34 | 		defaults[snakeToCamel(key)] = schema.parse(undefined);
  35 | 	}

  37 | 		...(defaults as CamelCaseKeys<ConfigState>),
  38 | 		baseUrl: process.env.AUTH_BASE_URL || "",
  39 | 		appName: process.env.APP_NAME || ""
  40 | 	};
  41 | };
  42 |
  43 | // ... (Logic for zShape, keyMap, and defaults remains the same)
  44 |
  45 | // 1. Convert Data Fetching to a Server Function
  46 | export const getSettings = async (): Promise<AppSettings> => {
  47 | 	let rows: { key: string; value: string }[];
  48 | 	try {
  49 | 		rows = await db.select().from(configStore);
  50 | 	} catch {
  51 | 		return getDefaults();
  52 | 	}
  53 |
  54 | 	const finalConfig: Record<string, unknown> = {};
  55 | 	const rawMap = new Map(rows.map(r => [r.key, r.value]));
  56 |
  57 | 	for (const [snakeKey, value] of Object.entries(CONFIG_DEF)) {
  58 | 		const camelKey = snakeToCamel(snakeKey);
  59 | 		const dbValue = rawMap.get(snakeKey);
  60 | 		const schema = value as z.ZodTypeAny;
  61 |
  62 | 		if (dbValue === undefined) {
  63 | 			finalConfig[camelKey] = schema.parse(undefined);
  64 | 		} else {
  65 | 			// Logic for parsing values from string back to their types
  66 | 			if (schema instanceof z.ZodDefault) {
  67 | 				const innerType = (schema as z.ZodDefault<z.ZodTypeAny>).def.innerType;
  68 | 				if (innerType instanceof z.ZodNumber) finalConfig[camelKey] = Number(dbValue);
  69 | 				else if (innerType instanceof z.ZodBoolean) finalConfig[camelKey] = dbValue === "true";
  70 | 				else finalConfig[camelKey] = dbValue;
  71 | 			} else {
  72 | 				finalConfig[camelKey] = dbValue;
  73 | 			}
  74 | 		}
  75 | 	}
  76 |
  77 | 	// Ensure database has all current keys
  78 | 	const missing = Object.keys(CONFIG_DEF).filter(k => !new Set(rows.map(r => r.key)).has(k));
  79 | 	if (missing.length > 0) {
  80 | 		const inserts = missing.map(k => ({
  81 | 			key: k,
  82 | 			value: String((CONFIG_DEF as Record<string, z.ZodTypeAny | undefined>)[k]?.parse(undefined))
  83 | 		}));
  84 | 		await db.insert(configStore).values(inserts).onConflictDoNothing().execute();
  85 | 	}
  86 |
  87 | 	return {
  88 | 		...(finalConfig as AppSettings),
  89 | 		baseUrl: process.env.AUTH_BASE_URL || "",
  90 | 		appName: process.env.APP_NAME || ""
  91 | 	};
  92 | };
```

```ts
  10 | export function formatBytes(bytes: number) {
  11 | 	if (bytes === 0) return "0 B";
  12 | 	const k = 1024;
  13 | 	const sizes = ["B", "KB", "MB", "GB", "TB"];
  14 | 	const i = Math.floor(Math.log(bytes) / Math.log(k));
  15 | 	return `${Number.parseFloat((bytes / k ** i).toFixed(2))} ${sizes[i]}`;
  16 | }
  17 |
  18 | export function parseBytes(input: string): number | null {
  19 | 	const units: Record<string, number> = {
  20 | 		b: 1,
  21 | 		kb: 1024,
  22 | 		mb: 1024 ** 2,
  23 | 		gb: 1024 ** 3,
  24 | 		tb: 1024 ** 4
  25 | 	};
  26 | 	const match = input.toLowerCase().match(/^(\d+(?:\.\d+)?)\s*([a-z]+)?$/);
  27 | 	if (!match) return null;
  28 | 	const value = Number.parseFloat(match[1]);
  29 | 	const unit = match[2] || "b";
  30 | 	if (!units[unit]) return null;
  31 | 	return Math.floor(value * units[unit]);
  32 | }
  33 |
  34 | export function formatDuration(ms: number): string {
  35 | 	if (ms < 1000) return `${ms}ms`;
  36 | 	const s = 1000;
  37 | 	const m = s * 60;
  38 | 	const h = m * 60;
  39 | 	const d = h * 24;
  40 |
  41 | 	if (ms >= d) return `${Number.parseFloat((ms / d).toFixed(2))}d`;
  42 | 	if (ms >= h) return `${Number.parseFloat((ms / h).toFixed(2))}h`;
  43 | 	if (ms >= m) return `${Number.parseFloat((ms / m).toFixed(2))}m`;
  44 | 	return `${Number.parseFloat((ms / s).toFixed(2))}s`;
  45 | }
  46 |
  47 | export function parseDuration(input: string): number | null {
  48 | 	const units: Record<string, number> = {
  49 | 		ms: 1,
  50 | 		s: 1000,
  51 | 		m: 1000 * 60,
  52 | 		h: 1000 * 60 * 60,
  53 | 		d: 1000 * 60 * 60 * 24
  54 | 	};
  55 | 	const match = input.toLowerCase().match(/^(\d+(?:\.\d+)?)\s*([a-z]+)?$/);
  56 | 	if (!match) return null;
  57 | 	const value = Number.parseFloat(match[1]);
  58 | 	const unit = match[2] || "ms";
  59 | 	if (!units[unit]) return null;
  60 | 	return Math.floor(value * units[unit]);

  63 | export function getStatusLabel(status: UploadStatus, progress: number): string {
  64 | 	switch (status) {
  65 | 		case "completed":
  66 | 			return "Done";
  67 | 		case "error":
  68 | 			return "Error";
  69 | 		case "pending":
  70 | 			return "Queued";

  72 | 			return "Paused";

  77 |
  78 | export function calculateGlobalProgress(
  79 | 	files: Array<{ id: string; file: File }>,
  80 | 	fileStatuses: Map<string, UploadStatus>,
  81 | 	fileProgress: Map<string, number>
  82 | ): {
  83 | 	completedCount: number;
  84 | 	globalProgress: number;
  85 | 	isGlobalComplete: boolean;
  86 | 	isGlobalError: boolean;
  87 | } {
  88 | 	if (files.length === 0) {
  89 | 		return {
  90 | 			completedCount: 0,
  91 | 			globalProgress: 0,
  92 | 			isGlobalComplete: false,
  93 | 			isGlobalError: false
  94 | 		};
  95 | 	}
  96 |
  97 | 	const completedCount = files.filter(f => fileStatuses.get(f.id) === "completed").length;
  98 |
  99 | 	const hasError = files.some(f => fileStatuses.get(f.id) === "error");
 100 |
 101 | 	const totalSize = files.reduce((acc, f) => acc + f.file.size, 0);
 102 | 	const loadedSize = files.reduce((acc, f) => {
 103 | 		const progress = fileProgress.get(f.id) || 0;
 104 | 		const status = fileStatuses.get(f.id);
 105 | 		const effectiveProgress = status === "completed" ? 100 : progress;
 106 | 		return acc + (f.file.size * effectiveProgress) / 100;
 107 | 	}, 0);
 108 |
 109 | 	return {
 110 | 		completedCount,
 111 | 		globalProgress: totalSize > 0 ? (loadedSize / totalSize) * 100 : 0,
 112 | 		isGlobalComplete: completedCount === files.length,
 113 | 		isGlobalError: hasError
 114 | 	};
 115 | }

 138 | export const snakeToCamel = (str: string): string => str.replace(/_([a-z])/g, g => g[1].toUpperCase());

 140 | export const camelToSnake = (str: string): string => str.replace(/[A-Z]/g, letter => `_${letter.toLowerCase()}`);
 141 |
 142 | const SLUG_CHARS = "abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789";
 143 | const SLUG_LENGTH = 6;
 144 | const MAX_SLUG_RETRIES = 10;
 145 |
 146 | export function generateSlug(): string {
 147 | 	let result = "";
 148 | 	const randomValues = crypto.getRandomValues(new Uint8Array(SLUG_LENGTH));
 149 | 	for (let i = 0; i < SLUG_LENGTH; i++) {
 150 | 		result += SLUG_CHARS[randomValues[i] % SLUG_CHARS.length];
 151 | 	}
 152 | 	return result;
 153 | }
 154 |
 155 | export async function generateUniqueSlug(checkExists: (slug: string) => boolean | Promise<boolean>): Promise<string> {
 156 | 	for (let attempt = 0; attempt < MAX_SLUG_RETRIES; attempt++) {
 157 | 		const slug = generateSlug();
 158 | 		const exists = await checkExists(slug);
 159 | 		if (!exists) {
 160 | 			return slug;
 161 | 		}
 162 | 	}
 163 | 	throw new Error("Failed to generate unique slug after maximum retries");
 164 | }
 165 |
 166 | export function ring(color = "ring-primary") {
 167 | 	return `focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-offset-2 focus-visible:outline-none ${color}`;
 168 | }
 169 |
 170 | export function getInitials(name: string) {
 171 | 	const parts = name.trim().split(/\s+/);
 172 | 	if (parts.length === 0) return "";
 173 | 	if (parts.length === 1) return parts[0].substring(0, 2).toUpperCase();
 174 | 	return (parts[0][0] + parts[parts.length - 1][0]).toUpperCase();
 175 | }
```

`mcp-todos.ts`:

```ts
   1 | import fs from "node:fs";
   2 |
   3 | const todosPath = "./mcp-todos.json";
   4 |
   5 | // In-memory todos storage
   6 | const todos = fs.existsSync(todosPath)
   7 | 	? JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(todosPath, "utf8"))
   8 | 	: [
   9 | 			{
  10 | 				id: 1,
  11 | 				title: "Buy groceries"
  12 | 			}
  13 | 		];
  14 |
  15 | // Subscription callbacks per userID
  16 | let subscribers: ((todos: Todo[]) => void)[] = [];
  17 |
  18 | export type Todo = {
  19 | 	id: number;
  20 | 	title: string;
  21 | };
  22 |
  23 | // Get the todos for a user
  24 | export function getTodos(): Todo[] {
  25 | 	return todos;
  26 | }
  27 |
  28 | // Add an item to the todos
  29 | export function addTodo(title: string) {
  30 | 	todos.push({ id: todos.length + 1, title });
  31 | 	fs.writeFileSync(todosPath, JSON.stringify(todos, null, 2));
  32 | 	notifySubscribers();
  33 | }
  34 |
  35 | // Subscribe to cart changes for a user
  36 | export function subscribeToTodos(callback: (todos: Todo[]) => void) {
  37 | 	subscribers.push(callback);
  38 | 	callback(todos);
  39 | 	return () => {
  40 | 		subscribers = subscribers.filter(cb => cb !== callback);
  41 | 	};
  42 | }
  43 |
  44 | // Notify all subscribers of a user's cart
  45 | function notifySubscribers() {
  46 | 	for (const cb of subscribers) {
  47 | 		try {
  48 | 			cb(todos);
  49 | 		} catch {}
  50 | 	}
  51 | }
```

`orpc/context.ts`:

```ts
   1 | // src/orpc/context.ts
   2 | import { ORPCError } from "@orpc/server";
   3 | import { getRequestHeaders } from "@tanstack/react-start/server";
   4 |
   5 | import { type AppDb, db } from "#/db";
   6 | import { type AuthSession, auth, type Clinic } from "#/lib/auth";
   7 |
   8 | import type { UserRole } from "../lib/permissions";
   9 |
  10 | export type OrpcContext = {
  11 | 	session: AuthSession["session"] | null;
  12 | 	auth: typeof auth;
  13 | 	user: AuthSession["user"] | null;
  14 | 	clinicId: string;
  15 | 	db: AppDb;
  16 | 	isAuthenticated: boolean;
  17 | 	clinic: AuthSession["user"]["primaryClinic"] | null;
  18 | 	ip?: string;
  19 | 	userAgent?: string;
  20 | 	headers: Headers;
  21 | 	requireRole: (role: UserRole) => void;
  22 | };
  23 |
  24 | // Make this sync by receiving auth data as parameter
  25 | export function createContextSync(data: {
  26 | 	session: AuthSession["session"] | null;
  27 | 	user: AuthSession["user"] | null;
  28 | 	clinic: AuthSession["user"]["primaryClinic"] | null;
  29 | 	headers: Headers;
  30 | }): OrpcContext {
  31 | 	return {
  32 | 		db,
  33 | 		auth,
  34 | 		user: data.user,
  35 | 		session: data.session,
  36 | 		clinic: data.clinic,
  37 | 		clinicId: data.user?.primaryClinic?.id ?? "",
  38 | 		ip: data.headers.get("x-forwarded-for") ?? data.headers.get("x-real-ip") ?? undefined,
  39 | 		userAgent: data.headers.get("user-agent") ?? undefined,
  40 | 		isAuthenticated: !!data.user,
  41 | 		headers: data.headers,
  42 | 		requireRole: (role: UserRole) => {
  43 | 			if (data.user?.role !== role) {
  44 | 				throw new ORPCError("FORBIDDEN");
  45 | 			}
  46 | 		}
  47 | 	};
  48 | }
  49 |
  50 | // Keep async version for compatibility
  51 | export async function createContext(options: CreateContextOptions = {}): Promise<OrpcContext> {
  52 | 	const headers = options.headers ?? getRequestHeaders();
  53 | 	const data = await auth.api.getSession({ headers });
  54 |
  55 | 	return createContextSync({
  56 | 		session: data?.session ?? null,
  57 | 		user: data?.user ?? null,
  58 | 		clinic: data?.user?.primaryClinic ?? null,
  59 | 		headers
  60 | 	});
  61 | }
  62 |
  63 | export type CreateContextOptions = {
  64 | 	request?: Request; // Optional request object for server context
  65 | 	headers?: Headers;
  66 | 	clinic?: Clinic; // Optional override for clinicId, if needed in special cases
  67 | };
  68 |
  69 | export type Context = Awaited<ReturnType<typeof createContext>>;
```

`orpc/init.ts`:

```ts
   1 | import { ORPCError, os } from "@orpc/server";
   2 | import { z } from "zod";
   3 |
   4 | import { db } from "#/db";
   5 | import { auth } from "#/lib/auth";
   6 |
   7 | import type { Context, OrpcContext } from "./context";
   8 |
   9 | // Define base with proper Context type
  10 | export const base = os.$context<Context>().errors({
  11 | 	UNAUTHORIZED: {
  12 | 		message: "Unauthorized access",
  13 | 		statusCode: 401
  14 | 	},
  15 | 	RATE_LIMITED: {
  16 | 		data: z.object({ retryAfter: z.number() }),
  17 | 		message: "You are being rate limited",
  18 | 		statusCode: 429
  19 | 	}
  20 | });
  21 |
  22 | // Helper to get session data consistently
  23 | async function getSessionData(headers: Headers) {
  24 | 	const sessionData = await auth.api.getSession({ headers });
  25 |
  26 | 	if (!sessionData?.session || !sessionData?.user) {
  27 | 		throw new ORPCError("UNAUTHORIZED");
  28 | 	}
  29 |
  30 | 	return sessionData;
  31 | }
  32 |
  33 | // Public DB middleware (no auth required)
  34 | export const dbMiddleware = base.middleware(async ({ next, context }) => {
  35 | 	return next({
  36 | 		context: {
  37 | 			...context,
  38 | 			db
  39 | 		}
  40 | 	});
  41 | });
  42 |
  43 | // Enhanced auth middleware with better error handling
  44 | export const authMiddleware = base.middleware(async ({ context, next }) => {
  45 | 	// Ensure headers exist (works with both server and client contexts)
  46 | 	const headers = context.headers ?? new Headers();
  47 | 	const sessionData = await getSessionData(headers);
  48 |
  49 | 	const requireRole = (role: string) => {
  50 | 		if (sessionData.user.role !== role) {
  51 | 			throw new ORPCError("FORBIDDEN", {
  52 | 				message: `Role ${role} required, got ${sessionData.user.role}`
  53 | 			});
  54 | 		}
  55 | 	};
  56 |
  57 | 	// Build enriched context
  58 | 	const enrichedContext: OrpcContext = {
  59 | 		db: context.db ?? db,
  60 | 		auth,
  61 | 		session: sessionData.session,
  62 | 		user: sessionData.user,
  63 | 		clinic: sessionData.user.primaryClinic ?? null,
  64 | 		clinicId: sessionData.user.primaryClinic?.id ?? "",
  65 | 		isAuthenticated: true,
  66 | 		ip: headers.get("x-forwarded-for") ?? headers.get("x-real-ip") ?? undefined,
  67 | 		userAgent: headers.get("user-agent") ?? undefined,
  68 | 		headers,
  69 | 		requireRole
  70 | 	};
  71 |
  72 | 	return next({
  73 | 		context: enrichedContext
  74 | 	});
  75 | });
  76 |
  77 | // Fixed: Role-specific middleware using base directly
  78 | // Updated role middleware to support multiple roles
  79 | export function requireRoleMiddleware(requiredRoles: string[]) {
  80 | 	return base.middleware(async ({ context, next }) => {
  81 | 		const ctx = context as OrpcContext;
  82 | 		if (!ctx.user || !requiredRoles.includes(ctx.user.role ?? "")) {
  83 | 			throw new ORPCError("FORBIDDEN", {
  84 | 				message: `One of roles [${requiredRoles.join(", ")}] required`
  85 | 			});
  86 | 		}
  87 | 		return next({ context });
  88 | 	});
  89 | }
  90 |
  91 | // Export pre‑configured bases
  92 | export const publicProcedure = base.use(dbMiddleware);
  93 | export const authorizedProcedure = base.use(authMiddleware);
  94 | export const protectedProcedure = authorizedProcedure.use(dbMiddleware);
  95 |
  96 | // Fixed: Create admin and staff procedures properly
  97 | // These should use authMiddleware first, then check roles
  98 | export const adminProcedure = base.use(authMiddleware).use(requireRoleMiddleware(["admin"]));
  99 |
 100 | export const clinicProcedure = base.use(authMiddleware).use(requireRoleMiddleware(["doctor", "staff", "admin"]));
 101 |
 102 | export const rateLimit = base.middleware(async ({ next }) => {
 103 | 	throw new ORPCError("RATE_LIMITED", {
 104 | 		message: "You are being rate limited",
 105 | 		data: { retryAfter: 60 }
 106 | 	});
 107 | 	return next();
 108 | });
 109 |
 110 | export function retry(options: { times: number }) {
 111 | 	/**
 112 | 	 * Best practices for dedupe-middlewares
 113 | 	 * {@link https://orpc.dev/docs/best-practices/dedupe-middleware}
 114 | 	 */
 115 | 	return os.$context<{ canRetry?: boolean }>().middleware(({ context, next }) => {
 116 | 		const canRetry = context.canRetry ?? true;
 117 |
 118 | 		if (!canRetry) {
 119 | 			return next();
 120 | 		}
 121 |
 122 | 		let times = 0;
 123 | 		while (true) {
 124 | 			try {
 125 | 				return next({
 126 | 					context: {
 127 | 						canRetry: false
 128 | 					}
 129 | 				});
 130 | 			} catch (e) {
 131 | 				if (times >= options.times) {
 132 | 					throw e;
 133 | 				}
 134 |
 135 | 				times++;
 136 | 			}
 137 | 		}
 138 | 	});
 139 | }
 140 | /* example for rate limit middleware
 141 | export const rateLimit = base
 142 | .use(rateLimit)
 143 | .errors({
 144 |   NOT_FOUND: {
 145 |     message: "Resource not found",
 146 |     statusCode: 404,
 147 |   },
 148 | })
 149 | .middleware(async ({ next }) => {
 150 |   // Implement your rate limiting logic here (e.g., using Redis or in-memory store)
 151 |   const isRateLimited = false; // Replace with actual check
 152 |
 153 |   if (isRateLimited) {
 154 |     throw new ORPCError("RATE_LIMITED", {
 155 |       message: "You are being rate limited",
 156 |       data: { retryAfter: 60 }, // Example: retry after 60 seconds
 157 |     });
 158 |   }
 159 |   return next();
 160 | })
 161 | */

```

`orpc/router/appointment.ts`:

```ts
   1 | import { and, between, desc, eq } from "drizzle-orm";
   2 | import { z } from "zod";
   3 |
   4 | import { db } from "../../db";
   5 | import { appointment } from "../../db/schema";
   6 | import { protectedProcedure } from "../init";
   7 | import { AppointmentsCreateSchema, AppointmentsUpdateSchema } from "../schema";
   8 |
   9 | // Create appointment
  10 | export const createAppointment = protectedProcedure
  11 | 	.input(AppointmentsCreateSchema)
  12 | 	.output(AppointmentsUpdateSchema)
  13 | 	.handler(async ({ input, context }) => {
  14 | 		// Check for conflicts
  15 | 		const existing = await db.query.appointment.findFirst({
  16 | 			where: and(
  17 | 				eq(appointment.doctorId, input.doctorId),
  18 | 				eq(appointment.appointmentDate, input.appointmentDate),
  19 | 				eq(appointment.status, "PENDING")
  20 | 			)
  21 | 		});
  22 |
  23 | 		if (existing) {
  24 | 			throw new Error("Doctor is already booked at this time");
  25 | 		}
  26 | 		if (!context.clinicId) {
  27 | 			throw new Error("Missing clinicId in context");
  28 | 		}
  29 |
  30 | 		const { clinicId, ...appointmentInput } = input;
  31 | 		const [newAppointment] = await db
  32 | 			.insert(appointment)
  33 | 			.values({
  34 | 				...appointmentInput,
  35 | 				clinicId: context.clinicId,
  36 | 				id: crypto.randomUUID()
  37 | 			})
  38 | 			.returning();
  39 | 		return newAppointment;
  40 | 	});
  41 |
  42 | export const getAppointments = protectedProcedure
  43 | 	.input(
  44 | 		z.object({
  45 | 			page: z.number().default(1),
  46 | 			limit: z.number().default(10),
  47 | 			status: z.string().optional(),
  48 | 			doctorId: z.string(),
  49 | 			patientId: z.string().optional()
  50 | 		})
  51 | 	)
  52 | 	.handler(async ({ input, context }) => {
  53 | 		const { page, limit, status, doctorId, patientId } = input;
  54 | 		const offset = (page - 1) * limit;
  55 |
  56 | 		const whereClause = and(
  57 | 			eq(appointment.clinicId, context.clinicId),
  58 | 			eq(appointment.isDeleted, false),
  59 | 			status ? eq(appointment.status, status) : undefined,
  60 | 			doctorId ? eq(appointment.doctorId, doctorId) : undefined,
  61 | 			patientId ? eq(appointment.patientId, patientId) : undefined
  62 | 		);
  63 |
  64 | 		const items = await db.query.appointment.findMany({
  65 | 			where: whereClause,
  66 | 			limit,
  67 | 			offset,
  68 | 			orderBy: desc(appointment.appointmentDate),
  69 | 			with: { patient: true, doctor: true }
  70 | 		});
  71 |
  72 | 		return { items, total: await db.$count(appointment, whereClause) };
  73 | 	});
  74 |
  75 | // Get appointments by date range
  76 | export const getAppointmentsByDateRange = protectedProcedure
  77 | 	.input(
  78 | 		z.object({
  79 | 			startDate: z.date(),
  80 | 			endDate: z.date(),
  81 | 			doctorId: z.string().optional(),
  82 | 			status: z.string().optional()
  83 | 		})
  84 | 	)
  85 | 	.output(z.array(AppointmentsUpdateSchema))
  86 | 	.handler(async ({ input, context }) => {
  87 | 		let whereClause = and(
  88 | 			eq(appointment.clinicId, context.clinicId),
  89 | 			between(appointment.appointmentDate, input.startDate, input.endDate),
  90 | 			eq(appointment.isDeleted, false)
  91 | 		);
  92 |
  93 | 		if (input.doctorId) {
  94 | 			whereClause = and(whereClause, eq(appointment.doctorId, input.doctorId));
  95 | 		}
  96 |
  97 | 		if (input.status) {
  98 | 			whereClause = and(whereClause, eq(appointment.status, input.status));
  99 | 		}
 100 |
 101 | 		return await db.query.appointment.findMany({
 102 | 			where: whereClause,
 103 | 			with: {
 104 | 				patient: true,
 105 | 				doctor: true
 106 | 			},
 107 | 			orderBy: desc(appointment.appointmentDate)
 108 | 		});
 109 | 	});
 110 |
 111 | export const updateAppointmentStatus = protectedProcedure
 112 | 	.input(
 113 | 		z.object({
 114 | 			id: z.string(),
 115 | 			status: z.enum(["PENDING", "CONFIRMED", "COMPLETED", "CANCELLED", "NO_SHOW"])
 116 | 		})
 117 | 	)
 118 | 	.output(AppointmentsUpdateSchema)
 119 | 	.handler(async ({ input, context }) => {
 120 | 		const [updated] = await db
 121 | 			.update(appointment)
 122 | 			.set({ status: input.status })
 123 | 			.where(and(eq(appointment.id, input.id), eq(appointment.clinicId, context.clinicId)))
 124 | 			.returning();
```

```ts
   1 | // routers/clinic.router.ts
   2 | import { and, eq, sql } from "drizzle-orm";

   5 | import { db } from "../../db";

   7 | import { adminProcedure } from "../init";

   9 | // Create clinic (admin only)

  11 | 	.input(
  12 | 		z.object({
  13 | 			name: z.string(),
  14 | 			email: z.email().optional(),
  15 | 			timezone: z.string().default("UTC"),
  16 | 			address: z.string().optional(),
  17 | 			phone: z.string().optional()
  18 | 		})
  19 | 	)
  20 | 	.output(z.any())
  21 | 	.handler(async ({ input }) => {
  22 | 		const [newClinic] = await db
  23 | 			.insert(clinics)
  24 | 			.values({
  25 | 				id: crypto.randomUUID(),
  26 | 				...input
  27 | 			})
  28 | 			.returning();
  29 |
  30 | 		// Create default clinic settings
  31 | 		await db.insert(clinicSetting).values({
  32 | 			id: crypto.randomUUID(),
  33 | 			clinicId: newClinic.id,
  34 | 			openingTime: "09:00",
  35 | 			closingTime: "17:00",
  36 | 			workingDays: JSON.stringify(["MONDAY", "TUESDAY", "WEDNESDAY", "THURSDAY", "FRIDAY"])
  37 | 		});
  38 |
  39 | 		return newClinic;
  40 | 	});
  41 |
  42 | // Add member to clinic
  43 | export const addClinicMember = adminProcedure
  44 | 	.input(
  45 | 		z.object({
  46 | 			clinicId: z.string(),
  47 | 			userId: z.string(),
  48 | 			role: z.enum(["ADMIN", "DOCTOR", "STAFF"])
  49 | 		})
  50 | 	)
  51 | 	.output(z.any())
  52 | 	.handler(async ({ input }) => {
  53 | 		const [member] = await db
  54 | 			.insert(clinicMembers)
  55 | 			.values({
  56 | 				userId: input.userId,
  57 | 				clinicId: input.clinicId,
  58 | 				role: input.role
  59 | 			})
  60 | 			.returning();
  61 |
  62 | 		// Update user's clinicId
  63 | 		await db.update(user).set({ clinicId: input.clinicId }).where(eq(user.id, input.userId));
  64 |
  65 | 		return member;
  66 | 	});
  67 |
  68 | export const getVitalSignsHistory = adminProcedure
  69 | 	.input(
  70 | 		z.object({
  71 | 			patientId: z.string(),
  72 | 			startDate: z.date().optional(),
  73 | 			endDate: z.date().optional()
  74 | 		})
  75 | 	)
  76 | 	.output(z.array(z.any()))
  77 | 	.handler(async ({ input }) => {
  78 | 		const conditions = [eq(vitalSign.patientId, input.patientId)];
  79 | 		if (input.startDate) {
  80 | 			conditions.push(sql`${vitalSign.createdAt} >= ${input.startDate.toISOString()}`);
  81 | 		}
  82 | 		if (input.endDate) {
  83 | 			conditions.push(sql`${vitalSign.createdAt} <= ${input.endDate.toISOString()}`);
  84 | 		}
  85 | 		const results = await db
  86 | 			.select()
  87 | 			.from(vitalSign)
  88 | 			.where(and(...conditions))
  89 | 			.orderBy(sql`${vitalSign.createdAt} DESC`);
  90 | 		return results;
  91 | 	});
  92 |
  93 | // Get clinic dashboard stats
  94 | export const getClinicStats = adminProcedure
  95 | 	.input(z.object({ clinicId: z.string() }))
  96 | 	.output(
  97 | 		z.object({
  98 | 			totalPatients: z.number(),
  99 | 			totalDoctors: z.number(),
 100 | 			totalAppointments: z.number(),
 101 | 			pendingAppointments: z.number(),
 102 | 			completedAppointments: z.number(),
 103 | 			revenue: z.number().optional()
 104 | 		})
 105 | 	)
 106 | 	.handler(async ({ input, context }) => {
 107 | 		// Check if user has access to this clinic
 108 | 		const member = await db.query.clinicMembers.findFirst({
 109 | 			where: and(eq(clinicMembers.clinicId, input.clinicId), eq(clinicMembers.userId, context.user?.id ?? ""))
 110 | 		});
 111 |
 112 | 		if (!member && context.user?.role !== "admin") {
 113 | 			throw new Error("Access denied");
 114 | 		}
 115 |
 116 | 		const stats = await db.transaction(async tx => {
 117 | 			const totalPatients = await tx.$count(
 118 | 				patient,
 119 | 				and(eq(patient.clinicId, input.clinicId), eq(patient.isDeleted, false))
 120 | 			);
 121 |
 122 | 			const totalDoctors = await tx.$count(
 123 | 				doctor,
 124 | 				and(eq(doctor.clinicId, input.clinicId), eq(doctor.isDeleted, false))
 125 | 			);
 126 |
 127 | 			const totalAppointments = await tx.$count(appointment, eq(appointment.clinicId, input.clinicId));
 128 |
 129 | 			const pendingAppointments = await tx.$count(
 130 | 				appointment,
 131 | 				and(eq(appointment.clinicId, input.clinicId), eq(appointment.status, "PENDING"))
 132 | 			);
 133 |
 134 | 			const completedAppointments = await tx.$count(
 135 | 				appointment,
 136 | 				and(eq(appointment.clinicId, input.clinicId), eq(appointment.status, "COMPLETED"))
 137 | 			);
 138 |
 139 | 			return {
 140 | 				totalPatients,
 141 | 				totalDoctors,
 142 | 				totalAppointments,
 143 | 				pendingAppointments,
 144 | 				completedAppointments
 145 | 			};
 146 | 		});
 147 |
 148 | 		return stats;
 149 | 	});
```

```ts
 628 | export const getRevenueOverview = dashboardProcedure
 629 | 	.input(
 630 | 		z.object({
 631 | 			startDate: z.coerce.date(),
 632 | 			endDate: z.coerce.date(),
 633 | 			groupBy: z.enum(["day", "week", "month"]).default("day")
 634 | 		})
 635 | 	)
 636 | 	.handler(async ({ context, input }) => {
 637 | 		const { db, clinicId } = context;
 638 | 		const { startDate, endDate, groupBy } = input;
 639 |
 640 | 		let groupByClause: string;
 641 | 		switch (groupBy) {
 642 | 			case "day":
 643 | 				groupByClause = "date(payment_date/1000, 'unixepoch')";
 644 | 				break;
 645 | 			case "week":
 646 | 				groupByClause = "strftime('%W', payment_date/1000, 'unixepoch')";
 647 | 				break;
 648 | 			case "month":
 649 | 				groupByClause = "strftime('%m', payment_date/1000, 'unixepoch')";
 650 | 				break;
 651 | 		}
 652 |
 653 | 		const revenue = await db
 654 | 			.select({
 655 | 				period: sql.raw(groupByClause),
 656 | 				total: sql<number>`sum(${payment.amountPaid})`,
 657 | 				count: sql<number>`count(*)`,
 658 | 				average: sql<number>`avg(${payment.amountPaid})`
 659 | 			})
 660 | 			.from(payment)
 661 | 			.where(
 662 | 				and(
 663 | 					eq(payment.clinicId, clinicId ?? ""),
 664 | 					eq(payment.status, "PAID"),
 665 | 					between(payment.paymentDate, startDate, endDate)
 666 | 				)
 667 | 			)
 668 | 			.groupBy(sql.raw(groupByClause));
 669 |
 670 | 		const totalRevenue = await db
 671 | 			.select({
 672 | 				sum: sql<number>`sum(${payment.amountPaid})`,
 673 | 				count: sql<number>`count(*)`
 674 | 			})
 675 | 			.from(payment)
 676 | 			.where(
 677 | 				and(
 678 | 					eq(payment.clinicId, clinicId ?? ""),
 679 | 					eq(payment.status, "PAID"),
 680 | 					gte(payment.paymentDate, startDate),
 681 | 					lte(payment.paymentDate, endDate)
 682 | 				)
 683 | 			);
 684 |
 685 | 		return {
 686 | 			revenue: revenue,
 687 | 			summary: {
 688 | 				total: totalRevenue[0]?.sum || 0,
 689 | 				transactionCount: totalRevenue[0]?.count || 0,
 690 | 				averageTransaction:
 691 | 					(totalRevenue[0]?.count || 0) > 0 ? (totalRevenue[0]?.sum || 0) / totalRevenue[0]?.count : 0
 692 | 			}
 693 | 		};
 694 | 	});

 696 | export const getPatientDemographics = dashboardProcedure.handler(async ({ context }) => {
 697 | 	const { db, clinicId } = context;
 698 |
 699 | 	const [ageGroups, genderDistribution, locations] = await Promise.all([
 700 | 		db
 701 | 			.select({
 702 | 				age_group: sql<string>`CASE
 703 | 				WHEN (strftime('%Y', 'now') - strftime('%Y', ${patient.dateOfBirth})) < 18 THEN '0-17'
 704 | 				WHEN (strftime('%Y', 'now') - strftime('%Y', ${patient.dateOfBirth})) BETWEEN 18 AND 30 THEN '18-30'
 705 | 				WHEN (strftime('%Y', 'now') - strftime('%Y', ${patient.dateOfBirth})) BETWEEN 31 AND 50 THEN '31-50'
 706 | 				WHEN (strftime('%Y', 'now') - strftime('%Y', ${patient.dateOfBirth})) BETWEEN 51 AND 70 THEN '51-70'
 707 | 				ELSE '70+'
 708 | 			END`,
 709 | 				count: sql<number>`count(*)`
 710 | 			})
 711 | 			.from(patient)
 712 | 			.where(and(eq(patient.clinicId, clinicId ?? ""), eq(patient.isDeleted, false)))
 713 | 			.groupBy(sql`age_group`),
 714 | 		db
 715 | 			.select({ gender: patient.gender, count: sql`count(*)` })
 716 | 			.from(patient)
 717 | 			.where(and(eq(patient.clinicId, clinicId ?? ""), eq(patient.isDeleted, false)))
 718 | 			.groupBy(patient.gender),
 719 | 		db
 720 | 			.select({ address: patient.address, count: sql`count(*)` })
 721 | 			.from(patient)
 722 | 			.where(and(eq(patient.clinicId, clinicId ?? ""), eq(patient.isDeleted, false), ne(patient.address, "")))
 723 | 			.groupBy(patient.address)
 724 | 			.orderBy(desc(sql`count(*)`))
 725 | 			.limit(10)
 726 | 	]);
 727 |
 728 | 	return {
 729 | 		ageGroups: ageGroups,
 730 | 		genderDistribution,
 731 | 		topLocations: locations
 732 | 	};
 733 | });

 735 | export const getDoctorPerformance = dashboardProcedure
 736 | 	.input(
 737 | 		z.object({
 738 | 			period: z.enum(["week", "month", "year"]).default("month"),
 739 | 			doctorId: z.string().optional()
 740 | 		})
 741 | 	)
 742 | 	.handler(async ({ context, input }) => {
 743 | 		const { db, clinicId } = context;
 744 |
 745 | 		// Safety check for clinic context
 746 | 		if (!clinicId) {
 747 | 			throw new Error("Clinic context not found");
 748 | 		}
 749 |
 750 | 		const { period, doctorId } = input;
 751 |
 752 | 		const startDate = new Date();
 753 | 		switch (period) {
 754 | 			case "week":
 755 | 				startDate.setDate(startDate.getDate() - 7);
 756 | 				break;
 757 | 			case "month":
 758 | 				startDate.setMonth(startDate.getMonth() - 1);
 759 | 				break;
 760 | 			case "year":
 761 | 				startDate.setFullYear(startDate.getFullYear() - 1);
 762 | 				break;
 763 | 		}

 765 | 		const doctorsList = await db.query.doctor.findMany({
 766 | 			where: and(

 769 | 				doctorId ? eq(doctor.id, doctorId) : undefined
 770 | 			),

 772 | 				appointments: {
 773 | 					where: gte(appointment.appointmentDate, startDate)
 774 | 				}
 775 | 			}
 776 | 		});

 788 | 		}));
```

```ts
 407 | 			whereClause = and(whereClause, eq(doctor.isActive, isActive));
 408 | 		}
 409 |
 410 | 		if (specialty) {
 411 | 			whereClause = and(whereClause, eq(doctor.specialty, specialty));
 412 | 		}

 415 | 			sortBy === "name"
 416 | 				? doctor.name
 417 | 				: sortBy === "rating"
 418 | 					? doctor.rating
 419 | 					: sortBy === "specialty"
 420 | 						? doctor.specialty
 421 | 						: doctor.createdAt;

 423 | 		const orderBy = sortOrder === "asc" ? sortColumn : desc(sortColumn);

 443 | 						name: true
 444 | 					}
 445 | 				}
 446 | 			}
 447 | 		});

 488 | // Get doctor statistics
 489 | export const getDoctorStatistics = protectedProcedure
 490 | 	.input(
 491 | 		z.object({
 492 | 			doctorId: z.string(),
 493 | 			startDate: z.date().optional(),
 494 | 			endDate: z.date().optional()
 495 | 		})
 496 | 	)
 497 | 	.output(
 498 | 		z.object({
 499 | 			totalAppointments: z.number(),
 500 | 			completedAppointments: z.number(),
 501 | 			cancelledAppointments: z.number(),
 502 | 			averageRating: z.number().nullable(),
 503 | 			totalPatients: z.number(),
 504 | 			totalRevenue: z.number(),
 505 | 			upcomingAppointments: z.number()
 506 | 		})
 507 | 	)
 508 | 	.handler(async ({ input }) => {
 509 | 		const { doctorId, startDate, endDate } = input;
 510 |
 511 | 		let appointmentFilter: SQL | undefined;
 512 |
 513 | 		if (startDate) {
 514 | 			appointmentFilter = and(appointmentFilter, sql`appointment_date >= ${startDate}`);
 515 | 		}
 516 |
 517 | 		if (endDate) {
 518 | 			appointmentFilter = and(appointmentFilter, sql`appointment_date <= ${endDate}`);
 519 | 		}
 520 |
 521 | 		const appointments = await db.query.appointment.findMany({
 522 | 			where: and(eq(sql`doctor_id`, doctorId), appointmentFilter, eq(sql`is_deleted`, false))
 523 | 		});
 524 |
 525 | 		const totalAppointments = appointments.length;
 526 | 		const completedAppointments = appointments.filter(a => a.status === "COMPLETED").length;
 527 | 		const cancelledAppointments = appointments.filter(a => a.status === "CANCELLED").length;
 528 |
 529 | 		const upcomingAppointments = appointments.filter(a => {
 530 | 			const appointmentDate = new Date(a.appointmentDate);
 531 | 			return appointmentDate > new Date() && (a.status === "SCHEDULED" || a.status === "PENDING");
 532 | 		}).length;
 533 |
 534 | 		const uniquePatients = new Set(appointments.map(a => a.patientId)).size;
 535 |
 536 | 		const totalRevenue = appointments
 537 | 			.filter(a => a.status === "COMPLETED" && a.appointmentPrice)
 538 | 			.reduce((sum, a) => sum + (a.appointmentPrice || 0), 0);
 539 |
 540 | 		const doctorRating = await db.query.doctor.findFirst({
 541 | 			where: eq(doctor.id, doctorId),
 542 | 			columns: { rating: true }
 543 | 		});
 544 |
 545 | 		return {
 546 | 			totalAppointments,
 547 | 			completedAppointments,
 548 | 			cancelledAppointments,
 549 | 			averageRating: doctorRating?.rating || null,
 550 | 			totalPatients: uniquePatients,
 551 | 			totalRevenue,
 552 | 			upcomingAppointments
 553 | 		};
 554 | 	});
```

```ts
 585 | 		const conditions = and(

 588 | 			input.doctorId ? eq(diagnosis.doctorId, input.doctorId) : undefined,
 589 | 			input.startDate ? sql`${diagnosis.date} >= ${input.startDate}` : undefined,
 590 | 			input.endDate ? sql`${diagnosis.date} <= ${input.endDate}` : undefined
 591 | 		);
 592 |
 593 | 		const allEncounters = await db.query.diagnosis.findMany({
 594 | 			where: conditions
 595 | 		});
 596 |
 597 | 		const totalEncounters = allEncounters.length;

 599 | 		const completedEncounters = allEncounters.filter(e => e.status === "COMPLETED").length;

 602 | 		const dates = allEncounters.map(e => e.date.toDateString());
 603 | 		const uniqueDates = new Set(dates);
 604 | 		const avgPerDay = uniqueDates.size > 0 ? totalEncounters / uniqueDates.size : 0;
 605 |
 606 | 		// Get top diagnoses
 607 | 		const diagnosisCounts = new Map<string, number>();

 609 | 			if (encounter.diagnosis) {
 610 | 				diagnosisCounts.set(encounter.diagnosis, (diagnosisCounts.get(encounter.diagnosis) || 0) + 1);
 611 | 			}
 612 | 		}
 613 | 		const topDiagnosis = Array.from(diagnosisCounts.entries())
 614 | 			.map(([diagnosis, count]) => ({ diagnosis, count }))
 615 | 			.sort((a, b) => b.count - a.count)
 616 | 			.slice(0, 5);

 619 | 		const typeCounts = new Map<string, number>();
 620 | 		for (const diagnosis of allEncounters) {
 621 | 			typeCounts.set(diagnosis.type ?? "", (typeCounts.get(diagnosis.type ?? "") || 0) + 1);
 622 | 		}
 623 | 		const encountersByType = Array.from(typeCounts.entries()).map(([type, count]) => ({ type, count }));
 624 |
 625 | 		return {
 626 | 			totalEncounters,
 627 | 			activeEncounters,
 628 | 			completedEncounters,

 631 | 			encountersByType
 632 | 		};
 633 | 	});
```

```ts
  47 | // Record growth measurement
  48 | export const recordGrowth = clinicProcedure
  49 | 	.input(
  50 | 		z.object({
  51 | 			patientId: z.string(),
  52 | 			date: z.date(),
  53 | 			weight: z.number().optional(),

  55 | 			headCircumference: z.number().optional(),
  56 | 			notes: z.string().optional()
  57 | 		})
  58 | 	)
  59 | 	.handler(async ({ input, context }) => {
  60 | 		const patientData = await db.query.patient.findFirst({
  61 | 			where: eq(patient.id, input.patientId)
  62 | 		});
  63 |
  64 | 		if (!patientData) throw new Error("Patient not found");
  65 |
  66 | 		// Calculate age in months and days
  67 | 		const ageInMonths = calculateAgeInMonths(patientData.dateOfBirth, input.date);
  68 | 		const ageInDays = calculateAgeInDays(patientData.dateOfBirth, input.date);
  69 |
  70 | 		if (!patientData.gender) {
  71 | 			throw new Error("Patient gender is required");
  72 | 		}
  73 | 		const gender = patientData.gender;
  74 |

  76 | 		let weightForAgeZ = null;
  77 | 		let heightForAgeZ = null;
  78 | 		let hcForAgeZ = null;
  79 | 		let bmiForAgeZ = null;
  80 |
  81 | 		if (input.weight) {
  82 | 			const weightStandard = await getWHOStandard(ageInDays, gender, "WFA");
  83 | 			if (weightStandard) {
  84 | 				weightForAgeZ = calculateZScore(
  85 | 					input.weight,
  86 | 					weightStandard.mValue,
  87 | 					weightStandard.lValue,
  88 | 					weightStandard.sValue
  89 | 				);
  90 | 			}
  91 | 		}
  92 |
  93 | 		if (input.height) {
  94 | 			const heightStandard = await getWHOStandard(ageInDays, gender, "HFA");
  95 | 			if (heightStandard) {
  96 | 				heightForAgeZ = calculateZScore(
  97 | 					input.height,
  98 | 					heightStandard.mValue,
  99 | 					heightStandard.lValue,
 100 | 					heightStandard.sValue
 101 | 				);
 102 | 			}
 103 | 		}
 104 |
 105 | 		if (input.headCircumference) {
 106 | 			const hcStandard = await getWHOStandard(ageInDays, gender, "HcFA");
 107 | 			if (hcStandard) {
 108 | 				hcForAgeZ = calculateZScore(
 109 | 					input.headCircumference,
 110 | 					hcStandard.mValue,
 111 | 					hcStandard.lValue,
 112 | 					hcStandard.sValue
 113 | 				);
 114 | 			}
 115 | 		}
 116 |
 117 | 		// Calculate BMI if both weight and height are provided
 118 | 		if (input.weight && input.height) {
 119 | 			const heightInMeters = input.height / 100;
 120 | 			bmiForAgeZ = input.weight / (heightInMeters * heightInMeters);
 121 |
 122 | 			const bmiStandard = await getWHOStandard(ageInDays, gender, "BMI");
 123 | 			if (bmiStandard) {
 124 | 				bmiForAgeZ = calculateZScore(bmiForAgeZ, bmiStandard.mValue, bmiStandard.lValue, bmiStandard.sValue);
 125 | 			}
 126 | 		}
 127 |
 128 | 		const [record] = await db
 129 | 			.insert(growthRecord)
 130 | 			.values({
 131 | 				id: crypto.randomUUID(),
 132 | 				clinicId: context.clinicId,
 133 | 				patientId: input.patientId,
 134 | 				gender: patientData.gender,
 135 | 				ageDays: ageInDays,
 136 | 				ageMonths: ageInMonths,
 137 | 				date: input.date,
 138 | 				recordedAt: new Date(),
 139 | 				weight: input.weight,

 141 | 				headCircumference: input.headCircumference,
 142 | 				weightForAgeZ,
 143 | 				heightForAgeZ,

 153 | 	});

 185 | 		return chartData;
 186 | 	});
 187 |
 188 | // Update growth measurement
 189 | export const updateGrowthMeasurement = clinicProcedure
 190 | 	.input(
 191 | 		z.object({
 192 | 			id: z.string(),
 193 | 			date: z.date().optional(),
 194 | 			weight: z.number().optional(),
 195 | 			height: z.number().optional(),
 196 | 			headCircumference: z.number().optional(),
 197 | 			notes: z.string().optional()
 198 | 		})
 199 | 	)
 200 | 	.handler(async ({ input, context }) => {
 201 | 		const existing = await db.query.growthRecord.findFirst({
 202 | 			where: and(eq(growthRecord.id, input.id), eq(growthRecord.clinicId, context.clinicId))
 203 | 		});
 204 |
 205 | 		if (!existing) throw new Error("Growth record not found");
 206 |
 207 | 		const patientData = await db.query.patient.findFirst({
 208 | 			where: eq(patient.id, existing.patientId)
 209 | 		});
 210 |
 211 | 		if (!patientData) throw new Error("Patient not found");
 212 |
 213 | 		const recordDate = input.date || existing.date;
 214 | 		const ageInMonths = calculateAgeInMonths(patientData.dateOfBirth, recordDate);
 215 | 		const ageInDays = calculateAgeInDays(patientData.dateOfBirth, recordDate);
 216 |
 217 | 		const gender = patientData.gender || existing.gender;
 218 |
 219 | 		let weightForAgeZ = existing.weightForAgeZ;
 220 | 		let heightForAgeZ = existing.heightForAgeZ;
 221 | 		let hcForAgeZ = existing.hcForAgeZ;
 222 | 		let bmiForAgeZ = existing.bmiForAgeZ;
 223 |
 224 | 		const weight = input.weight ?? existing.weight;
 225 | 		const height = input.height ?? existing.height;
 226 | 		const headCircumference = input.headCircumference ?? existing.headCircumference;
 227 |
 228 | 		if (weight && gender) {
 229 | 			const weightStandard = await getWHOStandard(ageInDays, gender, "WFA");
 230 | 			if (weightStandard) {
 231 | 				weightForAgeZ = calculateZScore(
 232 | 					weight,
 233 | 					weightStandard.mValue,
 234 | 					weightStandard.lValue,
 235 | 					weightStandard.sValue
 236 | 				);
 237 | 			}
 238 | 		}
 239 |
 240 | 		if (height && gender) {
 241 | 			const heightStandard = await getWHOStandard(ageInDays, gender, "HFA");
 242 | 			if (heightStandard) {
 243 | 				heightForAgeZ = calculateZScore(
 244 | 					height,
 245 | 					heightStandard.mValue,
 246 | 					heightStandard.lValue,
 247 | 					heightStandard.sValue
 248 | 				);
 249 | 			}
 250 | 		}
 251 |
 252 | 		if (headCircumference && gender) {
 253 | 			const hcStandard = await getWHOStandard(ageInDays, gender, "HcFA");
 254 | 			if (hcStandard) {
 255 | 				hcForAgeZ = calculateZScore(headCircumference, hcStandard.mValue, hcStandard.lValue, hcStandard.sValue);
 256 | 			}
 257 | 		}
 258 |
 259 | 		if (weight && height && gender) {
 260 | 			const heightInMeters = height / 100;
 261 | 			const bmi = weight / (heightInMeters * heightInMeters);
 262 | 			const bmiStandard = await getWHOStandard(ageInDays, gender, "BMI");
 263 | 			if (bmiStandard) {
 264 | 				bmiForAgeZ = calculateZScore(bmi, bmiStandard.mValue, bmiStandard.lValue, bmiStandard.sValue);
 265 | 			}
 266 | 		}
 267 |
 268 | 		const [updated] = await db
 269 | 			.update(growthRecord)
 270 | 			.set({
 271 | 				date: recordDate,
 272 | 				ageDays: ageInDays,
 273 | 				ageMonths: ageInMonths,
 274 | 				weight,
 275 | 				height,
 276 | 				headCircumference,
 277 | 				weightForAgeZ,
 278 | 				heightForAgeZ,
 279 | 				hcForAgeZ,
 280 | 				bmiForAgeZ,
 281 | 				notes: input.notes ?? existing.notes,
 282 | 				updatedAt: new Date()
 283 | 			})
 284 | 			.where(and(eq(growthRecord.id, input.id), eq(growthRecord.clinicId, context.clinicId)))
 285 | 			.returning();
 286 |
 287 | 		return updated;
 288 | 	});
 289 |
 290 | // Delete growth measurement
 291 | export const deleteGrowthMeasurement = clinicProcedure
 292 | 	.input(
 293 | 		z.object({
 294 | 			id: z.string()
 295 | 		})
 296 | 	)
 297 | 	.handler(async ({ input, context }) => {
 298 | 		const [deleted] = await db
 299 | 			.delete(growthRecord)
 300 | 			.where(and(eq(growthRecord.id, input.id), eq(growthRecord.clinicId, context.clinicId)))
 301 | 			.returning();
 302 |
 303 | 		if (!deleted) throw new Error("Growth record not found");
 304 |
 305 | 		return { success: true, id: deleted.id };
 306 | 	});
 307 |
 308 | // Get growth percentile classification
 309 | export const getGrowthPercentile = clinicProcedure
 310 | 	.input(
 311 | 		z.object({
 312 | 			patientId: z.string(),
 313 | 			date: z.date().optional()
 314 | 		})
 315 | 	)
 316 | 	.handler(async ({ input, context }) => {
 317 | 		const patientData = await db.query.patient.findFirst({
 318 | 			where: eq(patient.id, input.patientId)
 319 | 		});
 320 |
 321 | 		if (!patientData) throw new Error("Patient not found");
 322 |
 323 | 		const referenceDate = input.date || new Date();
 324 | 		const ageDays = calculateAgeInDays(patientData.dateOfBirth, referenceDate);
 325 | 		const ageMonths = calculateAgeInMonths(patientData.dateOfBirth, referenceDate);
 326 |
 327 | 		const latestRecord = await db.query.growthRecord.findFirst({
 328 | 			where: and(eq(growthRecord.patientId, input.patientId), eq(growthRecord.clinicId, context.clinicId)),
 329 | 			orderBy: (growthRecord, { desc }) => [desc(growthRecord.date)]
 330 | 		});
 331 |
 332 | 		if (!latestRecord) {
 333 | 			return {
 334 | 				ageDays,
 335 | 				ageMonths,
 336 | 				classifications: null
 337 | 			};
 338 | 		}
 339 |
 340 | 		const getClassification = (zScore: number | null): string => {
 341 | 			if (zScore === null) return "NO_DATA";
 342 | 			if (zScore < -3) return "SEVERELY_UNDERWEIGHT";
 343 | 			if (zScore < -2) return "UNDERWEIGHT";
 344 | 			if (zScore <= 1) return "NORMAL";
 345 | 			if (zScore <= 2) return "OVERWEIGHT";
 346 | 			return "OBESE";
 347 | 		};
 348 |
 349 | 		const getStuntingClassification = (zScore: number | null): string => {
 350 | 			if (zScore === null) return "NO_DATA";
 351 | 			if (zScore < -3) return "SEVERELY_STUNTED";
 352 | 			if (zScore < -2) return "STUNTED";
 353 | 			if (zScore <= 1) return "NORMAL";
 354 | 			if (zScore <= 2) return "TALL";
 355 | 			return "VERY_TALL";
 356 | 		};
 357 |
 358 | 		return {
 359 | 			ageDays,
 360 | 			ageMonths,
 361 | 			classifications: {
 362 | 				weight: {
 363 | 					zScore: latestRecord.weightForAgeZ,
 364 | 					classification: getClassification(latestRecord.weightForAgeZ)
 365 | 				},
 366 | 				height: {
 367 | 					zScore: latestRecord.heightForAgeZ,
 368 | 					classification: getStuntingClassification(latestRecord.heightForAgeZ)
 369 | 				},
 370 | 				headCircumference: {
 371 | 					zScore: latestRecord.hcForAgeZ,
 372 | 					classification: getClassification(latestRecord.hcForAgeZ)
 373 | 				},
 374 | 				bmi: {
 375 | 					zScore: latestRecord.bmiForAgeZ,
 376 | 					classification: getClassification(latestRecord.bmiForAgeZ)
 377 | 				}
 378 | 			},
 379 | 			lastMeasurement: latestRecord
 380 | 		};
 381 | 	});

```

`orpc/router/immunization.ts`:

```ts
   1 | // routers/immunization.router.ts
   2 | import { and, eq } from "drizzle-orm";
   3 | import { z } from "zod";
   4 |
   5 | import { db } from "../../db";
   6 | import { immunization, patient } from "../../db/schema";
   7 | import { protectedProcedure } from "../init";
   8 |
   9 | // Record immunization
  10 | export const recordImmunization = protectedProcedure
  11 | 	.input(
  12 | 		z.object({
  13 | 			patientId: z.string(),
  14 | 			vaccine: z.string(),
  15 | 			date: z.date(),
  16 | 			dose: z.string(),
  17 | 			lotNumber: z.string().optional(),
  18 | 			administeredByStaffId: z.string().optional(),
  19 | 			notes: z.string().optional()
  20 | 		})
  21 | 	)
  22 | 	.output(z.any())
  23 | 	.handler(async ({ input, context }) => {
  24 | 		const [record] = await db
  25 | 			.insert(immunization)
  26 | 			.values({
  27 | 				id: crypto.randomUUID(),
  28 | 				clinicId: context.clinicId,
  29 | 				...input
  30 | 			})
  31 | 			.returning();
  32 | 		return record;
  33 | 	});
  34 |
  35 | // Get immunization schedule for patient
  36 | export const getPatientImmunizationSchedule = protectedProcedure
  37 | 	.input(z.object({ patientId: z.string() }))
  38 | 	.output(z.any())
  39 | 	.handler(async ({ input }) => {
  40 | 		// Get patient age
  41 | 		const patientData = await db.query.patient.findFirst({
  42 | 			where: eq(patient.id, input.patientId)
  43 | 		});
  44 |
  45 | 		if (!patientData) throw new Error("Patient not found");
  46 |
  47 | 		const ageInDays = Math.floor((Date.now() - patientData.dateOfBirth.getTime()) / (1000 * 60 * 60 * 24));
  48 |
  49 | 		// Get due vaccines based on age
  50 | 		const dueVaccines = await db.query.vaccineSchedule.findMany({
  51 | 			where: (vaccineSchedule, { lte, and: andV }) =>
  52 | 				andV(lte(vaccineSchedule.ageInDaysMin, ageInDays), lte(vaccineSchedule.ageInDaysMax, ageInDays))
  53 | 		});
  54 |
  55 | 		// Get administered vaccines
  56 | 		const administered = await db.query.immunization.findMany({
  57 | 			where: and(eq(immunization.patientId, input.patientId), eq(immunization.isDeleted, false))
  58 | 		});
  59 |
  60 | 		// Filter out vaccines that have been administered
  61 | 		const pendingVaccines = dueVaccines.filter(
  62 | 			vaccine => !administered.some(admin => admin.vaccine === vaccine.vaccineName)
  63 | 		);
  64 |
  65 | 		return {
  66 | 			administered,
  67 | 			pending: pendingVaccines,
  68 | 			ageInDays
  69 | 		};
  70 | 	});
```

```ts
 177 | // Get patient medical history
 178 | export const getPatientMedicalHistory = protectedProcedure
 179 | 	.input(

 217 | 			includeDeleted ? undefined : eq(medicalRecord.isDeleted, false)
 218 | 		);

 238 | 			offset,
 239 | 			orderBy: desc(medicalRecord.createdAt)
 240 | 		});
 241 |
 242 | 		// Get counts for diagnosis and vitals per record
 243 | 		const enrichedRecords = await Promise.all(
 244 | 			records.map(async record => {
 245 | 				const diagnosisCount = await db.$count(diagnosis, eq(diagnosis.medicalId, record.id));
 246 | 				const vitalSignsCount = await db.$count(vitalSign, eq(vitalSign.medicalId, record.id));

 252 | 				};

 257 | 		const hasMore = offset + limit < total;
 258 |

 260 | 	});

 274 | 			.set({
 275 | 				...input.data,
 276 | 				updatedAt: new Date()
 277 | 			})
 278 | 			.where(eq(medicalRecord.id, input.id))
 279 | 			.returning();

 282 | 			throw new Error("Medical record not found");
 283 | 		}
 284 |

 286 | 	});
```

```ts
 197 | 			limit: z.number(),

 199 | 		})
 200 | 	)
 201 | 	.handler(async ({ input, context }) => {
 202 | 		const { page, limit, search, status, isActive, gender, bloodGroup } = input;
 203 | 		const offset = (page - 1) * limit;
 204 |
 205 | 		let whereClause = and(eq(patient.clinicId, context.clinicId || ""), eq(patient.isDeleted, false));
 206 |
 207 | 		if (search) {
 208 | 			whereClause = and(
 209 | 				whereClause,
 210 | 				or(

 212 | 					like(patient.lastName, `%${search}%`),
 213 | 					like(patient.email, `%${search}%`),
 214 | 					like(patient.phone, `%${search}%`)
 215 | 				)
 216 | 			);
 217 | 		}
 218 |
 219 | 		if (status) {
 220 | 			whereClause = and(whereClause, eq(patient.status, status));
 221 | 		}
 222 |
 223 | 		if (isActive !== undefined) {
 224 | 			whereClause = and(whereClause, eq(patient.isActive, isActive));
 225 | 		}
 226 |
 227 | 		if (gender) {
 228 | 			whereClause = and(whereClause, eq(patient.gender, gender));
 229 | 		}
 230 |
 231 | 		if (bloodGroup) {
 232 | 			whereClause = and(whereClause, eq(patient.bloodGroup, bloodGroup));
 233 | 		}

 235 | 		const patientsList = await db.query.patient.findMany({
 236 | 			where: whereClause,
 237 | 			limit,
 238 | 			offset,
 239 | 			orderBy: desc(patient.createdAt)
 240 | 		});

 307 | // Get patient statistics
 308 | export const getPatientStats = protectedProcedure
 309 | 	.input(z.object({ id: z.string() }))
 310 | 	.output(
 311 | 		z.object({
 312 | 			totalAppointments: z.number(),
 313 | 			completedAppointments: z.number(),
 314 | 			cancelledAppointments: z.number(),
 315 | 			totalPayments: z.number(),
 316 | 			paidAmount: z.number(),
 317 | 			dueAmount: z.number(),
 318 | 			totalPrescriptions: z.number(),
 319 | 			activePrescriptions: z.number(),
 320 | 			totalImmunizations: z.number(),
 321 | 			lastVisit: z.date().nullable(),
 322 | 			nextAppointment: z.date().nullable()
 323 | 		})
 324 | 	)
 325 | 	.handler(async ({ input, context }) => {
 326 | 		const patientId = input.id;
 327 |
 328 | 		// Get appointment stats
 329 | 		const appointmentStats = context.db
 330 | 			.select({
 331 | 				total: sql<number>`count(*)`,
 332 | 				completed: sql<number>`sum(case when ${appointment.status} = 'COMPLETED' then 1 else 0 end)`,
 333 | 				cancelled: sql<number>`sum(case when ${appointment.status} = 'CANCELLED' then 1 else 0 end)`,
 334 | 				lastVisit: sql<Date>`max(case when ${appointment.status} = 'COMPLETED' then ${appointment.appointmentDate} else null end)`,
 335 | 				nextAppointment: sql<Date>`min(case when ${appointment.appointmentDate} > datetime('now') and ${appointment.status} not in ('CANCELLED', 'COMPLETED') then ${appointment.appointmentDate} else null end)`
 336 | 			})
 337 | 			.from(appointment)
 338 | 			.where(and(eq(appointment.patientId, patientId), eq(appointment.isDeleted, false)))
 339 | 			.get();
 340 |
 341 | 		// Get payment stats
 342 | 		const paymentStats = context.db
 343 | 			.select({
 344 | 				total: sql<number>`count(*)`,
 345 | 				paidAmount: sql<number>`coalesce(sum(${payment.amountPaid}), 0)`,
 346 | 				totalAmount: sql<number>`coalesce(sum(${payment.totalAmount}), 0)`
 347 | 			})
 348 | 			.from(payment)
 349 | 			.where(and(eq(payment.patientId, patientId), eq(payment.isDeleted, false)))
 350 | 			.get();
 351 |
 352 | 		// Get prescription stats
 353 | 		const prescriptionStats = context.db
 354 | 			.select({
 355 | 				total: sql<number>`count(*)`,
 356 | 				active: sql<number>`sum(case when ${prescription.status} = 'active' then 1 else 0 end)`
 357 | 			})
 358 | 			.from(prescription)
 359 | 			.where(eq(prescription.patientId, patientId))
 360 | 			.get();
 361 |
 362 | 		// Get immunization count
 363 | 		const immunizationCount = context.db
 364 | 			.select({ count: sql<number>`count(*)` })
 365 | 			.from(immunization)
 366 | 			.where(and(eq(immunization.patientId, patientId), eq(immunization.isDeleted, false)))
 367 | 			.get();
 368 |
 369 | 		return {
 370 | 			totalAppointments: appointmentStats?.total ?? 0,
 371 | 			completedAppointments: appointmentStats?.completed ?? 0,
 372 | 			cancelledAppointments: appointmentStats?.cancelled ?? 0,
 373 | 			totalPayments: paymentStats?.total ?? 0,
 374 | 			paidAmount: paymentStats?.paidAmount ?? 0,
 375 | 			dueAmount: (paymentStats?.totalAmount ?? 0) - (paymentStats?.paidAmount ?? 0),
 376 | 			totalPrescriptions: prescriptionStats?.total ?? 0,
 377 | 			activePrescriptions: prescriptionStats?.active ?? 0,
 378 | 			totalImmunizations: immunizationCount?.count ?? 0,
 379 | 			lastVisit: appointmentStats?.lastVisit ?? null,
 380 | 			nextAppointment: appointmentStats?.nextAppointment ?? null
 381 | 		};
 382 | 	});
 383 |
 384 | // Search patients with advanced filters
 385 | export const searchPatients = protectedProcedure
 386 | 	.input(
 387 | 		z.object({
 388 | 			query: z.string(),
 389 | 			limit: z.number().default(20),
 390 | 			includeDeleted: z.boolean().default(false)
 391 | 		})
 392 | 	)
 393 | 	.output(z.array(PatientSchema))
 394 | 	.handler(async ({ input, context }) => {
 395 | 		const { query, limit, includeDeleted } = input;
 396 |
 397 | 		const whereClause = and(
 398 | 			eq(patient.clinicId, context.clinicId || ""),
 399 | 			includeDeleted ? undefined : eq(patient.isDeleted, false),
 400 | 			or(
 401 | 				like(patient.firstName, `%${query}%`),
 402 | 				like(patient.lastName, `%${query}%`),
 403 | 				like(patient.email, `%${query}%`),
 404 | 				like(patient.phone, `%${query}%`),
 405 | 				sql`${patient.firstName} || ' ' || ${patient.lastName} LIKE ${`%${query}%`}`
 406 | 			)
 407 | 		);
 408 |
 409 | 		const results = await db.query.patient.findMany({
 410 | 			where: whereClause,
 411 | 			limit,
 412 | 			orderBy: [asc(patient.firstName), asc(patient.lastName)]
 413 | 		});
 414 |
 415 | 		return results;
 416 | 	});
 417 |
 418 | // Bulk create patients
 419 | export const bulkCreatePatients = protectedProcedure
 420 | 	.input(z.array(PatientCreateSchema))
 421 | 	.output(z.array(PatientSchema))
 422 | 	.handler(async ({ input, context }) => {
 423 | 		const patientsToInsert = input.map(patientData => ({
 424 | 			...patientData,
 425 | 			id: crypto.randomUUID(),
 426 | 			clinicId: context.clinicId || "",
 427 | 			createdById: context.user?.id ?? "",
 428 | 			createdAt: new Date(),
 429 | 			updatedAt: new Date()
 430 | 		}));
 431 |
 432 | 		const results = await db.insert(patient).values(patientsToInsert).returning();
 433 | 		return results;
 434 | 	});
 435 |
 436 | // Export all procedures
 437 | export const patientRouter = {
 438 | 	createPatient,
 439 | 	getPatient,
 440 | 	getPatientWithDetails,
 441 | 	listPatients,
 442 | 	updatePatient,
 443 | 	deletePatient,
 444 | 	hardDeletePatient,
 445 | 	getPatientStats,
 446 | 	searchPatients,
 447 | 	bulkCreatePatients
 448 | };
```

`orpc/router/service.ts`:

```ts
   1 | import { and, desc, eq, like } from "drizzle-orm";
   2 | import { z } from "zod";
   3 |
   4 | import { db } from "../../db";
   5 | import { service } from "../../db/schema";
   6 | import { protectedProcedure } from "../init";
   7 |
   8 | export const listServices = protectedProcedure
   9 | 	.input(
  10 | 		z.object({
  11 | 			search: z.string().optional(),
  12 | 			category: z.string().optional(),
  13 | 			page: z.number().int().min(1).default(1),
  14 | 			pageSize: z.number().int().min(1).max(100).default(50)
  15 | 		})
  16 | 	)
  17 | 	.output(
  18 | 		z.object({
  19 | 			services: z.array(z.any()),
  20 | 			total: z.number(),
  21 | 			page: z.number(),
  22 | 			totalPages: z.number()
  23 | 		})
  24 | 	)
  25 | 	.handler(async ({ input, context }) => {
  26 | 		const { search, category, page, pageSize } = input;
  27 | 		const clinicId = context.clinicId;
  28 |
  29 | 		const conditions = and(
  30 | 			eq(service.isDeleted, false),
  31 | 			clinicId ? eq(service.clinicId, clinicId) : undefined,
  32 | 			category ? eq(service.category, category) : undefined,
  33 | 			search ? like(service.serviceName, `%${search}%`) : undefined
  34 | 		);
  35 |
  36 | 		const services = await db.query.service.findMany({
  37 | 			where: conditions,
  38 | 			limit: pageSize,
  39 | 			offset: (page - 1) * pageSize,
  40 | 			orderBy: desc(service.createdAt)
  41 | 		});
  42 |
  43 | 		const total = await db.$count(service, conditions);
  44 |
  45 | 		return {
  46 | 			services,
  47 | 			total,
  48 | 			page,
  49 | 			totalPages: Math.ceil(total / pageSize)
  50 | 		};
  51 | 	});
  52 |
  53 | export const getService = protectedProcedure
  54 | 	.input(z.object({ id: z.string() }))
  55 | 	.output(z.any())
  56 | 	.handler(async ({ input }) => {
  57 | 		const found = await db.query.service.findFirst({
  58 | 			where: and(eq(service.id, input.id), eq(service.isDeleted, false))
  59 | 		});
  60 | 		if (!found) throw new Error("Service not found");
  61 | 		return found;
  62 | 	});
```

`orpc/router/sse.ts`:

```ts
   1 | import { eventIterator, os } from "@orpc/server";
   2 | import * as z from "zod";
   3 |
   4 | const MAX_EVENTS = 5;
   5 |
   6 | export const sse = os
   7 | 	.route({
   8 | 		method: "GET",
   9 | 		path: "/sse",
  10 | 		tags: ["SSE"],
  11 | 		summary: "Server-Sent Events"
  12 | 	})
  13 | 	.output(eventIterator(z.object({ time: z.date() })))
  14 | 	.handler(async function* () {
  15 | 		let count = 0;
  16 |
  17 | 		while (count < MAX_EVENTS) {
  18 | 			count++;
  19 | 			yield { time: new Date() };
  20 | 			await new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, 1000));
  21 | 		}
  22 | 	});
```

```ts
 347 | export const getVitalSignsTrend = protectedProcedure
 348 | 	.input(VitalSignsTrendSchema)
 349 | 	.handler(async ({ context, input }) => {
 350 | 		const { clinicId, db } = context;
 351 | 		const { patientId, days, metrics } = input;
 352 |
 353 | 		const startDate = startOfDay(subDays(new Date(), days));
 354 |
 355 | 		if (!clinicId) throw new Error("Clinic context missing");
 356 |
 357 | 		console.debug("Getting vital signs trend", { patientId, days, metrics });
 358 |
 359 | 		const vitalSignsList = await db.query.vitalSign.findMany({
 360 | 			where: and(
 361 | 				eq(vitalSign.clinicId, clinicId),
 362 | 				eq(vitalSign.patientId, patientId),
 363 | 				gte(vitalSign.recordedAt, startDate)
 364 | 			),
 365 | 			orderBy: [vitalSign.recordedAt]
 366 | 		});
 367 |
 368 | 		const trend: {
 369 | 			dates: string[];
 370 | 			temperature: Array<{ value: number; date: string }>;
 371 | 			bloodPressure: Array<{ systolic: number; diastolic: number; date: string }>;
 372 | 			heartRate: Array<{ value: number; date: string }>;
 373 | 			oxygen: Array<{ value: number; date: string }>;
 374 | 		} = {
 375 | 			dates: [],
 376 | 			temperature: [],
 377 | 			bloodPressure: [],
 378 | 			heartRate: [],
 379 | 			oxygen: []
 380 | 		};
 381 |
 382 | 		vitalSignsList.forEach(vs => {
 383 | 			const date = vs.recordedAt.toISOString();
 384 | 			trend.dates.push(date);
 385 |
 386 | 			if (metrics.includes("temperature") && vs.bodyTemperature) {
 387 | 				trend.temperature.push({ value: vs.bodyTemperature, date });
 388 | 			}
 389 |
 390 | 			if (metrics.includes("bloodPressure") && vs.systolic && vs.diastolic) {
 391 | 				trend.bloodPressure.push({ systolic: vs.systolic, diastolic: vs.diastolic, date });
 392 | 			}
 393 |
 394 | 			if (metrics.includes("heartRate") && vs.heartRate) {
 395 | 				trend.heartRate.push({ value: vs.heartRate, date });
 396 | 			}
 397 |
 398 | 			if (metrics.includes("oxygen") && vs.oxygenSaturation) {
 399 | 				trend.oxygen.push({ value: vs.oxygenSaturation, date });
 400 | 			}
 401 | 		});
 402 |
 403 | 		// Calculate summary statistics
 404 | 		const summary = {
 405 | 			temperature: calculateSummary(trend.temperature.map(t => t.value)),
 406 | 			heartRate: calculateSummary(trend.heartRate.map(h => h.value)),
 407 | 			oxygenSaturation: calculateSummary(trend.oxygen.map(o => o.value))
 408 | 		};
 409 |
 410 | 		return {
 411 | 			patientId,
 412 | 			period: { days, startDate, endDate: new Date() },
 413 | 			trend,
 414 | 			summary,
 415 | 			totalReadings: vitalSignsList.length
 416 | 		};
 417 | 	});

 703 | 	const { clinicId, db, user } = context;
 704 | 	const { patientId, doctorId, page, pageSize, fromDate, toDate, status, typeOfEncounter, search } = input;

 724 | 		});

 731 | 		});

 734 | 		}

 738 | 		where: conditions,
 739 | 		with: {
 740 | 			patient: {
 741 | 				with: {
 742 | 					user: {
 743 | 						columns: {
 744 | 							name: true
 745 | 						}
 746 | 					}
 747 | 				}
 748 | 			},

 750 | 				with: {

 764 | 		orderBy: [desc(diagnosis.date)]
 765 | 	});

 771 | 			d =>
 772 | 				d.diagnosis?.toLowerCase().includes(searchLower) ||
 773 | 				d.treatment?.toLowerCase().includes(searchLower) ||
 774 | 				d.symptoms?.toLowerCase().includes(searchLower)
 775 | 		);
```
