```ts
 805 | 		});
 806 |
 807 | 		if (!existing) {
 808 | 			throw new Error("Diagnosis not found");
 809 | 		}
 810 |
 811 | 		await db
 812 | 			.update(diagnosis)
 813 | 			.set({
 814 | 				isDeleted: true,
 815 | 				deletedAt: new Date(),
 816 | 				updatedAt: new Date()
 817 | 			})
 818 | 			.where(eq(diagnosis.id, id));
 819 |
 820 | 		// auditLog insert commented out because table is not defined in the schema context
 821 |
 822 | 		return { success: true, message: "Diagnosis deleted successfully" };
 823 | 	});
 824 |
 825 | export const getDiagnosisStatistics = protectedProcedure
 826 | 	.input(
 827 | 		z.object({
 828 | 			startDate: z.coerce.date(),
 829 | 			endDate: z.coerce.date(),
 830 | 			groupBy: z.enum(["doctor", "type", "status"]).default("doctor")
 831 | 		})
 832 | 	)
 833 | 	.handler(async ({ context, input }) => {
 834 | 		const { clinicId, db } = context;
 835 | 		const { startDate, endDate, groupBy } = input;
 836 |
 837 | 		if (!clinicId) throw new Error("Clinic context missing");
 838 |
 839 | 		console.info("Generating diagnosis statistics", { startDate, endDate, groupBy });
 840 |
 841 | 		const whereConditions = and(
 842 | 			eq(diagnosis.clinicId, clinicId),
 843 | 			eq(diagnosis.isDeleted, false),
 844 | 			between(diagnosis.date, startDate, endDate)
 845 | 		);
 846 |
 847 | 		const [totalResult] = await db.select({ count: sql<number>`count(*)` }).from(diagnosis).where(whereConditions);
 848 |
 849 | 		const byType = await db
 850 | 			.select({
 851 | 				type: diagnosis.type,
 852 | 				count: sql<number>`count(*)`
 853 | 			})
 854 | 			.from(diagnosis)
 855 | 			.where(whereConditions)
 856 | 			.groupBy(diagnosis.type);
 857 |
 858 | 		const byStatus = await db
 859 | 			.select({
 860 | 				status: diagnosis.status,
 861 | 				count: sql<number>`count(*)`
 862 | 			})
 863 | 			.from(diagnosis)
 864 | 			.where(whereConditions)
 865 | 			.groupBy(diagnosis.status);
 866 |
 867 | 		const byDoctor = await db
 868 | 			.select({
 869 | 				doctorId: diagnosis.doctorId,
 870 | 				count: sql<number>`count(*)`
 871 | 			})
 872 | 			.from(diagnosis)
 873 | 			.where(whereConditions)
 874 | 			.groupBy(diagnosis.doctorId)
 875 | 			.orderBy(sql`count(*) DESC`)
 876 | 			.limit(10);
 877 |
 878 | 		// Get doctor names for the top doctors
 879 | 		const doctorIds = byDoctor.map(d => d.doctorId).filter(Boolean);
 880 | 		const doctorsList =
 881 | 			doctorIds.length > 0
 882 | 				? await db.query.doctor.findMany({
 883 | 						where: and(eq(doctor.clinicId, clinicId), inArray(doctor.id, doctorIds as string[])),
 884 | 						with: {
 885 | 							user: {
 886 | 								columns: {
 887 | 									name: true
 888 | 								}
 889 | 							}
 890 | 						}
 891 | 					})
 892 | 				: [];
 893 |
 894 | 		const doctorMap = new Map(doctorsList.map(d => [d.id, d.user?.name || d.name]));
 895 |
 896 | 		const statistics = {
 897 | 			period: { startDate, endDate },
 898 | 			total: totalResult?.count ?? 0,
 899 | 			distribution: {
 900 | 				byType: byType.map(t => ({ type: t.type, count: Number(t.count) })),
 901 | 				byStatus: byStatus.map(s => ({ status: s.status, count: Number(s.count) }))
 902 | 			},
 903 | 			topDoctors: byDoctor.map(d => ({
 904 | 				doctorId: d.doctorId,
 905 | 				doctorName: doctorMap.get(d.doctorId) || "Unknown",
 906 | 				count: Number(d.count)
 907 | 			}))
 908 | 		};
 909 |
 910 | 		console.info("Diagnosis statistics generated", statistics);
 911 | 		return statistics;
 912 | 	});
 913 |
 914 | // ============================================
 915 | // Helper Functions
 916 | // ============================================
 917 |
 918 | function calculateSummary(values: number[]): {
 919 | 	min: number | null;
 920 | 	max: number | null;
 921 | 	avg: number | null;
 922 | 	latest: number | null;
 923 | } {
 924 | 	if (values.length === 0) {
 925 | 		return { min: null, max: null, avg: null, latest: null };
 926 | 	}
 927 | 	return {
 928 | 		min: Math.min(...values),
 929 | 		max: Math.max(...values),
 930 | 		avg: values.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0) / values.length,
 931 | 		latest: values[values.length - 1]
 932 | 	};
 933 | }
```

```tsx
 167 |
 168 | function AddGrowthMeasurement({ patientId }: { patientId: string }) {
 169 | 	const [weight, setWeight] = useState("");
 170 | 	const [height, setHeight] = useState("");
 171 |
 172 | 	const recordGrowth = useMutation(
 173 | 		orpc.growth.record.mutationOptions({
 174 | 			onSuccess: () => {
 175 | 				setWeight("");
 176 | 				setHeight("");
 177 | 				toast.success("Growth recorded successfully!");
 178 | 			}
 179 | 		})
 180 | 	);
 181 |
 182 | 	const handleSubmit = (e: React.FormEvent) => {
 183 | 		e.preventDefault();
 184 | 		recordGrowth.mutate({
 185 | 			patientId,
 186 | 			weight: weight ? Number.parseFloat(weight) : undefined,
 187 | 			height: height ? Number.parseFloat(height) : undefined,
 188 | 			date: new Date()
 189 | 		});
 190 | 	};
 191 |
 192 | 	return (
 193 | 		<Card className='mt-6'>
 194 | 			<CardHeader>
 195 | 				<CardTitle>Record New Measurement</CardTitle>
 196 | 			</CardHeader>
 197 | 			<CardContent>
 198 | 				<form
 199 | 					className='flex gap-4'
 200 | 					onSubmit={handleSubmit}
 201 | 				>
 202 | 					<div className='flex-1'>
 203 | 						<Label htmlFor='weight'>Weight (kg)</Label>
 204 | 						<Input
 205 | 							className='w-full rounded border p-2'
 206 | 							id='weight'
 207 | 							onChange={e => setWeight(e.target.value)}
 208 | 							placeholder='e.g., 7.5'
 209 | 							step='0.1'
 210 | 							type='number'
 211 | 							value={weight}
 212 | 						/>
 213 | 					</div>
 214 | 					<div className='flex-1'>
 215 | 						<Label htmlFor='height'>Height (cm)</Label>
 216 | 						<Input
 217 | 							className='w-full rounded border p-2'
 218 | 							id='height'
 219 | 							onChange={e => setHeight(e.target.value)}
 220 | 							placeholder='e.g., 68.5'
 221 | 							step='0.5'
 222 | 							type='number'
 223 | 							value={height}
 224 | 						/>
 225 | 					</div>
 226 | 					<div className='flex items-end'>
 227 | 						<Button
 228 | 							disabled={recordGrowth.isPending}
 229 | 							type='submit'
 230 | 						>
 231 | 							{recordGrowth.isPending ? "Saving..." : "Save"}
 232 | 						</Button>
 233 | 					</div>
 234 | 				</form>
 235 | 			</CardContent>
 236 | 		</Card>
 237 | 	);
 238 | }
```

```tsx
 113 |
 114 | function calculateAge(dob: Date): number {
 115 | 	const months = (new Date().getFullYear() - dob.getFullYear()) * 12;
 116 | 	return months + (new Date().getMonth() - dob.getMonth());
 117 | }
 118 |
 119 | function _formatLastVisit(date?: Date | null): string {
 120 | 	if (!date) return "Never";
 121 | 	return new Date(date).toLocaleDateString();
 122 | }
```

`utils/decimal.ts`:

```ts
   1 | /**
   2 |  * Client-safe decimal utilities
   3 |  * These functions work with Decimal.js types without importing server dependencies
   4 |  */
   5 |
   6 | interface DecimalLike {
   7 | 	toNumber: () => number;
   8 | }
   9 |
  10 | function isDecimalLike(value: unknown): value is DecimalLike {
  11 | 	return (
  12 | 		typeof value === "object" &&
  13 | 		value !== null &&
  14 | 		"toNumber" in value &&
  15 | 		typeof (value as DecimalLike).toNumber === "function"
  16 | 	);
  17 | }
  18 |
  19 | /**
  20 |  * Convert any valid decimal input to a JS number
  21 |  * Supports: number, string, Decimal-like objects
  22 |  */
  23 | export function toNumber(value: unknown): number {
  24 | 	if (typeof value === "number") {
  25 | 		return value;
  26 | 	}
  27 | 	if (typeof value === "string") {
  28 | 		const num = Number(value);
  29 | 		if (Number.isNaN(num)) {
  30 | 			throw new Error(`Invalid number string: ${value}`);
  31 | 		}
  32 | 		return num;
  33 | 	}
  34 | 	if (isDecimalLike(value)) {
  35 | 		return value.toNumber();
  36 | 	}
  37 | 	throw new Error("Invalid decimal input");
  38 | }
  39 |
  40 | /**
  41 |  * Convert decimal to number with fallback
  42 |  */
  43 | export function decimalToNumber(value?: unknown): number {
  44 | 	if (value === null || value === undefined) {
  45 | 		return 0;
  46 | 	}
  47 | 	if (typeof value === "number") {
  48 | 		return value;
  49 | 	}
  50 | 	if (isDecimalLike(value)) {
  51 | 		return value.toNumber();
  52 | 	}
  53 | 	return 0;
  54 | }
```

```ts
   3 | 	if (lowerAction.includes("appointment")) return "appointment";

   5 | 	if (lowerAction.includes("payment")) return "payment";
   6 | 	if (lowerAction.includes("prescription")) return "prescription";
   7 | 	return "appointment";
   8 | }

  13 | 	if (lowerAction.includes("update")) return "updated";
  14 | 	if (lowerAction.includes("cancel")) return "cancelled";
  15 | 	if (lowerAction.includes("complete")) return "completed";
  16 | 	return "updated";
  17 | }
```

`utils/mcp-handler.ts`:

```ts
   1 | import { InMemoryTransport } from "@modelcontextprotocol/sdk/inMemory.js";
   2 | import type { McpServer } from "@modelcontextprotocol/sdk/server/mcp.js";
   3 | import type { JSONRPCMessage } from "@modelcontextprotocol/sdk/types.js";
   4 |
   5 | export async function handleMcpRequest(request: Request, server: McpServer): Promise<Response> {
   6 | 	try {
   7 | 		const jsonRpcRequest = (await request.json()) as JSONRPCMessage;
   8 |
   9 | 		const [clientTransport, serverTransport] = InMemoryTransport.createLinkedPair();
  10 |
  11 | 		let responseData: JSONRPCMessage | null = null;
  12 |
  13 | 		clientTransport.onmessage = (message: JSONRPCMessage) => {
  14 | 			responseData = message;
  15 | 		};
  16 |
  17 | 		await server.connect(serverTransport);
  18 |
  19 | 		await clientTransport.start();
  20 | 		await serverTransport.start();
  21 |
  22 | 		await clientTransport.send(jsonRpcRequest);
  23 |
  24 | 		await new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, 10));
  25 |
  26 | 		await clientTransport.close();
  27 | 		await serverTransport.close();
  28 |
  29 | 		return Response.json(responseData, {
  30 | 			headers: {
  31 | 				"Content-Type": "application/json"
  32 | 			}
  33 | 		});
  34 | 	} catch (error) {
  35 | 		console.error("MCP handler error:", error);
  36 |
  37 | 		// Return a JSON-RPC error response
  38 | 		return Response.json(
  39 | 			{
  40 | 				jsonrpc: "2.0",
  41 | 				error: {
  42 | 					code: -32603,
  43 | 					message: "Internal server error",
  44 | 					data: error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error)
  45 | 				},
  46 | 				id: null
  47 | 			},
  48 | 			{
  49 | 				status: 500,
  50 | 				headers: {
  51 | 					"Content-Type": "application/json"
  52 | 				}
  53 | 			}
  54 | 		);
  55 | 	}
  56 | }

```
